notes.title: Application Data Update and Server Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
　
Server maintenance will be performed on the following schedule.
　
◇Date & Time
[PDT] 09/24/2025 22:00 – 09/25/2025 01:00 [Scheduled]
[CEST] 09/25/2025 07:00 – 09/25/2025 10:00 [Scheduled]
　
◇Maintenance Details
・Application Data Update
・Supply Drop Lineup Update
　
　※Please note that you will not be able to log in to the game during the maintenance.
　※The end time may vary depending on the maintenance status. Please understand this in advance.
　※Entering the maintenance during matching may cause unexpected errors.
　　Please log out of the game before maintenance.
　
　
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
　
[PDT] 09/25/2025 / [CEST] 09/25/2025 Updated content is listed below.
　
　
■GBO Autumn Festival Pre-event
Starting from [PDT] 08/28/2025 / [CEST] 08/28/2025, GBO Autumn Festival Pre-event will begin.
　■Period
　　[PDT] 08/28/2025 01:00 – 10/01/2025 21:59 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 08/28/2025 10:00 – 10/02/2025 06:59 [Scheduled]
　　※You can have a check to the information below for more details.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/546744790793846879
　
　
■[Revival event] Gundam Delta Kai Ground Type guaranteed STEP UP Supply Drop
Starting from [PDT] 09/25/2025 / [CEST] 09/25/2025, 
Gundam Delta Kai Ground Type guaranteed STEP UP Supply Drop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/55c8ec48bdb9a51a2f0975609d675dc0bf89bfc9.jpg[/img]
　
　　■Period
　　　[PDT] 09/25/2025 01:00 – 10/01/2025 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　　[CEST] 09/25/2025 10:00 – 10/02/2025 06:30 [Scheduled]
　
　　■Content
　　A Supply Drop, in which 10 consecutive Supply Drops can be requested up to STEP7.
　　The STEP will progress by 1 each time you perform a request,
　　as STEP1 → STEP2 → STEP3 → STEP4 → STEP5 → STEP6 → STEP7.
　　Once you reach STEP7, the Boosted Supply Drop will end.
　　・STEP1 (15 Tokens): Tokens 50% OFF!
　　・STEP2 (30 Tokens): 50 ★★★★ Mechanic tickets as a bonus!
　　・STEP3 (30 Tokens): 50 ★★★★ Modification kits as a bonus!
　　・STEP4 (30 Tokens): ★★★★ Materials Drop Rate x2!
　　・STEP5 (30 Tokens): ★★★★ Materials Drop Rate x3! + 100 ★★★★ Mechanic tickets as a bonus!
　　・STEP6 (30 Tokens): ★★★★ Materials Drop Rate x3! + 100 ★★★★ Modification kits as a bonus!
　　・STEP7 (30 Tokens): 1 Guaranteed “Gundam Delta Kai Ground Type LV1”!!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ custom part “Electric Defense System LV1” as bonus!
　
　■Custom part
　◎Electric Defense System LV1
　　・Activates after 4 minutes of combat.
　　　If unit HP is at 30% or more, nullifies radar damage from attacks and skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/1f51d2ecfb9c62865b4d083b98c45151dc31bfe6.png[/img]
　
　※Same supplies will be drawn as the ongoing Supply Drops.
　　　For details, please check the [Item List].
　※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
　
　
■Notice of Supply Drop Lineup “Gabthley Beta”
Supply Drop Lineup has been updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/3bf06eadfc3061c31fc2cc474b05d8287dd8a8ce.jpg[/img]
　
　■Period
　　[PDT] 09/25/2025 01:00 – 10/01/2025 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 09/25/2025 10:00 – 10/02/2025 06:30 [Scheduled]
　
　■Added New Materials
　　■Unit
　　・★★★ Gabthley Beta LV1 (Support unit, ground/space uses, cost: 600)
　　　※The above MS is eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
　
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・Support unit with cost of 600.
　　・This modified Gabthley variant is a transformable MS, completed with the help of Paptimus Scirocco,
　　　who became involved with the Titans.
　　・The base model, the Gabthley, achieved a balance between variable mechanisms and structural strength
　　　as a conventional-sized MS by adopting a movable frame.
　　　While in MA form, concentrated thruster output gives it high mobility, allowing it to excel 
　　　in long-range movement, long-distance fire, and utilize part of its Movable Frame as a claw arm.
　　　Due to these abilities, it is considered a hit-and-run combat unit with high mobility and firepower unique to an MA.
　　・Although plans for mass production were scrapped due to maintenance and cost issues,
　　　its high performance in both MS and MA forms led to a redesign.
　　　Its transformation mechanism remains unchanged from the base model, 
　　　but its head sensors were enhanced for use as a commander unit.
　　　It was also newly equipped with a Fedayeen Rifle Mk-II, improving long-range bombardment capabilities,
　　　and a Multi-Shield that combines propulsion functions while in MA form.
　　・During the latter half of the Gryps War, this unit was deployed as a squadron commander unit 
　　　in a three-way conflict between the Titans, AEUG, and Axis.
　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
https://bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2025/07/40875db39477aef2889ea089c0ecc98d.mp4
　
　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　　　※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
　
　Skill “Multi Shield Controller”
　・Activated when shields are in possession.
　　While activated, mobility is increased, 
　　and thruster consumption when starting High Speed Movement or during movement is reduced.
　　Also, damage increases when landing a Ram Attack.
　　※This skill is a skill for “Gabthley Beta (Transformed)”.
　
　■Exclusive pilot item as a Bonus for the 10 Consecutive Supply Drops!
　　Beginning from [PDT] 09/25/2025 01:00 / [CEST] 09/25/2025 10:00,
　　1 random exclusive pilot item as a bonus can be obtained from 10 consecutive drops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/6123821a0364c0a77762769994fbce24f1a289fb.jpg[/img]
　
　■Period
　　　　[PDT] 09/25/2025 01:00 – 10/01/2025 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　　　[CEST] 09/25/2025 10:00 – 10/02/2025 06:30 [Scheduled]
　
　　■Supply Drop with Bonus Items
　　　Normal 10-consecutive Supply Drops
　
　　■Bonus Item Contents (get 1 of the 2 items randomly listed below)
　　　■Wear
　　　　Normal Suit: Titans 01
　　　■Accessory
　　　　Helmet: Titans 01
　　　※Requesting 10-Consecutive Supply Drops during the campaign will grant you an additional 11th supply drop,
　　　　and get 1 extra item.
　　　※Single Supply Drop is NOT applied with this benefit.
　　　　The bonus item will not be awarded even if you request the 1-Attempt Supply Drop ten times in a row.
　
　■Other material
　　⇒ Information about newly added materials
　　■New unlocked upper LV unit
　　・★★★★ Gundam Delta Kai Ground Type LV2 (Raid unit, ground only, cost 650)
　　※All ★★★ and ★★★★ units are eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/4787752e4c10c75da8967fe6642f36c60bc11118.png[/img]
　
　■Removed Materials from the Supply Drop
　　Some materials are removed from the supply drop lineup.
　　　※For more information regarding the updated supply drop lineup, please refer to the [Supply Drop List].
　
　■Notice of [Big Boost to Supply Drop Rates Campaign]
　　Some of the newly added materials will have a boost to their supply drop rates for a limited time.
　　■Period
　　　[PDT] 09/25/2025 01:00 – 10/01/2025 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　　[CEST] 09/25/2025 10:00 – 10/02/2025 06:30 [Scheduled]
　　■Featured material that will benefit from the Big Boost to its Supply Rate
　　・★★★ Gabthley Beta LV1 (Support unit, ground/space uses, cost: 600)
　　■Supply Drops that will benefit from Big Boost to Supply Rates
　　　・Normal Supply Drop
　　　　※After the end of the campaign, all supply drop rates will be the same as other materials.
　
　
■Notice of “Limited Supply Drop!! Gundam Delta Kai Ground Type”
Starting from [PDT] 09/25/2025 / [CEST] 09/25/2025, 
a Limited Supply Drop with a MS drop rate boosted event will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/5938648ecacde20750d1a78604b1747127304c8f.jpg[/img]
　
　■Period
　　　　[PDT] 09/25/2025 01:00 – 10/01/2025 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　　　[CEST] 09/25/2025 10:00 – 10/02/2025 06:30 [Scheduled]
　
　■Contents
　　During the period, “Limited Supply Drop (Once / 10 Times)” can be requested from the material counter.
　　During the Limited Supply Drop, Gundam Delta Kai Ground Type’s drop rate will be increased.
　　In addition, you will get 50 ★★★★ Mechanic tickets as a bonus when you request 10 consecutive Supply Drop.
　
　■Featured material with a Big Boost to its supply drop rate
　　In the Limited Supply Drop, drop rate on each unit LV and weapons will be affected respectively.
　　◎Supply drop rate increase① (Item Amount 1)
　　・★★★★ Gundam Delta Kai Ground Type LV1 (Raid unit, ground only, cost 600)
　　◎Supply drop rate increase② (Item Amount 1)
　　・★★★★ Gundam Delta Kai Ground Type LV2 (Raid unit, ground only, cost 650)
　　◎Supply drop rate increase③ (Item Amount 2)
　　　・★★ GDK Ground Type BR [RG] LV2
　　　・★ GDK Ground Type BS LV2
　
　■Supply Drops that are affected by the drop rate increase
　　・Limited Supply Drop
　
※Materials those can be received from this Limited Supply Drop will be as same as the current normal Supply Drop lineup.
　Differing from the standard Supply Drop, only the specified items in the Limited Supply Drop will be boosted.
※Drop rate increases of the Limited Supply Drop will affect the units of each LV and the units’ main weapon differently.
　While LV 1-2 unit and weapons are affected by the drop rate increases as below.
　・LV1 Unit’s drop rate increased by “1%”
　・LV2 Unit’s drop rate increased by “1%”
　・Main weapons’ drop rate Increase “3％”
　The Supply Drop rate increases is made by the reducing the drop rate of “★” rarity items.
※Regarding the detailed lineup of the Limited Supply Drop, please check [Item List].
※The amount of tokens required to request a Limited Supply Drop is the same as normal Supply Drop.
　(Once – 3 tokens / 10 Times – 30 tokens)
※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
　
■October 2025 Premium Login Bonus
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/a2a159bc024ef200d701624c6dc6e829e4b05b86.png[/img]
　◎[PDT] 09/30/2025 13:00 – 10/10/2025 12:59
　◎[CEST] 09/30/2025 22:00 – 10/10/2025 21:59
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/6c3771e66d357a3623069452f6429c5346967f03.png[/img]
　・List of items you can get
　　MS: ★★★ Messer Type-F01 LV1
　　Other: Mechanic ticket [★★★★]–[★★★★★], Modification kit [★★★]–[★★★★],
　　　　　  Hanger usage permission <At the beginning of the month>, DP, Token
　
　◎[PDT] 10/10/2025 13:00 – 10/20/2025 12:59
　◎[CEST] 10/10/2025 22:00 – 10/20/2025 21:59
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/18938f8ba555b61577440565ef7fc42f57a2a69b.png[/img]
　・List of items you can get
　　MS: ★★★ Zeta Gundam 3A Type LV1
　　Others: [★] – [★★★] Modification kits, Hanger usage permission ＜The middle of the month＞, DP, Token
　
　◎[PDT] 10/20/2025 13:00 – 10/31/2025 12:59
　◎[CEST] 10/20/2025 22:00 – 10/31/2025 21:59
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/26a5976dc5820f2b96fb0f394f43ec3ef5402ec9.png[/img]
　・List of items you can get
　　MS: ★★ Roswell Jegan LV1
　　Others: [★] – [★★★] Modification kits, Hanger usage permission ＜At the end of the month＞, DP, Token
　※When you acquire the Hangar usage permission, the dedicated hangar of the reinforcement facility will be opened.
　※Hangars have early, mid, and late slots, and each of these slots will be opened in the duration
　　in which the permission to use the hangar is acquired.
　※All hangars opened by the usage right will become unavailable at the end of the month 
　　in which the usage rights are acquired ([PDT] 12:59 / [CEST] 21:59 on the day).
　　(If the end of the month arrives in the middle of storing the MS, 
　　it will be unavailable after the MS enhancement is completed.)
　
　
■New Materials for exchange are added to Recycle Counter.
　⇒ Information about newly added materials
　■Units
　・★★★ Gundam G07 LV1 added
　・★★ GM Kai Ground Type [CB] [TB] LV2 added
　・★★ Gouf [F Unit] [TB] LV2 added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/d64b9a015790f144f0d7cbe3037a535190bf69c2.png[/img]
　※The materials mentioned above will be available at the Recycle Counter, from [JST] 09/25/2025 – 09/26/2025.
　
　
■Rating Match/Quick Match Game Modes are updated.
　※There may be differences about the game mode with the information above,
　　which were introduced during the previous update regarding [Possible Game Modes].
　
　
■Some MS spec is adjusted for the Situation Battle “The North America Front”.
　■Adjusted MS
　◎Team B
　・Hildolfr
　　⇒　Greater MS spec
　・Ram Z’Gok
　　⇒　Greater MS spec
　・Dom Tropical (Test Type)
　　⇒　Greater MS spec
　
　
■Schedule for this week's weekend-only battle
　◎Weekend-only battle schedule
　　[PDT] 09/25/2025 12:00 – 09/28/2025 11:59 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 09/25/2025 21:00 – 09/28/2025 20:59 [Scheduled]
　◎Special Rules
　　・Special Battle is now available!
　　・Situation Battle “The North America Front” will be held.
　
　
■Next Clan Match Schedule
Please refer, here for the next Clan Match schedule and reward collection period.
For an overview of the Clan Match, please refer here.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/3696937262747690435


The latest information will be posted on STEAM News and our X (Twitter) in the future.
https://x.com/pc_gbo2
　
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

notes.title: Application Data Update and Server Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
　
Server maintenance will be performed on the following schedule.
　
◇Date & Time
[PDT] 09/17/2025 22:00 – 09/18/2025 01:00 [Scheduled]
[CEST] 09/18/2025 07:00 – 09/18/2025 10:00 [Scheduled]
　
◇Maintenance Details
・Application Data Update
・Supply Drop Lineup Update
　
　※Please note that you will not be able to log in to the game during the maintenance.
　※The end time may vary depending on the maintenance status. Please understand this in advance.
　※Entering the maintenance during matching may cause unexpected errors.
　　Please log out of the game before maintenance.
　
　
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
　
[PDT] 09/18/2025 / [CEST] 09/18/2025 Updated content is listed below.
　
　
■GBO Autumn Festival Pre-event
Starting from [PDT] 08/28/2025 / [CEST] 08/28/2025, GBO Autumn Festival Pre-event will begin.
　■Period
　　[PDT] 08/28/2025 01:00 – 10/01/2025 21:59 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 08/28/2025 10:00 – 10/02/2025 06:59 [Scheduled]
　　※You can have a check to the information below for more details.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/546744790793846879
　
　
■Failnaught guaranteed STEP UP Supply Drop
Starting from [PDT] 09/18/2025 / [CEST] 09/18/2025, Failnaught LV1 guaranteed STEP UP Supply Drop will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/26a444612426a439fa05092441762e3e5a1b49f8.png[/img]
　
　■Period
　　[PDT] 09/18/2025 01:00 – 09/24/2025 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 09/18/2025 10:00 – 09/25/2025 06:30 [Scheduled]
　■Featured material which has the Big Boost in this Supply Rate
　　・★★★ Failnaught LV1 (Raid unit, ground/space uses, cost: 650)
　
　■Content
　　A Supply Drop, in which 10 consecutive Supply Drops can be requested up to STEP5.
　　The STEP will progress by 1 each time you perform a request, as STEP1 → STEP2 → STEP3 → STEP4 → STEP5.
　　Once STEP5 finishes, the Boosted Supply Drop will end.
　　・STEP1 (15 Tokens): Tokens 50% OFF!
　　・STEP2 (30 Tokens): ★★ and above Materials Drop Rate x1.5!
　　・STEP3 (30 Tokens): 1 ★★ or above rarity MS guaranteed!
　　・STEP4 (30 Tokens): Drop rate for Failnaught's materials x 1.5!
　　・STEP5 (30 Tokens): 1 Failnaught LV1 guaranteed!
　
　※Same supplies will be drawn as the ongoing Supply Drops.
　　For details, please check the [Item List].
　※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
　
　
■Notice of Supply Drop Lineup “Failnaught”
Supply Drop Lineup has been updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/58d11c9debbd0b3e2c4bdf0cf195d53deff0e6e6.jpg[/img]
　
　■Period
　　[PDT] 09/18/2025 01:00 – 09/24/2025 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 09/18/2025 10:00 – 09/25/2025 06:30 [Scheduled]
　
　■Added New Materials
　　■Unit
　　・★★★ Failnaught LV1 (Raid unit, ground/space uses, cost: 650)
　　　※The above MS is eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
　
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・Raid unit with cost of 650.
　　・A Tristan unit that was modified at Buch Junk Inc., 
　　　and equipped with an experimental attack unit known as the Failnaught System.
　　・Scharnhorst Buch, founder of the Buch Concern conglomerate, 
　　　which Buch Junk Inc. has been secretly moved forward  with next-gen Mobile Suit design 
　　　and testing via the Strategic Naval Research Institute (S.N.R.I.) and its Tristan unit.
　　・It is equipped with Quasi-Psycommu technology called “Failnaught System”, known as INCOM, 
　　　designed to handle weaponry with good fire power while reducing the burden of fire control, 
　　　allowing the pilot to focus solely on MS operation.
　　　Additionally, the unit is equipped with a Twin-eye type sensor pack on the rear of the head, 
　　　contributing to operational efficiency by providing surrounding information to Incom.
　　・Originally known for its remarkable mobility, the Tristan was equipped with an early variant of 
　　　movable thrusters featuring an AMBAC system, which would later be used for Crossbone Vanguard units
　　　and this significantly enhanced its maneuverability and responsiveness.
　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
https://bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2025/07/735a2666870ef6c29de3a3ae44185c3d.mp4
　
　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　　　※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
　
　Skill “Prototype Fin/Nozzle Control System”
　・Moving forward using High Speed Movement for a set period with full thrusters 
　　puts your unit into HSM attack position.
　　While in this position, High Speed Movement increases and thruster consumption is reduced.
　　Skill-compatible weapons can be used and enemies are staggered when collided with.
　　Also, reaction from recoil due to ranged attacks is nullified.
　　However, if heavy stagger or higher is nullified, stagger from cumulative damage becomes more frequent.
　　※Skill-compatible weapons for the skill will be the main ranged weapon “Failnaught Arm Beam Cannon”
　　　and sub-weapon “Failnaught Beam Rifle”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/16dcb8a6991c66e3b93354601f0349040d66f3b1.png[/img]
　
　■Exclusive pilot item as a Bonus for the 10 Consecutive Supply Drops!
　　Beginning from [PDT] 09/18/2025 01:00 / [CEST] 09/18/2025 10:00,
　　1 random exclusive pilot item as a bonus can be obtained from 10 consecutive drops.

notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
　
■GBO Antumn Festival Pre-event
Starting from [PDT] 08/28/2025 / [CEST] 08/28/2025, "GBO Antumn Festival Pre-event" will begin.
　■Period
　　[PDT] 08/28/2025 01:00 – 10/01/2025 21:59 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 08/28/2025 10:00 – 10/02/2025 06:59 [Scheduled]
　
　■Content
　　Several events will be held during the campaign.
　
　
■[GBO Autumn Festival Pre-event: ①] Wing Gundam Zero [EW] is now joining GBO2!!
To celebrate the 30th Anniversary of "Mobile Suit Gundam Wing", 
Wing Gundam Zero [EW] from "New Mobile Report Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz" is now joining GBO2!
　Introducing the newest ★★★★ MS in GBO2 Steam®, Wing Gundam Zero [EW]"!
　　・★★★★ Wing Gundam Zero [EW] LV1 (Raid unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)
　
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　　・Raid unit with cost of 700.
　　　・This unit served as a prototype for the five Gundams deployed in Operation Meteor, 
　　　　a resistance operation against the growing military power of OZ within the United Earth Sphere Alliance.
　　　・The After Colony (A.C.) calendar began with humanity’s colonization of space. In A.C. 195, 
　　　　following the end of war between Earth nations and the colonies, 
　　　　the United Earth Sphere Alliance was established, advocating for Total Pacifism. 
　　　　But Dekim Barton, head of the Barton Foundation, a key player in space-based capital, secretly formed
　　　　the Mariemaia Army, a private military organization, to resume efforts to dominate the Earth Sphere.
　　　・This unit is equipped with the ZERO System, which directly transmits combat data to the pilot’s brain,
　　　　enhancing their abilities. 
　　　　The Wing Binders mounted on its back provide vernier thrust for high-speed movement, 
　　　　and can also serve as defensive shields.
　　　　It is also armed with the Twin Buster Rifle, capable of annihilating a colony in a single shot, 
　　　　making it ideal for hit-and-run tactics during strategic base assaults.
　　　　This Gundam played a crucial role in liberating the Presidential Palace occupied by the Mariemaia Army.
　　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
https://adm-bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2025/08/6baec8322e5d1fcf3d39c49b726f4632.mp4
　　　
　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　　　
　　　Skill “Aerial Boost”
　　　・Can be used in the air.
　　　　Pressing "special attack" during a jump or while descending will consume thrust and perform a jump.
　　　　Movement speed is increased and damage from ranged attacks is reduced when jumping 
　　　　while this skill is active, but performing certain actions cancels the latter effect.
　　　　More thrust is consumed when using this skill in succession.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/188f30b8fed5b3b3453f42c8a16853ebfb207e6b.png[/img]
　
　　　Skill “ZERO System” LV2
　　　・After activating the sub-weapon “Activate ZERO System”, the following effects occur for a limited time.
　　　　・Attack power and mobility are increased
　　　　・Max melee and ranged strengths are increased
　　　　・While the amount of thruster consumed at the start of and during high speed movement is reduced
　　　　・The primary ranged weapon can be used during high speed movement
　　　　・The “Enhanced Offense System LV1” skill is granted
　　　　・Damage from enemy attacks and stagger caused by cumulative damage are reduced
　　　　・Psycommu lock-on time is extended
　　　　・Performance of compatible weapons are enhanced
　　　　After the effect ends, thrusters will be overheated.
　
　　　Skill "Emergency Self-Destruct Program"
　　　・When your unit is destroyed, 
　　　　the explosion deals damage to the enemy unit's overall HP and to all of their parts.

　　　featuring an F90 [S Type] concept.
　　・It was originally designed by the Strategic Naval Research Institute (S.N.R.I.) as an F90 [S Type] prototype to
　　　eventually be mass produced. However, Anaheim Electronics redesigned it to utilize their existing components
　　　such as generators and thrusters.

　　　and minimal transmission loss.
　　　In terms of performance metrics, such as thrust-to-weight ratio, it stood out from conventional mass-produced
　　　models, even surpassing the Heavygun in certain functions, improving its individual performance as an MS.
　　・As a result, it was able to adapt quite quickly, expanding its purpose beyond a handful of limited support roles.
　　　Some say to enhance its mobility, the four-barreled machine cannons on its shoulders were removed.

notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.

　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・Raid unit with cost of 750.
　　・This F90II is equipped with an Intercept Type mission pack primarily used for intercepting 
　　　and pursuing enemy units.
　　・Although the second unit of the F90 series was recovered with 60% of its structure missing, 
　　　core components such as the generator and main computer were still intact, 
　　　so it was restored by the Strategic Naval Research Institute (S.N.R.I.).
　　・Missing parts were reconstructed using the original F90 for reference,
　　　once again making it compatible with mission packs.
　　　And based on feedback gleaned from the completed basic design of the F91, 
　　　its control computer was replaced with a new bio-computer.
　　　As a result, the F90II (Dash) was born–a machine surpassing the overall performance of the first F90.
　　・Tailored to its mission objectives, this unit is equipped with thrust enhancement units 
　　　on both legs and a flight shield with a sub-flight system capable of independent flight.
　　　An I-Field allows it to form a large-diameter, lance-shaped beam saber which doubles as a beam-firing weapon.

　　Also, thruster consumption during High Speed Movement is reduced,

■MAPs
　◎some MAPs have been adjusted
　　Deserted City
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/c6b17d1a9ccbaea375a7cbc5b0cb9a131acfae16.png[/img]
　
　Adjustment ①: New buildings added to the central battlefield
　　⇒　The central area, which serves as the main battlefield, was generally an open space, 
　　　　making it difficult to approach enemy units.
　　　　Therefore, we have added new tall buildings to serve as cover.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/bbbbc8d84c0fa3434d3c9d4f0f2eb4aae3c5c6d8.png[/img]
　
　Adjustment ②: Added cover around Relay Points E and F
　　⇒　Relay points E and F were both located in open areas without any cover, 
　　　　making it particularly difficult to secure them during high-cost battles.
　　　　Therefore, we have added new structures to serve as cover.
　◎Relay point E
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/61349aaeb453a16a395407f48dee870f40306d10.png[/img]
　
　◎Relay point F
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/0d25dea0b75cb16f86417a6d85f4dacfcd270777.png[/img]
　
　
　Military Port
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/fd8b73e6fa0587fa8a69c25f9d7865faef1ff854.png[/img]
　
　Adjustment ①: New route added for advancing toward the base
　　⇒　Until now, advancing toward the base required either making a large detour along the outer edge of the map 
　　　　to use a slope, or jumping over the ledge in front of the base, which made it difficult to launch an attack.
　　　　To address this, we have added a slope in front of the base.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/768f8a7726c51dfe195a49cb5b9722fe90338e95.png[/img]
　
　Adjustment ②: Water transparency adjusted for ground-level perspective
　　⇒　With the addition of the slope making it easier to advance toward the base, we have increased 
　　　　the water’s surface transparency when viewed from the ground to make it easier to see underwater activity, 
　　　　in order to prevent the defending side from being put at too much of a disadvantage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/ad1743084c2d48060cd44e149734a38f0eea5c5f.png[/img]
　
　Adjustment③: Adjusted water depth
　　⇒　This map features significant elevation differences between the ground and underwater areas,
　　　　making it difficult to attack in either direction due to firing angle limitations.
　　　　To address this, we have raised the overall depth of the underwater areas.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/95458da6d1961dfc7606ffdf3fbc6b675e6b596e.png[/img]
　
　City Ruins
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/c0624a39eba8754a6aa72da54f86bbe75524e1be.png[/img]
　
　Adjustment ①: Added a new route that allows traversal through the dome
　　⇒　The dome located at the center of the map had limited entry routes, which often led to a stalemate in battles.
　　　　To address this, we have added new entry routes into the dome.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/01222a721b2a75c9837a8d4cbd6df9cb7cc5bd10.png[/img]
　
　Adjustment ②: Relocated the Type 61 tank
　　⇒　The Type 61 tanks positioned near relay points C and D were obstructing movement during mobile suit combat,
　　　　so we have adjusted their placement.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/dd2670dced8c73982ff1275f297dbe0c536c1ea7.png[/img]
　
　
　Ravine
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/b314b632038336daa86c72a5e6c8f4c513c5f7fc.png[/img]
　
　Adjustment ①: Modified the shape of the central high ground
　　⇒　This map tended to result in a stalemate due to long-range firefights in the central area, 
　　　　so we have modified the shape of the central high ground to allow players to advance while taking cover.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/eb9d1cef1df626588a1c25b2ad89f9e8fe3f39f0.png[/img]
　
　Adjustment ②: Added a new route from the central area into the waterways
　　⇒　We have created an opening in the cliff that separates the central area and the waterways,
　　　　adding a new route to relay points A and B.
　　　　Additionally, since there was previously only one exit from the waterways, 
　　　　we have added a branch to create a second exit.
　◎Modified the shape of the cliff
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/3a23e5f39ec4f903f557e0f19e4d5e035460c3cc.png[/img]
　
　◎Added a branch to the waterway
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/f557d024bcb266b764954fd80c9a323b9112e6e5.png[/img]
　
　⇒　In addition, various minor adjustments to terrain shapes have been made throughout the map.
　
　
■Others

　　　　　and pressing the confirm button.

　　　for an extended period.
　　・In “Resort Development District”, we’ve fixed an issue where tank-type MS would get unnaturally stuck 
　　　on the rooftops of buildings near the base.
　　・In “Colony Drop Area”, we’ve fixed an area where mobile suits (MS) were unable to land 
　　　and would continuously fall for an extended period.
　
　◎Units
　　・In “ReZEL”, we’ve fixed an issue where the sound effect would sometimes not being played when using
　　　the ranged main weapon “ReZEL Beam Rifle”.
　　・In “Heavygun”, we’ve corrected the unit description when the language is set to English.
　　・In “Engage Zero Yonfavin”, we’ve corrected the spelling of weapon names when the language is set to English.
　
　◎Skills
　　・For the skill “Max Performance”, we’ve fixed an issue where performing certain actions would incorrectly increase
　　　the activation count from pilot kills.
　　・For the skills “Close Combat Program” and “Overfeed”, we’ve fixed an issue where, 
　　　under certain conditions of damage reactions from attacks 
　　　by opponents using the “High Speed Mobile Shooting” skill were not being properly reduced.
　　・For the skill “Close Combat Program”, we’ve added text to the description regarding the shield-equipped weapons.
　　　■After the change
　　　　If a melee weapon is equipped when hit by a ranged attack, mobility is increased while the stagger is reduced.
　　　　However, when a shield weapon is selected, the skill will not activate.
　
　◎Battles
　　・Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions of no damage reaction would occur when taking attacks 
　　　during high-speed movement in midair.
　　・In beam shield-type weapons, fixed an issue where performing an attack at the moment the weapon overheats
　　　would result in no hit detection occurring, despite the attack animation occuring.
　
　◎Weapons
　　・In beam shield-type weapons, we’ve fixed unclear wording in the weapon description.
　　　This fix does not affect the performance of the weapon.
　　　■Before
　　　　If the shield is fired on while activated, damage taken is reduced.
　　　■Now
　　　　If the shield is fired on while activated, damage dealt to Shield HP is reduced.
　
　◎Hangars
　　・In the Hangar, we’ve fixed an issue where the cursor would sometimes appear in an unnatural position 
　　　when displaying the MS list from various facilities.
　
　◎Others
　　・In the H.A.R.O. menu, when first accessing the ‘MS > Favorite MS/Badges’ screen, 
　　　we’ve added a guide for the target value regarding COST 750, which was previously missing.
　
　
The latest information will be posted on STEAM News and our X (Twitter) in the future.
https://x.com/pc_gbo2
　
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

　　during humanity's migration to space colonies.

　　It completed an MS that placed an intense amount of stress on the pilot during acceleration,
　　but never became a standard-issue unit. Instead, the company moved on
　　to develop mass-production units by cutting its excessive performance mechanisms
　・To counter this, engineers at OZ secretly started researching a method of forcibly enhancing a pilot's
　　combat capabilities by directly transmitting actions necessary for victory to the brain, resulting in the

　　the engineers abandoned the unit and fled the company.
　　Once rebuilt, this MS would make an appearance in A.C. 195, which was a time of great turmoil.

■[2nd Anniversary Celebration: ①] Wing Gundam Zero is now in!
Wing Gundam Zero from "New Mobile Report Gundam Wing" is now joining the Steam® GBO2!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/edc49217d83a230c01b8f5ba0a83ee2c26779441.png[/img]
　Introducing the Wing Gundam Zero, which will appear as a ★★★★ unit in GBO2!
　　・★★★★ Wing Gundam Zero LV1 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)
　
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　　・From "New Mobile Report Gundam Wing"　/ For ground/space MAP
　　　・General unit with cost of 700.
　　・A unit developed based on the first combat MS of the After Colony (A.C.) era, 
　　　during humanity's migration to space colonies.
　　・OZ was originally a thriving construction company thanks to the colony development boom, 
　　　but would later venture into the defense industry.
　　　It completed an MS that placed an intense amount of stress on the pilot during acceleration,
　　　but never became a standard-issue unit. Instead, the company moved on
　　　to develop mass-production units by cutting its excessive performance mechanisms
　　・To counter this, engineers at OZ secretly started researching a method of forcibly enhancing a pilot's
　　　combat capabilities by directly transmitting actions necessary for victory to the brain, resulting in the
　　　completion of the ZERO System to boost pilot performance. Along with this, they would upgrade
　　　materials, equipment, and structure. For armor, they would use a new material known as Gundanium alloy,
　　　offering remarkable bulletproofing and viscosity, and enabling the unit to transform into a
　　　high-speed Neo-Bird form. They would also successfully develop the Twin Buster Rifle, 
　　　capable of annihilating an entire colony with a single shot.
　　・However, fearing this technology would be exploited by OZ, 
　　　the engineers abandoned the unit and fled the company.
　　　Once rebuilt, this MS would make an appearance in A.C. 195, which was a time of great turmoil.

　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・A variant of the GM III, the main MS of the Federation Forces after the Gryps Conflict, 
　　　enhanced and modified for veteran pilots.
　　　To improve its close-quarters combat capabilities, the upper body has been heavily reinforced,
　　　giving it a powerful appearance and earning it the name “Powered”.
　　・Specialized for melee combat, its arsenal is limited to essential weapons such as the Beam Rifle, 
　　　Beam Saber, and GM Rifle.
　　　However, its clear purpose and role make it easy to handle, allowing for reliable battlefield performance.
　　・Additionally, the synergy with the skill “Interrupt Tackle”, which cancels post-melee attack stiffness with a tackle,
　　　enables this unit to fully demonstrate its potential in close-range combat.
　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.

■Notice of Supply Drop Lineup "F91"
Supply Drop Lineup has been updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/6c2a40223351ea07041dfcad88beabe8c07c51b3.jpg[/img]
　
　■Period
　　　　[PDT] 05/15/2025 01:00 – 05/21/2025 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　　　[CEST] 05/15/2025 10:00 – 05/22/2025 06:30 [Scheduled]
　
　■Added New Materials
　　■Unit
　　・★★★★★ F91 LV1 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost: 750)
　　　※The above MS is eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
　
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・General unit with cost of 750.
　　・This compact MS was created by the Strategic Naval Research Institute (S.N.R.I.) under its initiative to increase
　　　the role of compact mobile suits and realize the full potential of current technology.
　　・Based on concerns that the increased size of 5th-generation MS would lead to higher costs due to the impossibility
　　　of repurposing existing components, S.N.R.I. devised the Formula Plan to downsize mobile suits.
　　　The preceding F90 series had multi-functional armor(MCA) and newly-developed thermonuclear reactors,
　　　greatly improving the thrust-to-weight ratio.
　　　This extra output was used to power a Variable Speed Beam Rifle (V.S.B.R.) with the ability 
　　　to adjust rate of fire and firepower, as well as a beam shield.
　　・This MS uses data obtained from the F90 to realize the full potential of current technology by improving
　　　the maximum output.
　　　Limiters have been imposed due to its extraordinary capabilities, but it comes equipped with a biocomputer 
　　　that activates the suit’s full potential only when the pilot is deemed capable of handling it.
　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
https://bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2025/03/2f89d4603eee7677c76542d484a78153.mp4
　
　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　　　※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
　
　Skill “Max Performance”
　・This skill can be activated by pressing the "special weapon" after a destroying a certain number of enemy MS or
　　destruction assists.
　　・All the parts HP (head, back, and legs) of the MS will be fully recovered.
　　・Increases the unit attack power and mobility.
　　・Thrusters consumption at the start of and during high-speed movement is also reduced.
　　・Delays the movement of your MS’s marker on enemy radar
　　After the skill effect ends, it can be used again after a certain cooldown period.
https://bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2025/03/5889068ff1c80961779a8974b734ff12.mp4
　
　Skill “Mobile Melee Program”
　・Activates while moving forward at high speed for a certain time with target weapon selected.
　　Melee attacks switch to special melee while activated.
　　However, during melee attacks activated by this skill, thruster recovery will not occur.
　　※For the F91, the corresponding weapon for this skill is the sub-weapon “F91 Beam Saber x2”.
　
　Sub-weapon “F91 Beam shield”
　・When selecting this weapon, your MS will activate a beam shield that can attack or defend.
　　While selected, shield attacks become possible, allowing you to deflect melee attacks from the front, 
　　except for projectile-based melee attacks, tackles, and heavy attacks from enemy MSs, 
　　causing them to be knocked down.
　　Additionally, it will deal damage if hitting an enemy MS.
　　However, shield attacks cannot be performed in combo attacks.
　・The Beam Shield differs from a physical shield in the following ways:
　　▼Beam Shield
　　・The shield will only be available while the weapon is selected.
　　・When blocking ranged attacks, damage to MS HP is reduced.
　　・It has a limited usage time and will overheat if exceeded.
　　・If the shield’s HP reaches zero, it will forcefully overheat.
　　・Once the overheat recovers, it can be used again with full shield HP restored.
　　・Deploying the shield does not negatively affect mobility.
　　▼Physical Shield
　　・Always has a shield hitbox.
　　・If the shield is selectable, damage taken by the shield is reduced while selected.
　　・When the shield’s HP reaches zero, it is destroyed and loses its defensive effects.
　　・While the shield is intact, mobility is slightly hindered, but this restriction will be lifted when the shield is destroyed.

we’re holding event "2nd Anniversary Pre-Celebration"!!

　■Period

　　・STEP3 (30 Tokens): 50 ★★★★★ Modification Kit for bonus!
　　・STEP4 (30 Tokens): ALL Drops will be MS!
　　・STEP5 (30 Tokens): 100 ★★★★★ Mechanic Tickets for bonus!
　　・STEP6 (30 Tokens): 100 ★★★★★ Modification Kit for bonus!

　　・STEP9 (30 Tokens): 2 ★★ MS & 1 ★★★ MS guaranteed!!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ 300 ★★★★★ Modification Kit for bonus!

　　・STEP2 (30 tokens): 1 guaranteed random MS from 4 more carefully-selected powerful MS!
　　・STEP3 (30 tokens): 1 guaranteed random MS from 4 even more carefully-selected powerful MS!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　And also guarantee you the new MS “F90 LV1”!

　　・Boosts mobility and attack power.

　　・Shortens the lock-on time of psycommu armament, and automatically reloads
　　　all Psycommu Equipment (excluding defensive-type) when it’s used to destroy an enemy.
　　・Nullifies all reactions except for stagger due to cumulative damage, but only at the point of skill activation.
　
　Sub-Weapon “Psycho Plates [Defend]”
　・After using the weapon, it deploys a psycho plates which blocks melee and ranged attacks.
　　The remaining ammunition is expended every time Psycho plate takes more than a certain amount of damage
　　from melee or ranged attacks.
　　The deployment of the psycho plate will be canceled

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/026f3af84a744c9fe42dd090b95cd891285b60e0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/da95426fbb2789880757254922135c4624906db3.png[/img]

　① Unlock the slot by “MS expansion”!
　　・By applying “MS Expansion” on any MS, you can unlock an “Expansion Slot” in which to grant expansion skills.
　　　⇒　You need MS expansion coin and DP for MS expansion.
　　　⇒　You can get MS expansion coin from daily mission and monthly mission since May 2025.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/30bbd55d42d35b5deef0e2e8aa1af21b2eaa2f9a.png[/img]
　
　② Develop expansion skills by “Skill Development”!
　　・After unlocking the Expansion slot, the selected MS will now be able to develop a skill.
　　　⇒　Choose the mechanic and start developing, 1 random “expansion skill” will be found.
　　　　　Furthermore, 2 skills will be found if you get a “great success”.
　　　⇒　You will need MS expansion coin and DP for skill developing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/52c9abf59695900476b9c5e4fa7c0d08fd094afb.png[/img]
　
　◎Mechanic list
　　【General mechanic】
　　　The cheapest option here but have the lowest chance to develop a high LV skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/d188117d60d6f47b59e2deaa60350068cb5865cf.png[/img]
　
　　【Veteran mechanic】
　　　Development cost became higher but can develop to at least LV2 skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/f06fa594a7501d487754cb7ce704b1ab00900d28.png[/img]
　
　　【Leona Lucraft】
　　　The most expensive one and you can develop to at least LV3 skill and also higher chance to obtain high LV skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/df7d5b4325b1200e57dfbf4443b441eb18490891.png[/img]
　
　
　※You can develop skills for one MS as you like, 
　　but you can only request skill development from each mechanic once per day.
　
　◎Expansion skills
　　・You can get random expansion skill with random LV from below.
　
　　▼【Offensive expansion skills】
　　　Ranged Strength Expansion LV1–5
　　　Boost ranged strength and maximum ranged strength.
　
　　　Melee Strength Expansion LV1–5
　　　Boost melee strength and maximum melee strength.
　
　　▼【Defensive expansion skills】
　　　Ballistic Resistance Expansion LV1–5
　　　Boost ballistic resistance and maximum ballistic resistance.
　
　　　Beam Resistance Expansion LV1–5
　　　Boost beam resistance and maximum beam resistance.
　
　　　Melee Resistance Expansion LV1–5
　　　Boost melee resistance and maximum melee resistance.
　
　　▼【Mobility expansion skills】
　　　Thruster Expansion LV1–5
　　　Boost thruster and maximum thruster.
　
　　▼【Custom parts expansion skills】
　　　Custom Part Expansion [HP] LV1–5
　　　Unit HP increases for each “Attack” type custom part equipped.
　
　　　Custom Part Expansion [Attack] LV1–5
　　　Unit melee strength and ranged strength increase for each “Move” type custom part equipped.
　
　　　Custom Part Expansion [Armor] LV1–5
　　　Unit ballistic resistance, beam resistance and melee resistance increase 
　　　for each “Auxiliary” type custom part equipped.
　
　　　Custom Part Expansion [Thruster] LV1–5
　　　Thrusters increases for each “Special” type custom part equipped.
　
　③ Set your developed skill
　　・You can set ONE developed skill to your expansion skill slot.
　　　⇒　Setting another expansion skill to the slot will overwrite the skill in the slot only.
　　　　　Of course, you can stop setting skill and just leave the recent one in the slot.
　
　④ Improve the performance of the expansion skills you set with “Skill Enhancement”!
　　・Skill enhancement can upgrade the skill LV directly.
　　　⇒　You need Expansion skill enhancement ticket to upgrade your skills.
　　　⇒　Expansion skills LV is up to “5”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/f93f54cc15a721c21fedb0be5d790dfdd3f79e85.png[/img]
　
　“Expansion skill enhancement ticket” will be on sale from [PDT] 04/03//2025 01:00 / [CEST] 04/03/2025 10:00.
　You can purchase it through H.A.R.O. ➝ Store directly.
　■Price
　　1 Expansion skill enhancement ticket　/　2.99 USD
　　11 Expansion skill enhancement ticket　/　26.99 USD
　
　◎Request bonus
　　・Every time you develop skills will be counted the request count by each mechanic.
　　　Stacking up the request count will grant you benefit such as discount on “MS expansion coin” or “DP”,
　　　or a higher chance of “great success”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/5bac16ecb68776f150db113a1626e9822306361f.png[/img]
　
　
　■Hangar related
　　◎Some DP requirement of enhancement in the hangar is now adjusted.
　　　⇒　Since DP is an essential item for the Expansion facility,
　　　　　all DP requirement in the Hangar for MS enhancement is now 50% off for all MS.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/d1557723437c5138ddeda26a68f38637df8846a7.png[/img]
　
　
■Unit related
　◎New unit cost range 750 is now unlocked.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/0bbbca6e9682aaefa37a1c9dfdf05b9c666b9c07.png[/img]
　
　
■New Materials for exchange are added to DP exchange Counter.
　⇒ Information about newly added materials
　■Units
　　・★★GM Command LA LV1 added
　　・★★GM [Gatheroad] LV1 added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/f7f67cbcc53750e9c04f43cf788721d5c6a0fa6d.png[/img]
　
　
■Rating Match/Quick Match Game Modes are updated.
　※There may be differences about the game mode with the information above,
　　which were introduced during the previous update regarding [Possible Game Modes].
　
　
■Situation Battle is now updated.
　⇒　The topic of the week is “At the Site of the Fallen Colony”.
　※For more details about this week’s Situation Battle, please click here.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/546731472820633926
　
■Schedule for this week's weekend-only battle
　◎Weekend-only battle schedule
　　・[PDT] 04/03/2025 12:00 – 04/06/2025 11:59
　　・[CEST] 04/03/2025 21:00 – 04/06/2025 20:59
　◎Special Rules
　　・"Mix-up", "Simple Battle", "Shuffle Target", "Brawl Match" and "Duel Match" will be held in every 2 hours.
　　・Situation Battle “At the Site of the Fallen Colony” will be held.
　
　
■Next Clan Match Schedule
Please refer, here for the next Clan Match schedule and reward collection period.
For an overview of the Clan Match, please refer here.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/3696937262747690435
　
　
■Fixes
　◎Units
　　・In rare cases, when the “Unicorn Gundam [Awakened]” was attacked while using the sub-weapon
　　　“Shield Funnels x3 [Defense]”, “Shield Funnels x3 [Defense]” would immediately overheat and now is fixed.
　　・In Moon Gundam, Psycho Plate would emit an unnatural glow when hit by an enemy counter attack
　　　under certain circumstances and now is fixed.
　　・In Moon Gundam and Varguil, the effects and sound effects during emergency evasion were not
　　　occurring correctly and now is fixed.
　　・In Moon Gundam and Psycho Bawoo, the Psycho Plate would not be emitting when respawning 
　　　in certain situations and now is fixed.
　　・In Gundam Mk-II [Magallanica Issued], a typo is found in the MS description and now is corrected.
　　・In Nightingale, the funnel effect would continue to remain if the unit was destroyed 
　　　while using the sub-weapon “Funnel x4 [Stationary]” and now is fixed.
　　・In GF-Tank, the weapon icon for the melee main weapon “MC [Pile Hammer]” was similar to other weapons,
　　　so it has been revised to make it easier to identify.
　　・During the activation of sub-weapon “Psycho-Jammer” of “Rozen Zulu”, 
　　　“Burning Gundam” in Hyper Mode within range was unable to activate ”Meikyo Shisui”, which is now fixed.
　
　◎Skills
　　・Some of the text for the skill “Awaken Ability Boost (B)” was misleading, which has been revised.
　　　※This fix does not affect skill performance.
　　　■Before
　　　　Also, when damaging enemy units with melee or counter attacks, 
　　　　additional damage is dealt according to the HP of remaining enemy units.
　　　■Now
　　　　Also, when damaging enemy units with melee or counter attacks, 
　　　　damage is dealt according to the HP of remaining enemy units.
　　・When using the skill “Large Utility Binder” and receive an attack with no damage reaction, the “RESIST” message
　　　would appear even if there was no damage reaction to mitigate the damage which is now fixed.
　　・The skill “Anti-Air Ranged Aux. Program” was not working on MS that had the skill “NT-D Ability Boost” activated,
　　　which is now fixed.
　　・The damage reaction reduction effect of the skill “Fall Prevention System” was not being applied while performing
　　　an aerial melee attack with the skill “Aerial Melee System”, which is now fixed.
　　・In the skill “High Speed ​​Mobile Shooting”, the “English” description did not state that
　　　it “disables the reaction reduction effect of the skill “Maneuver Armor” and now is corrected.
　　・When using the “Transform” skill to perform certain operations while transforming caused unnatural dust effect
　　　and now is fixed.
　　・Regarding skill “Meikyo Shisui” of “Burning Gundam”, when using the melee-type shooting weapon 
　　　“Sekiha Tenkyoken, there was an issue where the effect that partially invalidates the opponent's 
　　　“melee resistance” (which activates when using a melee weapon) did not trigger, which is now fixed.
　
　◎Battles
　　・For some ranged weapons that require to stop in place when attacking, an issue was occurring 
　　　where it was possible to attack in the air by performing certain operations, which is now fixed.
　
　◎Others
　　・An issue was occurring at Hangar where the number of recycle tickets not being used at the facility 
　　　was being displayed and now is fixed.
　
　
The latest information will be posted on STEAM News and our X (Twitter) in the future.
https://x.com/pc_gbo2
　
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

notes.title: Application Data Update and Server Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
　
Server maintenance will be performed on the following schedule.
　
◇Date & Time
[PST] 03/05/2025 21:00 – 03/06/2025 01:00 [Scheduled]
[CET] 03/06/2025 06:00 – 03/06/2025 10:00 [Scheduled]
　
◇Maintenance Details
・Application Data Update
・Supply Drop Lineup Update
　
　※Please note that you will not be able to log in to the game during the maintenance.
　※The end time may vary depending on the maintenance status. Please understand this in advance.
　※Entering the maintenance during matching may cause unexpected errors.
　　Please log out of the game before maintenance.
　
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

　　・STEP2 (30 Tokens): 50 ★★★★★ Mechanic tickets for bonus!
　　・STEP3 (30 Tokens): 50 ★★★★★ Modification kits for bonus!
　　・STEP4 (30 Tokens): ALL Drops will be MS! + Accessory “Backpack: Unicorn Gundam [Awaken]” for bonus!!!
　　・STEP5 (30 Tokens): 100 ★★★★★ Mechanic tickets for bonus!
　　・STEP6 (30 Tokens): 100 ★★★★★ Modification kits for bonus!
　　・STEP7 (30 Tokens): 1 “Unicorn Gundam [Awakened] LV1” guaranteed!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ Custom part “Melee ATK-DEF Program LV1” guaranteed!!
　　・STEP8 (30 Tokens): 1 ★★ MS & 1 ★★★ MS guaranteed! + 300 ★★★★★ Mechanic tickets for bonus!!
　　・STEP9 (30 Tokens): 2 ★★ MS & 1 ★★★ MS guaranteed! + 300 ★★★★★ Modification kits for bonus!
　　・STEP10 (30 Tokens): Another “Unicorn Gundam [Awakened] LV1” guaranteed!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ 1 ★★★★ MS guaranteed! + Accessory “Mask: Unicorn Gundam [Awaken]” for bonus!!!
　
　■Custom part
　◎Melee ATK-DEF Program LV1
　・Increase melee boost by 5.
　　Reduce melee attack damage taken by 10％.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/aa579b09dbf67446935bfad7c2f175d4e3184020.png[/img]
　
　※Same supplies will be drawn as the ongoing Supply Drops.
　　　For Details, please check [Item List].
　
　
■Notice of Supply Drop Lineup “Unicorn Gundam [Awakened]”
Supply Drop Lineup has been updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/9529951b1e52dd57f7ba590fe55a8d286a7f97ae.jpg[/img]
　
　■Period
　　[PST] 03/06/2025 01:00 – 03/12/2025 20:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CET] 03/06/2025 10:00 – 03/13/2025 05:30 [Scheduled]
　
　■Added New Materials
　　■Unit
　　・★★★★★ Unicorn Gundam [Awakened] LV1 (Raid unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)
　　　※The above MS is eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
　
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・Raid unit with cost of 700.
　　・FA Unicorn Gundam in its full battle configuration with all its weapons runs out.
　　・The Unicorn Gundam’s pilot, Banagher Links, overcame numerous hardships and grew as a result,
　　　and in response to his strong wishes, the Psycho-frame system emits from red to green.
　　・Remotely controlling a simple shield like a funnel, forming a special force field, 
　　　and piercing Neo Zeong’s armor with a blow, such events could be regarded as miracles, 
　　　for it is not mechanically possible, as well as pointing to the superhuman abilities of Newtype pilots.
　　・Unicorn Gundam [Awakened] is equipped with shield funnels, 
　　　which is a combined offensive and defensive weapon, as well as a beam magnum and head vulcan.
　　　In addition, this unit has an all-time effect of nullifying the “psycommu jack” effect, 
　　　which was originally denying the access to psycommu weapons.
　　　And the skill “Awaken Ability Boost (B)” not only improves the performance of the unit itself,
　　　but also allows the recovery of units in your army when the skill is activated, 
　　　making it a unit with the “potential” to turn the tide of battle even in critical situations.
　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
https://bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2024/12/3634301336faa3d2297aede170069c79.mp4
　
　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　　　※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
　
　Skill “Awaken Ability Boost (B)”
　・Activates automatically once only when HP goes under a certain value with following effects.
　・Boosting unit spec.
　・Reduced thruster consumption when starting and during the high-speed movement.
　・Extending the lock-on time of enemies’ psycommu weapons.
　・When damage is dealt to an enemy MS with a melee attack or counter attack, 
　　additional damage is dealt depending on the remaining HP of the enemy MS
　　In addition, the HP of allies within a certain range immediately after the skill is activated will be recovered by
　　a certain amount, and the HP of each part (head, rear, legs) is fully recovered.
　　The amount of recovery increases the lower the remaining HP of the target is.
　
　Skill “Shield Funnel Special Def System”
　・When an equipped shield funnel is attacked, damage taken will be reduced.
　　If hit by a ranged beam attack, damage and reaction are further reduced.
　
　Skill “Shield Funnels x2 [Sensor]”
　・Deploy 2 shield funnels when using the weapon.
　　Deployed shield funnels will follow the unit for a certain period of time 
　　and automatically attack enemy MS within range.
　　If the MS is downed, the deployment will be canceled and the weapon will be forced into overheat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/9d76e058234717d42548ed7902e28e8afd923308.png[/img]
　
　■Exclusive pilot item as a Bonus for the 10 Consecutive Supply Drops!
　　Beginning from [PST] 03/06/2025 01:00 / [CET] 03/06/2025 10:00,
　　1 random exclusive pilot item as a bonus can be obtained from 10 consecutive drops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/52b3156bfacd776f6528ad5451c50bd860525f8d.png[/img]
　
　　■Period
　　　[PST] 03/06/2025 01:00 – 03/12/2025 20:30 [Scheduled]
　　　[CET] 03/06/2025 10:00 – 03/13/2025 05:30 [Scheduled]
　
　　■Supply Drop with Bonus Items

　　■Bonus Item Contents (get 1 of the 2 items randomly listed below)

　　　■Accessory
　　　　Helmet: Vist Foundation 01

　　　　and get 1 extra item.
　　　※Single Supply Drop is NOT applied with this benefit.
　　　　The bonus item will not be awarded even if you request the 1-Attempt Supply Drop ten times in a row.
　
　■Other materials
　　■Units
　　・★ GM II LV4 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost: 450)
　　・★ High Mobility Zaku LV4 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost: 450)
　　・★ High Mobility Zaku Ground Type LV4 (General unit, ground only, cost: 450)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/d7a76c58d087d74a0f719283f9ebfc32ef7a9ed9.png[/img]
　
　■Removed Materials from the Supply Drop
　　Some materials are removed from the supply drop lineup.
　　　※For more information regarding the updated supply drop lineup, please refer to the [Supply Drop List].
　
　■Notice of [Big Boost to Supply Drop Rates Campaign]
　　Some of the newly added materials will have a boost to their supply drop rates for a limited time.
　　■Period
　　　[PST] 03/06/2025 01:00 – 03/12/2025 20:30 [Scheduled]
　　　[CET] 03/06/2025 10:00 – 03/13/2025 05:30 [Scheduled]
　　■Featured material that will benefit from the Big Boost to its Supply Rate
　　・★★★★★ Unicorn Gundam [Awakened] LV1 (Raid unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)
　　■Supply Drops that will benefit from Big Boost to Supply Rates
　　　・Normal Supply Drop
　　　　※After the end of the campaign, all supply drop rates will be the same as other materials.
　
　■Time Limited Special Hangar unlocking campaign
　　Starting from [PST] 03/06/2025 / [CET] 03/06/2025, Time Limited Special Hangar unlocking campaign will begin.
　
　　■Period
　　　[PST] 03/06/2025 01:00 – 04/12/2025 11:59 [Scheduled]
　　　[CET] 03/06/2025 10:00 – 04/12/2025 20:59 [Scheduled]
　
　　■Content
　　　During the period, pilot who obtain a new ★★★★★ MS from Supply Drop will unlock 
　　　a time limited hangar slot for MS enhancement.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/2a49c1ba389daf1360e4a0b3db83da80a538035e.png[/img]
　
　※Hangar slot can only be used during the campaign.
　　(If the campaign ended while the slot used for MS enhancement, 
　　then the slot will be no longer available after the enhancement is finished.)
　
　
■Overview of “GBO DAYS”
We have different events for all pilots [JST] every first Thursday through the first Sunday
as our big campaign "GBO Days"!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/026f3af84a744c9fe42dd090b95cd891285b60e0.png[/img]
　■What is GBO Days?
　　GBO Days is a special monthly campaign that will start at the first Thursday of every month at [JST] 17:00 
　　until the next Monday [JST] 04:59 [scheduled].
　　Pilots who always play GBO2 will receive a lot of benefits, furthermore, 
　　new and returning pilots will be even benefited from some of the content during the campaign!
　■GBO Days March Schedule
　　[PST] 03/06/2025 01:00 – 03/09/2025 11:59 [Scheduled]
　　[CET] 03/06/2025 10:00 – 03/09/2025 20:59 [Scheduled]
　■Campaign Details
　　During the period,
　　①Free "Guaranteed Mobile Suit Supply Drops" that can be requested once a day! (Up to 4 Units!)
　　②"Special Supply Drop" with 2 guaranteed ★★★ or above rarity MS can be requested once! (10 Times/30 Tokens)
　　③Basic rewards (EXP, DP, CP) after battle will be doubled! 
　　　If you are a new or returning pilot, it will be increased to 5 times!
　　④New & returning pilots always have a 100% container discovery rate of the recon team!
　　　Also, veteran pilots of GBO2 who sortie with, new & returning pilots,
　　　their observation unit's container discovery rate will be increased by 30%!
　※New pilots must start up GBO2 for the first time and click "GAME START" on the title screen  within 14 days.
　※Returning pilots are those who have not logged in for at least 45 days since the last logged out of GBO2.
　※Please note that basic rewards will not be increased if pilot has started a game session after the campaign period.
　※The number of containers that can be found will be only two per day.
　※If you have been awarded with Premium War Merit badge, 
　　the number of containers you can find per day will be increased.
　※Date will be updated daily at 5:00 AM [JST].
　※If Penalty status is [PENALTY LV1] or above, you will not able to get any container.
　
　
■New Materials for exchange are added to DP exchange Counter.
　⇒ Information about newly added materials
　■Units
　・★★★ Gundam GP01 [Aqua] LV1 added
　・★★★ Dijeh (CA) LV2 added
　・★★ Advanced Hazel LV2 added
　・★★ Jesta [Shezarr Type Team B] LV2 added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/487a2dd4775f61f35d72df7239b7fe712cdb848a.png[/img]
　

■Rating Match/Quick Match Game Modes are updated.
　※There may be differences about the game mode with the information above,
　　which were introduced during the previous update regarding [Possible Game Modes].
　

■Situation Battle is now updated.
　⇒　The topic of the week is “The Final Battle, A Baoa Qu”.
　※For more details about this week’s Situation Battle, please click here.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/546728939295342710
　

■Schedule for this week's weekend-only battle
　◎Weekend-only battle schedule
　　・[PST] 03/06/2025 11:00 – 03/09/2025 10:59
　　・[CET] 03/06/2025 20:00 – 03/09/2025 19:59
　◎Special Rules
　　・"Mix-up", "Simple Battle", "Shuffle Target", "Brawl Match" and "Duel Match" will be held in every 2 hours.
　　・Situation Battle “The Final Battle, A Baoa Qu” will be held.
　
　
■Next Clan Match Schedule
Please refer, here for the next Clan Match schedule and reward collection period.
For an overview of the Clan Match, please refer here.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/3696937262747690435
　
　
■Update for Clan Match reward MS!
　New reward MS for Clan Match is available from [JST] 03/09/2025.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/9609296c979ad4b45fab3ea7f251b5128b440d08.jpg[/img]
　
　■New MS
　　・★★　GM Shooter (Support unit, ground/space uses, cost: 500)
　
　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・Support unit with cost of 500.
　　・A unit reused the GM Sniper II for ultra-long-range support MS.
　　・Due to the improvements made to sub-flight systems (SFS) after the One Year War,
　　　MSs now become more capable of performing aerial attacks.
　　　For this reason, even in the late 0090s, 
　　　MS without variable mechanisms and bases with poor defense facilities still required sniper units 
　　　and other MS that could provide medium- and long-range support from the perspective of air defense.
　　・Although this unit is based on the outdated GM Sniper II, 
　　　operation was streamlined for use with a high-output long-range beam rifle.
　　　By integrating and downsizing its cooling system and energy packs to fit within its backpack,
　　　it was able to provide sustained, ultra-long-range fire as a standalone MS.
　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
　
　※Since the lineup has been updated, “Condition of claiming Clan Match reward MS” has been reset as well.
　
The latest information will be posted on STEAM News and our X (Twitter) in the future.
https://x.com/pc_gbo2
　
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

[PST] 02/26/2025 21:00 – 02/27/2025 00:00 [Scheduled]
[CET] 02/27/2025 06:00 – 02/27/2025 09:00 [Scheduled]

・Application Data Update
・Supply Drop Lineup Update

We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

　　　it can be expected to improve self-defense and continuity of battle capabilities.
　　　Although it is equipped with a small number of weapons, 
　　　it is an easy-to-manage MS with a simple and clear operational method and role.
　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
　
　　■Custom Part

　※Same supplies will be drawn as the ongoing Supply Drops.
　　　For Details, please check [Item List].
　※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
　
　
■Notice of Supply Drop Lineup “Silver Bullet [Funnel Test Type]”
Supply Drop Lineup has been updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/e9d6cac874788f37bac17e871419fba2900242c0.jpg[/img]
　
　■Period
　　[PST] 02/06/2025 00:00 – 02/12/2025 20:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CET] 02/06/2025 09:00 – 02/13/2025 05:30 [Scheduled]
　■Added New Materials
　　■Unit
　　・★★★ Silver Bullet [Funnel Test Type] LV1 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost: 600)
　　　※The above MS is eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
　
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・General unit with cost of 600.
　　・This prototype variant of the Silver Bullet was developed by Anaheim Electronics and based on the Döven Wolf,
　　　which was seized by Federation forces.
　　・Since research for the Silver Bullet primarily focused on the Neo Zeon-developed quasi-Psycommu system,
　　　some of the Döven Wolf’s signature high-powered internal weaponry was omitted.
　　　This greatly reduced the unit’s weight and streamlined transfer of energy supply throughout its various thrusters,
　　　improving overall performance.
　　　So development of this unit would progress primarily for technological research purposes,
　　　while also keeping actual combat capability in mind.
　　・This MS was also used as a testbed for a large funnel under Federation development during the same period.
　　　A large wired funnel with its own built-in generator was mounted to its back,
　　　contributing significantly to development of subsequent Psycommu-equipped units.
　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
https://bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2024/11/18b886ce4b094951a27f369f4a1e4895.mp4
　
　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　　　※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
　
■About counter action in Silver Bullet [Funnel Test Type]
　Since this MS will grab the enemy with its right arm when the counter is engaged,
　the action of the counter will change as follows depending on the use of the sub-weapon “Wired Hand [Saber R]”.
　・When “Wired Hand [Saber R]” is ready to use,
　　⇒　Applying a normal counter attack.
　・When “Wired Hand [Saber R]” is already in use,

　　　※Requesting 10-Consecutive Supply Drops during the campaign will grant you an additional 11th supply drop,

　　　※Single Supply Drop is NOT applied with this benefit.
　　　　The bonus item will not be awarded even if you request the 1-Attempt Supply Drop ten times in a row.
　
　■Other materials

　　・★ Zaku II FZ (Fritz Helmet) LV4 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost: 450)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/2517c02b58af569be648729da151911acd42ec0c.png[/img]
　
　■Notice of [Big Boost to Supply Drop Rates Campaign]
　　Some of the newly added materials will have a boost to their supply drop rates for a limited time.
　　■Period
　　　[PST] 02/06/2025 00:00 – 02/12/2025 20:30 [Scheduled]
　　　[CET] 02/06/2025 09:00 – 02/13/2025 05:30 [Scheduled]

　　■Supply Drops that will benefit from Big Boost to Supply Rates
　　　・Normal Supply Drop
　　　　※After the end of the campaign, all supply drop rates will be the same as other materials.
　
　
■Overview of “GBO DAYS”
We have different events for all pilots [JST] every first Thursday through the first Sunday as our big campaign "GBO Days"!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/026f3af84a744c9fe42dd090b95cd891285b60e0.png[/img]
　■What is GBO Days?
　　GBO Days is a special monthly campaign that will start at the first Thursday of every month
　　at [JST] 17:00 until the next Monday [JST] 04:59 [scheduled].
　　Pilots who always play GBO2 will receive a lot of benefits, furthermore, 
　　new and returning pilots will be even benefited from some of the content during the campaign!
　■GBO Days February Schedule
　　[PST] 02/06/2025 00:00 – 02/09/2025 11:59 [Scheduled]
　　[CET] 02/06/2025 09:00 – 02/09/2025 20:59 [Scheduled]
　■Campaign Details

　　②"Special Supply Drop" with 2 guaranteed ★★★ or above rarity MS can be requested once! (10 Times/30 Tokens)
　　③Basic rewards (EXP, DP, CP) after battle will be doubled!

notes.title: ■Ri-Shun Festival Pre-event 2025
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
　
Thank you for your constant support, pilots! 
We would like to announce that "Ri-Shun Festival Pre-event 2025" is about to start!
　
■Ri-Shun Festival Pre-event 2025
Starting from [PST] 01/23/2025 / [CET] 01/23/2025, "Ri-Shun Festival Pre-event 2025" will begin.
　■Period
　　[PST] 01/23/2025 00:00 – 02/05/2025 20:59 [Scheduled]
　　[CET] 01/23/2025 09:00 – 02/06/2025 05:59 [Scheduled]
　
　
■Ri-Shun Festival Pre-event 2025①: Special Supply Drop
Starting from [PST] 01/23/2025 / [CET] 01/23/2025, "Special Supply Drop" will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/0ac2f0eea0136647b3bac8874549806005833193.png[/img]
　■Period
　　[PST] 01/23/2025 00:00 – 02/05/2025 20:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CET] 01/23/2025 09:00 – 02/06/2025 05:30 [Scheduled]
　
　※Notice regarding the event period
　　Except the first day from [JST] 17:00 to the next morning 4:59, 
　　later Drops will be refreshed and ready for request from everyday 5:00 a.m. until the next morning 4:59 [JST].
　　In addition, lineup update will occur at [JST] 01/30/2025 13:30 and the last day 13:30 [JST].
　　You can check the detailed schedule below.

The latest information will be posted on STEAM News and our Twitter in the future.
https://twitter.com/pc_gbo2
　
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

■Notice of Supply Drop Lineup “Demeter”
Supply Drop Lineup has been updated.

　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・Raid unit with cost of 650.
　　・It is a Qubeley type MS and is an NT-only unit carried by someone claimed herself “Haman Karn”, 
　　　who was supposed to have been killed in the war.
　　・Although it has a very slender body structure as an MS, it is equipped with three-in-one binders on its back 
　　　that concentrate complex functions of funnels, beam armament, and boosters, etc.
　　　In practice, it easily destroyed A.E.U.G.’s escort ships with all-range attacks, 
　　　and it can also perform melee combat with escort MS at the same time, 
　　　demonstrating the performance and piloting skills appropriate to the lineage of the Qubeley.
　　・With a large number of funnels standing by, 
　　　this unit can be expected to produce significant results when operated in a way that suits the battle situation.
　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.

　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　　　※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.

　　　・Increased mobility
　　　・Reduces damage from ranged attacks and staggering caused by accumulated damage
　　　・When an enemy MS is destroyed by your melee attack,
　　　　the HP of each part and MS HP will be recover a certain amount of its maximum HP
　　　・While activated, operation is limited for enemies within a determined range
　　　　that use melee weapons and High Speed Movement.
　　Skill “Heavy Attack” LV2
　　・When selecting the weapon corresponding to the “Heavy Attack” skill, 
　　　press and hold the attack button to perform a melee attack with the following effects.
　　・Increases the attack power and hit detection of melee attack
　　・Disables the “Special Buffer” skills of the enemy MS
　　・Even if the attack hits the enemy MS’s shield weapon, it will still deal damage to the MS itself
　　・Reduces damage taken, damage reactions, and staggering caused by accumulated damage while Heavy Attack.
　　Skill “Power Accelerator” LV3
　　・When binding a melee weapon and repelled by a melee attack, 
　　　your MS will be able to regain its posture more quickly than usual through evasion actions.
　　　In addition, when the situation above is ocurred, your MS will recover the whole thrusters.
　
　■Demeter’s skill “DM High-Performance Counter Program”

　　the counter action changes as follows depending on if the sub-weapon “Funnels” is remain standby or not.

We have different events for all pilots [JST] every first Thursday through the first Sunday as our big campaign "GBO Days"!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/026f3af84a744c9fe42dd090b95cd891285b60e0.png[/img]
　■What is GBO Days?
　　GBO Days is a special monthly campaign that will start at the first Thursday of every month

　　Pilots who always play GBO2 will receive a lot of benefits, furthermore,

notes.title: Notice of GBO Winter Festival
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
　
Thank you for your constant support, pilots! We would like to announce that "GBO Winter Festival" is about to start!
　
■GBO Winter Festival
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/ca855484cb6f4d57108f9113462c352eca7385ee.jpg[/img]
Starting from [PST] 11/28/2024 / [CET] 11/28/2024, GBO Winter Festival will available to all pilots.
　■Period
　　[PST] 11/28/2024 00:00 – 12/25/2024 20:59 [Scheduled]
　　[CET] 11/28/2024 09:00 – 12/26/2024 05:59 [Scheduled]
　
　
■【GBO Winter Festival:①】 Burning Gundam is now in Gundam!
We are implementing Mobile Fighter “Burning Gundam” of “Mobile Fighter G Gundam” to GBO2 Steam®!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/e7145380cee7cab7a1476a0ab689a6c2df3d0152.png[/img]
　Here is the intro of the new ★★★★ MS "Burning Gundam"!
　　・★★★★ Burning Gundam LV1 (Raid unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)
　
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　　・From “Mobile Fighter G Gundam” / Sortie MAP "Ground/Space"
　　　・Raid unit with cost of 700.
　　　・MF (Mobile Fighter) from Neo Japan who entered the 13th "Gundam Fight" tournament from the finals.
　　　・This MF is the successor to the Shining Gundam, and also follows the design concept of 
　　　　changing modes in accordance with emotional ups and downs of the pilot,
　　　　and changing its shape in response to the situation.
　　　　It is also capable of reproducing the “School of Master Asia” of its pilot, martial artist Domon Kasshu.
　　　　Even in its normal form, it has a performance that exceeds that of the Shining Gundam's Super Mode,
　　　　and it also has a Hyper Mode that surpasses the Super Mode.
　　　・With its power and speed that surpass those of its predecessor, as well as the “Meikyo shisui”, 
　　　　a state of mind that Domon has achieved through his own growth, 
　　　　this machine embodies the “Jin-Ki Ittai” (unity of man and machine) which is the goal of MFs.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2GrXZbV-jr4
　
　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　
※Burning Gundam will be added to the lineup on [PST] 11/28/2024 00:00 / [CET] 11/28/2024 09:00 (Scheduled).
　
　
■About the coming adjustment on Freedom Gundam
In light of the changes in the battlefield since its implementation on [JST] 01/25/2024,
due to the implementation of new units and other existing unit adjustments,
we plan to make adjustments to the Freedom Gundam for your continued enjoyment 
in the unit adjustments scheduled to be implemented around the end of December 2024.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and humble to ask for your understanding.
※For details about the adjustment, please check the information on the date of the adjustment.
　
　
■【GBO Winter Festival:②】 4 Special STEP UP Supply Drop!
　■Content
　　During the period 1st – 4th STEP UP Supply Drop will be available to all pilots.
　
■【GBO Winter Festival】: ②[Round 1] Burning Gundam guaranteed STEP UP Supply Drop
Starting from [PST] 11/28/2024 / [CET] 11/28/2024, Burning Gundam guaranteed STEP UP Supply Drop will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/44f2c9ec0fc8b5ae4332d84009e490c302c36759.png[/img]
　■Period
　　[PST] 11/28/2024 00:00 – 12/04/2024 20:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CET] 11/28/2024 09:00 – 12/05/2024 05:30 [Scheduled]
　
　■Content
　　A Supply Drop, in which 10 consecutive Supply Drops can be requested up to STEP10.
　　The STEP will progress by 1 each time you perform a request,
　　as STEP1 → STEP2 → STEP3 → STEP4 → STEP5 → STEP6 → STEP7 → STEP8 → STEP9 → STEP10.
　　After STEP10 is requested, Boosted Supply Drop will be over.
　
　　・STEP1 (15 Tokens): Token 50% OFF!
　　・STEP2 (30 Tokens): As a bonus 50 ★★★★ Mechanic tickets are obtainable!
　　・STEP3 (30 Tokens): As a bonus 50 ★★★★ Modification kits are obtainable!
　　・STEP4 (30 Tokens): ★★★★ materials drop rate x2.0!
　　・STEP5 (30 Tokens): ★★★★ materials drop rate x3.0!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ 100 ★★★★ Mechanic tckets for bonus!!
　　・STEP6 (30 Tokens): ★★★★ materials drop rate x3.0!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ 100 ★★★★ Modification kits for bonus!!
　　・STEP7 (30 Tokens): 1 “Burning Gundam LV1” is guaranteed!
　　・STEP8 (30 Tokens): As a bonus 300 ★★★★ Mechanic tickets are obtainable!
　　・STEP9 (30 Tokens): As a bonus 300 ★★★★ Modification kits are obtainable!
　　・STEP10 (30 Tokens): Another “Burning Gundam LV1” ＋ Mark "King of Hearts" for bonus!!!

　　For Details, please check [Item List].
　※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
　
　
■【GBO Winter Festival:③】 Custom part guaranteed Limited Supply Drop
Starting from [PST] 11/28/2024 / [CET] 11/28/2024, Custom part guaranteed Limited Supply Drop will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/d07d163da9a5816eea420ea05ff123e27a2900ba.png[/img]

　　　MS HP increases by 300 more, and melee strength increases 3.

Starting from [PST] 11/21/2024 / [CET] 11/21/2024,
Mass Production Type Z Gundam LV1 Guaranteed STEP UP Supply Drop will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/662747b03cc2e1b0baf2959e0842a107f972d852.jpg[/img]
　
　■Period

　　A Supply Drop, in which 10 consecutive Supply Drops can be requested up to STEP5.
　　The STEP will progress by 1 each time you perform a request, as STEP1 → STEP2 → STEP3 → STEP4 → STEP5.
　　Once STEP5 finished and this Boosted Supply Drop will be over.

　　・STEP2 (30 Tokens): ★★ and above Materials Drop Rate x1.5!
　　・STEP3 (30 Tokens): 1 ★★ or above rarity MS guaranteed!

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　⇒　Greatly boosting the drop rate from “3%” to “4.5%”!!
　　・STEP5 (30 Tokens): 1 Mass Production Type Z Gundam LV1 guaranteed!
　
　※Same supplies will be drawn as the ongoing Supply Drops.
　　　For details, please check the [Item List].
　※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
　
　
■Notice of Supply Drop Lineup “Mass Production Type Z Gundam”
Supply Drop Lineup has been updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/4b77f126156a4301ac151c2fe6a1c5fd7359fbfa.jpg[/img]
　■Period
　　[PST] 11/21/2024 00:00 – 11/27/2024 20:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CET] 11/21/2024 09:00 – 11/28/2024 05:30 [Scheduled]
　■Added New Materials
　　■Unit
　　・★★ Mass Production Type Z Gundam LV1 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost 550)
　
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・General unit with cost of 550.
　　・Developed as a mass-production variant of the AEUG’s flagship MS, known as the Zeta Gundam.
　　・In order to implement the transformation mechanism, 
　　　much of the Zeta Gundam’s internal structure had to consist of movable frame components.
　　　This reduced the weight of the MS so that the output of its generators and thrusters exceeded its mass; 
　　　the result was remarkable overall performance, even while in MS form.
　　　Impressed with the unit’s performance, the military considered developing a mass-production variant, 
　　　opting to eliminate the transformation mechanism of the original Zeta Gundam.
　　・A variety of other cost-cutting measures were implemented for mass production, 
　　　such as eliminating the head-mounted Twin-Eye and V antenna.
　　　Expectations were high that this would be a high-quality, low-cost attack MS,
　　　but it ultimately couldn’t compete with other developments during the same period, such as the Hyaku Shiki Kai.
　　　Because of this, development plans for this MS were scrapped after only a few units were produced.
　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
https://bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2024/09/3ad41183b79453efa7dd236b2a766898.mp4
　
　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
