notes.title: GBO2 Autumn Festival Post-event
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
■GBO2 Autumn Festival Post-event
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/cb55a850bd3f65bd55e252d8ecb6eea2b6a2e8c6.png[/img]
Starting from [PDT] 10/24/2024 / [CEST] 10/24/2024, "GBO2 Autumn Festival Post-event" will begin.
　■Period
　　[PDT] 10/24/2024 01:00 – [PST]11/06/2024 20:59 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 10/24/2024 10:00 – [CET]11/07/2024 05:59 [Scheduled]
　■Content
　　During the period, the following events will be available to all pilots.
　
　
■【Autumn Festival Post-event ①】 [Event 1] Custom Parts guaranteed STEP UP Supply Drop!
Starting from [PDT] 10/24/2024 / [CEST] 10/24/2024, "Custom Parts guaranteed STEP UP Supply Drop" will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/370636ba8f907db7ae313886b3977fe3db486512.png[/img]
　
　■Period
　　[PDT] 10/24/2024 01:00 – 10/30/2024 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 10/24/2024 10:00 – [CET]10/31/2024 05:30 [Scheduled]
　
　■Content
　　A Supply Drop, in which 10 consecutive Supply Drops can be requested up to STEP4.
　　The STEP will progress by 1 each time you perform a request, as STEP1 → STEP2 → STEP3 → STEP4.
　　Pilot can restart this STEP UP once ALL STEP 4 are finished.
　
　　◎STEP1 (30 Tokens)
　　　1 ★★ or above MS guaranteed!
　　◎STEP2 (30 Tokens)
　　　1 ★★★ or above MS guaranteed!
　　◎STEP3 (30 Tokens)
　　　1 ★★ or above MS guaranteed ＆ 1 ★★★ or above MS guaranteed!
　　◎STEP4 (30 Tokens)
　　　2 ★★ or above MS guaranteed ＆ 2 ★★★ or above MS guaranteed!
　　　＋ Randomly get one from “Composite Motor LV1” or “Fire Control Optimization System LV1”
　　　　　or “Thruster Control System LV5”!!
　
　　　Composite Motor LV1
　　　Increases speed by 5 and maneuverability by 9.
　　　Reduces load on legs by 20% after jumping or high-speed movement.
　　　Cannot be equipped with other parts that also increase speed or maneuverability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/4f52f6354f99375af36e495abca9a283b5bb4932.png[/img]
　
　　　Fire Control Optimization System LV1
　　　Range boosted 2 and ASL (Automated Sight Leveling) area expanded 5.
　　　Ranged beam weapon focus time reduced 5%.
　　　Damage dealt to enemies increases 5%.
　　　Cannot be used together with other parts that expand ASL or reduce beam weapon focus time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/486e86f872991b2160a48ef4e31a547ac42b3568.png[/img]
　
　　　Thruster Control System LV5
　　　Increase thruster by 15.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/67e016f6feabea552d259a306ff5ae1dfe2dc9f6.png[/img]
　
※Same supplies will be drawn as the ongoing Supply Drops.
　　For details, please check the [Item List].
※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
　
　
■【Autumn Festival Post-event ②】 Once for FREE! ★★★★ MS guaranteed Special STEP UP Supply Drop
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/31e2ec72e3d7f5295ca2ca05d8b6d3c62f1e5e6a.png[/img]

　　[CEST] 10/24/2024 10:00 – [CET]11/07/2024 05:30 [Scheduled]

During the campaign, pilots will obtain special login bonus based on the day of the event.
For pilots who logged in for whole 7 days, we will have MS “Hobby Hizack” and some other rewards 
such as Mechanic tickets for extra bonus!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/4d9fa124f16ef33bb31ce0041cc8446434c811bd.png[/img]
　
※Other than this login bonus, pilots can still login and claim other login bonus like normal Login Bonus,
　New Pilot Login Bonus and Premium Login Bonus.
※Pilots who already have those MS will obtain a number of recycle tickets instead.
※Please note that pilot who had logged-in to GBO2 and claimed the login bonus of that day before the ver.0185 update of
　[JST] 2024/10/24, the login bonus from this event will be postponed to the next day [JST] AM 05:00.
　
　
■【Autumn Festival Post-event ④】 Nu Gundam & Sazabi for present!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/8ce21b744b1795f979919ec2bf91b6433c1b5710.png[/img]
　★★★★ MS "Nu Gundam LV1" and "Sazabi Lv1" are now giving away to all pilots who login to GBO2 during the event!

　※Present will be sent after the update of [PDT] 10/24/2024 01:00 / [CEST] 10/24/2024 10:00.
　※Please claim your present from Reward Center.
　※Pilots who already have the materials will obtain a number of recycle tickets instead.
　
　
■【Autumn Festival Post-event ⑤】 Limited Special Missions
Starting from [PDT] 10/24/2024 / [CEST] 10/24/2024, "Limited Special Missions" will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/ae2614aa9afecaa5b78ab83eb7f95b7180700f17.jpg[/img]
　
　■Period
　　[PDT] 10/24/2024 01:00 – [PST]11/06/2024 20:59 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 10/24/2024 10:00 – [CET]11/07/2024 05:59 [Scheduled]
　
　■Content
　　We have a special mission for all pilots during the period.
　　You will have a chance to gain units, pilot wear and accessory while completing the special mission during the campaign.
　
　■Mission reward
　　■Units
　　　・★★ Zssa [Sleeve Type] LV1 – 2 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost 500–)
　　　・★★ Gunner Gundam LV4 (Support unit, ground/space uses, cost 550)
　　　・★★ Rick Dias LV4 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost 650)
　　　・★★ Gelgoog High Mobility Type [UL] LV4 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost 600)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/2e568d5d90c138a88d1493fab4d6a6e77ec844c2.png[/img]
　
　　■Wear and Accessory
　　　・Normal Suit: F.S.S. 02
　　　・Helmet: F.S.S. 02
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/4a6018b45160d8373cbc53a5b05a10af1ba401fe.png[/img]
　
　　■Other reward
　　　・15 ★ – ★★★ Mechanic tickets each
　
※Unlike daily missions, you don’t have to complete all of them in one day. 
　The achievement status will be carried over to the next day during the period.
※The details of the missions and their achievement status can be found in the “Missions”→ “Limited” 
　under the H.A.R.O. menu.
※Rewards can be gained in the Rewards Center.
　
　
■【Autumn Festival Post-event ⑥】 Daily Mission Challenge
During the campaign, pilots will obtain ★★ or ★★★ Mechanic tickets by completing Daily missions everyday.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/03d81a333b7c1fd5447b9c7894fdcd65ff98dbeb.png[/img]
　
※For those pilots who had finished daily missions on the day before the update of [JST] 10/24/2024,
　please finish one game to update the status of "Achieved all missions".
　
　
■【Autumn Festival Post-event ⑦】 Reinforced container recon team
During the period, container discovering chance after the battle will be increased from “10%” to “25%” during the period.
There is more! ALL containers will be Silver grade of above!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/04d5d877fe4467ae2b986c78b5234d51f9973900.png[/img]
　
※Maximum 2 containers can be discovered everyday.
※Extra container will be reward to those pilot who has been awarded with Premium War Medal.
※Date will be updated daily at 5:00 AM [JST].
※Pilots with penalty status [PENALTY LV1] or above will not able to get any container.
　
　
■【Autumn Festival Post-event ⑧】 Welcome to New & Returning Pilots Campaign
Starting from [PDT] 10/24/2024 / [CEST] 10/24/2024, "Welcome to New & Returning Pilots Campaign" will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/218f16ae87afdfdff97d0314e1d466825245b2f6.png[/img]

notes.title: Call to attention for the recent cheating behavior ([JST] 10/24/2024)
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
This is the Steam® version of the operations team.
　
In order to improve our countermeasures against unauthorized products obtained or purchased outside of
the legitimate Steam platform, we have added a process that will not send the target DLC
if we detect inconsistencies in the rights information.
We will continue to take actions to maintain a fairer game play for all GBO users.
　
If you would like to provide us with information or feedback on unauthorized activities,
such as the sale of fraudulent products, unwanted behavior, use of external tools, data falsification, etc.,
please contact us using the contact information below.

▼Contact (Inquiry)
・North America
https://www.bandainamcoent.com/support

・Europe
https://en.bandainamcoent.eu/

・Southeast Asia
https://www.bandainamcoent.asia/sea/contact-us


We have been putting all effort to provide a friendly environment to all users,
and have been conducting investigations based on the reports we have received and information 
from our internal investigation criteria, and in response to the disruptive actions.
We also have been monitoring the action logs as appropriation on the management side.
We would like to report that for the accounts where issues were confirmed, 
measures to halt the gameplay rights have been successfully implemented.

Activities such as disturbing or interfering with other users, using external tools,
or editing data are considered as cheating and are strongly prohibited.

We would like to announce for this once again here,
ALL items from other than Steam will be considered as unauthorized items,
users could be risking the account suspension as a violation of the Terms of Use when using these kind of items.
　
We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
We ask for your continued support for "Mobile Suit Gundam: Battle Operation 2." 
Thank you.

This is the Steam® version oeperations team.

notes.content:

This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/3276cd2b43fbfb10627db148718e609e8dbb8dc0.png[/img]

Complete the missions and get special rewards such as MS and camouflage patterns!

notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
Pilots! To show our thankness to all your playing and support,
we are now delighted to announce that "Autumn Festival" is started!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/ad3c85c9e7ab3a72f736a6f21ed9c86b873c0f7c.png[/img]
■"Autumn Festival 2024" Notice
Starting from [PDT] 09/26/2024 / [CEST] 09/26/2024,"Autumn Festival 2024" will begin.
　■Period
　　[PDT] 09/26/2024 01:00 – 10/23/2024 21:59 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 09/26/2024 10:00 – 10/24/2024 06:59 [Scheduled]
　
　
■【GBO2 Autumn Festival 2024: ①】 ★★★★★MS, Xi Gundam is finally here!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/fb869d74224a7f261b4d8c33495daae23c0f5e16.png[/img]
　Pilots, this is it! Our highest rarity in GBO2… ★★★★★ is now in game!!
　No only the outrageous power of this ★★★★★ MS, the unique enforcing skill “Forced Sortie” and unit skill 
　“Raise Counter” will also be granted at the very first of obtaining this MS!
　
　■Skill “Forced Sortie”
　　Normally Pilots need to wait for a certain of period to re-sortie to the battlefield when MS got destroyed.
　　But skill “Forced Sortie” will allow you to re-sortie Immediately.
　　Of course, there is some down side. Once MS is back to the battle by using this skill, 
　　MAX MS HP will be reduced and this skill can only be used once every game.
　　※”Forced Sortie” is a default skill for the unit. (Which means pilot have no need to unlock it from the Hangar.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/7d1ca89eda333c07dbbedf9947b391d0e9a005f2.png[/img]
　
　■Skill “Raise Counter”
　　Executing a counter with less than a level of HP remaining triggers a special powerful counter.
　　It also temporarily boosts ATK and DEF for your unit and ally units within a limited area.
　
　And now, let us introduce you our ★★★★★ MS, “Xi Gundam”!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/c28a7ab2aa96954723526cb3f45ef975f66d89bb.png[/img]
　
　★★★★★ Xi Gundam LV1 (General unit, Ground only, cost: 700)
　
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・General unit with cost of 700.
　　・U.C. 0100s, Mafty, an anti-Federation group acquired this unit in secret from Anaheim Electronics who developed
　　　this MS, then send this Gundam-type unit was used to carry out an assault on Federation cabinet members later.
　　・It is considered as a sister model of the Penelope, integrated with a Minovsky Flight Unit that allows it to conduct
　　　independent patrol flights.
　　　In addition, its Beam Barrier system and capability to transform into “Flight Form” makes it into a complete
　　　fifth-generation MS.
　　・In addition to standard equipment such as a beam rifle, beam saber, and shield, 
　　　it is also a heavily armed machine equipped with Funnel missiles, 
　　　and its high degree of perfection enabled it to engage in fierce battles with the Penelope and the Circe Unit.
　　・Can only be deployed on the Ground.

　under the H.A.R.O. menu.

Starting from [PDT] 08/22/2024 / [CEST] 08/22/2024, 
a Limited Supply Drop with a MS drop rate boosted event will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/949dc35be276a4f191c7ed7044eac9d22bb7b7cc.jpg[/img]

　　During the period, “Limited Supply Drop (Once / 10 Times)” can be requested from the material counter.
　　Within the Limited Supply Drop, Unicorn Gundam, Banshee & Kshatriya’s drop rate will be increased.
　　In addition, you will get 50 ★★★★ Modification kit as a bonus when you request 10 consecutive Supply Drop.
　
　■Featured material with a Big Boost to its supply drop rate
　　In the Limited Supply Drop, drop rate on each unit will be affected respectively.
　　◎Supply drop rate increase① (Item Amount 1)
　　・★★★★ Unicorn Gundam LV1 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)
　　◎Supply drop rate increase② (Item Amount 1)
　　・★★★★ Banshee LV1 (Raid unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)
　　◎Supply drop rate increase③ (Item Amount 1)
　　・★★★★ Kshatriya LV1 (Support unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)
　
　■Supply Drops that are affected by the drop rate increase
　　・Limited Supply Drop
※Materials those can be received from this Limited Supply Drop will be as same as the current normal Supply Drop
　lineup. Differing from the standard Supply Drop, only the specified items in the Limited Supply Drop will be boosted.
※Drop rate increases of the Limited Supply Drop will affect the units of each LV 
　and also the units’ main weapon differently.
　　While each unit is affected by the drop rate increases as below.
　　・Unit ①’s drop rate increased by “1%”
　　・Unit ②’s drop rate increased by “1%”
　　・Unit ③’s drop rate increased by “1%”
　The Supply Drop rate increases is made by the reducing the drop rate of “★” rarity items.
※Regarding the detailed lineup of the Limited Supply Drop, please check [Item List].
※The amount of tokens required to request a Limited Supply Drop is the same as normal Supply Drop.
　(Once – 3 tokens / 10 Times – 30 tokens)
※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
　
　
■Notice of Supply Drop Lineup “Zeta Gundam 3B Type”
Supply Drop Lineup has been updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/191a1020cd5fd916200c8542065312615267fbab.jpg[/img]
　■Period

　　・★★★ Zeta Gundam 3B Type LV1 (Support unit, ground/space uses, cost: 650)
　　　※The above MS is eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・Support unit with cost of 650.
　　・This Zeta Gundam 3 series variant was operated under the Chakra Research Lab, affiliated with
　　　an anti-Earth Federation force known as Karaba.
　　・As a variant of the Zeta Gundam 3, a particular area of focus for this unit was enhanced firepower
　　　for better long-range combat performance.
　　　It is equipped with a large beam cannon comparable to a Hyper Mega Launcher and an internal Mega Gatling.
　　　Its tail stabilizer can take on a winged shape for better attitude control while attacking,
　　　and additional sub thrusters were added to the lower legs to compensate for the weight increase.
　　・Its pilot, known as the “Gray Wolf,” ordered the unit in gray to match his name, but much to his displeasure,
　　　it was delivered in yellow, which performs better as a beam-deflection coating.
　　　It was nicknamed “Buster Zeta” by its pilot.
　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
https://bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2024/06/38fc9af8c5934e5ead88003c61bd1b95.mp4

　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　　　※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
　
　　Skill “Anti-Beam Coating LV3”

　　　However, if the HP falls below the minimum value, the skill effect becomes ineffective.
　　　※Beam resistance compensation is not reduced even if the skill effect is disabled at skill LV3.

notes.title: Notice About Suspension of Some Accounts（2024/8/1）
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
This is the Steam® version oeperations team.
　
Currently, we are receiving reports indicating that regular gameplay is being disrupted due to unauthorized behavior.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused to users who are enjoying the game normally.
　
We have been conducting investigations based on the reports we have received and information 
from our internal investigation criteria, and in response to these disruptive actions, 
we have been monitoring the action logs as appropriate on the management side.
We would like to report that for the accounts where issues were confirmed,

notes.title: About FA Unicorn Gundam's enhancement value different to the original setting
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
This is the Steam® version operations team.
　
　
We have confirmed an issue about FA Unicorn Gundam's enhancement value is not match the original setting 
after the update of [JST] 07/11/2024.

・Enhancement value for FA Unicorn Gundam's skill is not reaching the default setting

The above issues will be fixed at the update on [JST] 07/25/2024.

We apologize for this happen and all inconvenience caused to you.
Besides, we decided to compensate the targeted pilots due to the issue.

Pilot who obtained the second or beyond FA Unicorn Gundam during [JST] 07/11/2024 17:00 and 07/25/2024 14:00.
　
　
◎Content
To fill up the gap of missing enhancement value,
we will send 70 ★★★★ Mechanic tickets for each reobtained FA Unicorn Gundam
to compensate the enhancement value lost due to the issue.
　
◎Period for claiming the compensation
[PDT] 07/25/2024 after maintance - 09/25/2024 21:59
[CEST] 07/25/2024 after maintance - 09/26/2024 06:59
　
◎Additional information
All compensation will be sent automatically when pilot login to GBO2 after the update of [JST] 07/25/2024.
※Pilot can claim the compensation from the Reward Center.
　　
　
We deeply apologize for all inconvenience caused to you.
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

　　　Even if the unit’s melee attack compensation is already at its maximum, melee damage can be further increased.

　　　Since this part increases all armor compensation values,

　　　Since the Maximum of the ballistic resistance can be increased,

 “Awaken Ability Boost LV3” is incorrect in some languages.

For FA Unicorn Gundam’s skill “Awaken Ability Boost LV3”,

description for the language settings “English”, “Traditional Chinese (TW)”,
“Traditional Chinese (HK)” and “Simplified Chinese”

　Boost has been active for a set period.

　the attack power for a period.

This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
　
Server maintenance will be performed on the following schedule.
　
◇Date & Time
[PDT] 06/26/2024 22:00 – 06/27/2024 01:00 [Scheduled]
[CEST] 06/27/2024 07:00 – 06/27/2024 10:00 [Scheduled]
　
◇Maintenance Details
・【Update file ver.0179】
・Supply Drop Lineup Update
　
　※Please note that you will not be able to log in to the game during the maintenance.
　※The end time may vary depending on the maintenance status. Please understand this in advance.
　※Entering the maintenance during matching may cause unexpected errors.
　　Please log out of the game before maintenance.
　
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
　

　
　
[PDT] 06/27/2024 / [CEST] 06/27/2024 Updated content is listed below.
　
　
■【Update file ver.0179】
　
■1st Anniversary Celebration
1st Anniversary Celebration started from [PDT] 05/30/2024 / [CEST] 05/30/2024.
※Please have a check to below for more details.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/4147330837532126215
　
■【1st Anniversary Celebration: ①-7】 5th FA Unicorn Gundam Guaranteed STEP UP Supply Drop
This time, we are going to have FA Unicorn Gundam releasing on both STEAM and PS4/PS5 at the same patch!
Starting from [PDT] 06/27/2024 / [CEST] 06/27/2024, FA Unicorn Gundam Guaranteed STEP UP Supply Drop will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/8d449204a11e77160f06432e68e30a3156a27d03.png[/img]
　
　■Period
　　[PDT] 06/27/2024 01:00 – 07/03/2024 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 06/27/2024 10:00 – 07/04/2024 06:30 [Scheduled]
　
　■Contents
　　A Supply Drop, in which 10 consecutive Supply Drops can be requested up to STEP7.
　　The STEP will progress by 1 each time you perform a request,
　　as STEP1 → STEP2 → STEP3 → STEP4 → STEP5 → STEP6 → STEP7.
　　Once STEP7 finished and this STEP UP Supply Drop will be over.
　　・STEP1 (15 Tokens): Token 50% OFF!
　　・STEP2 (30 Tokens): As a bonus 50 Mechanic Tickets [★★★★] are obtainable!
　　・STEP3 (30 Tokens): As a bonus 50 Modification Kit [★★★★] are obtainable!
　　・STEP4 (30 Tokens): 2x Chance of obtaining “★★★★” materials!
　　・STEP5 (30 Tokens): 3x Chance of obtaining “★★★★” materials!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ As a bonus 100 Mechanic Tickets [★★★★] are obtainable!
　　・STEP6 (30 Tokens): 3x Chance of obtaining “★★★★” materials!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ As a bonus 100 Modification Kit [★★★★] are obtaianble!
　　・STEP7 (30 Tokens): 1 Guaranteed Obtainable “FA Unicorn Gundam LV1” !!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ As a bonus Custom Part “Special Combustion Agent LV1” is obtainable!
　
　■Custom parts
　◎Special Combustion Agent LV1
　　・Increases incendiary damage dealt by 20%.
　　　Also increases duration of incendiary effect by 10%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/72eaf20ea3361b110c7ab474506ab6c550a2594a.png[/img]
※Same supplies will be drawn as the ongoing Supply Drops.
　For details, please check the [Item List].
　
　
■Special MS Enhancement STEP UP Supply Drop
Starting from [PDT] 06/27/2024 / [CEST] 06/27/2024, Special MS Enhancement STEP UP Supply Drop will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/99c8b3ce2655321d8607949a330d027046e8e9b2.png[/img]
　■Period
　　[PDT] 06/27/2024 01:00 – 07/10/2024 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 06/27/2024 10:00 – 07/11/2024 06:30 [Scheduled]
　
■Content
　A Supply Drop, in which 10 consecutive Supply Drops can be requested up to STEP4.
　The STEP will progress by 1 each time when you request, as STEP1 → STEP2 → STEP3 → STEP4.
　Pilots can restart this Supply Drop from STEP1 once STEP4 is finished.
　・STEP1 (15 Tokens): 10 consecutive Supply Drops 50% OFF & 200 ★ Mechanic Tickets for bonus!
　・STEP2 (30 Tokens): 200 ★★ Mechanic Tickets for bonus!
　・STEP3 (30 Tokens): 200% rate for ★★ or above from Supply Drop ＆ 200 ★★★ Mechanic Tickets for bonus!
　・STEP4 (30 Tokens): 
　　200% rate for ★★ or above from Supply Drop ＆ 200 ★★★★ Mechanic Tickets for bonus! PLUS, ALL Drops will be MS!
　
　※Same supplies will be drawn as the ongoing Supply Drops.
　　　For details, please check the [Item List].
　※This lineup will be updated on [PDT] 07/04/2024 01:00 / [CEST] 07/04/2024 10:00 (scheduled).
　　Pilot will unable to see this information during 
　　[PDT] 07/03/2024 21:30 – 07/04/2024 01:00 / [CEST] 07/04/2024 06:30 – 10:00.
　　Please note that STEP process will NOT be reset after the lineup update.
　
　
■Notice of "Limited Supply Drop!! RX-93ff Nu Gundam & MSN-04FF Sazabi"
Starting from [PDT] 06/27/2024 / [CEST] 06/27/2024, a Limited Supply Drop with a MS drop rate boosted event will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/d651eb902708a49f33a6fe1db0cd48bdebb3a142.jpg[/img]
　
　■Period
　　[PDT] 06/27/2024 01:00 – 07/03/2024 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 06/27/2024 10:00 – 07/04/2024 06:30 [Scheduled]
　■Contents
　　During the period, “Limited Supply Drop (Once / 10 Times)” can be requested from the material counter.
　　Within the Limited Supply Drop, RX-93ff Nu Gundam & MSN-04FF Sazabi’s drop rate will be increased.
　　In addition, you will get 50 ★★★★ Modification kit as a bonus when you request 10 consecutive Supply Drop.
　■Featured material with a Big Boost to its supply drop rate
　　In the Limited Supply Drop, the specified unit and its related main weapon will be affected.
　　◎Supply drop rate increase① (Item Amount 1)
　　・★★★★ RX-93ff Nu Gundam LV1 (Raid unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)
　　◎Supply drop rate increase② (Item Amount 1)
　　・★★★★ MSN-04FF Sazabi LV1 (Support unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)
　　◎Supply drop rate increase③ (Item Amount 1)
　　・★★★ 93ff NH Bazooka LV1
　■Supply Drops that are affected by the drop rate increase
　　・Limited Supply Drop
※Materials those can be received from this Limited Supply Drop will be as same as
　the current normal Supply Drop lineup.
　Differing from the standard Supply Drop, only the specified items in the Limited Supply Drop will be boosted.
※Drop rate increases of the Limited Supply Drop will affect the units of each LV and also the units’ main weapon differently.
　e.g. While units and main weapon are affected by the drop rate increases as below.
　　・Unit 1’s drop rate increased by “1%”
　　・Unit 2’s drop rate increased by “1%”
　　・Main weapons’ drop rate Increase “3％”
　The Supply Drop drop rate increases is made by the reducing the drop rate of “★” rarity items.
※Regarding the detailed lineup of the Limited Supply Drop, please check [Item List].
※The amount of tokens required to request a Limited Supply Drop is the same as normal Supply Drop.
　(Once – 3 tokens / 10 Times – 30 tokens)
※Please make sure to have a check to the final date of this Limited Supply Drop so that you will not miss anything.
　
　
■Notice of Supply Drop Lineup “FA Unicorn Gundam”
Supply Drop Lineup has been updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/98ea4c2d0518cdffcd69f809780c0a69dde2c04e.png[/img]
　■Period
　　[PDT] 06/27/2024 01:00 – 07/03/2024 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 06/27/2024 10:00 – 07/04/2024 06:30 [Scheduled]
　■Added New Materials
　　■Unit
　　・★★★★ FA Unicorn Gundam LV1 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)
　　　※The above MS is eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・General unit with cost of 700.
　　・To prepare for a decisive battle over Laplace’s Box,
　　　this Unicorn Gundam’s specs were enhanced by hastily equipping it with reserve weaponry.
　　・The Unicorn Gundam faced challenges in prolonged battles due to its performance and weapon configuration.
　　　Because of this, it originally required an escort unit to operate,
　　　which aided “Newtype Hunters” in the destruction of Newtype weapons.
　　・For improved capabilities in prolonged combat, this unit was equipped with an abundance of additional weaponry,
　　　including Hyper Bazookas, Beam Gatling Guns, and Anti-Ship Missile Launchers.
　　　FA Unicorn Gundam is also equipped with multiple defensive weapon which is attached the I-field generators,
　　　dramatically improving its defensive capabilities.
　　・Although two large boosters were connected to maximize deployment time, 
　　　they were detached relatively early due to the large area exposed to attack, 
　　　and it disconnected them and continued into battle without them.
　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
https://bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2024/06/669d95b1a6a973b22454195ce737d379.mp4

　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　　　※Keep that in mind that the release time of the unit is scheduled.
　
　Sub-weapon “Beam Gatling Gun x4”
　・A beam gatling gun with machine gun properties.
　・Pressing the Reload button with heat gauges at 100% removes the limiter, temporarily altering weapon performance.
　　・Boosting fire power.
　　・Boosting fire range.
　　・Firing without charging the heat gauges.
　　Also Gatling Gun will stop firing once deactivating the limiter and get overheated for a long period of time
　　after the effect time.
　
　Skill “NT-D: Resonance Ability Boost LV1”
　・Press the touch pad button when drops to a certain HP to activate skill.
　　・Boosting attack power.
　　・Fully recovered ranged weapon ammo and heat gauges,
　　　instantly finish reload action and overheat as soon as skill is activated.
　　・NT-D skills become usable for friendly units within range as soon as skill is activated as well.
　　　If NT-D is already in effect, time till Awaken occurs will be reduced.
　　While the skill is in effect, the MS HP will be damaged at regular intervals.
　
　Skill “Awaken Ability Boost LV3”
　・Activate the skill by pressing touch pad once NT-D: Resonance Ability Boos has been active for a set period.
　　・Allies in the radar range when skill activates will be boosted the attack power for a period.
　　　Recovering all body parts HP (head, back, legs) for all allies in the radar range 
　　　and clearing debuffs including incendiary effect.
　　・Shorten ranged weapons reload and overheat time once the skill is activated.
　　・Nullify enemies’ Psycommu disabling effect.
　
　■Exclusive pilot item as a Bonus for the 10 Consecutive Supply Drops!
　　Beginning from [PDT] 06/27/2024 01:00 / [CEST] 06/27/2024 10:00,
　　1 random exclusive pilot item as a bonus can be obtained from 10 consecutive drops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/0ebfc76183283780c8799348c505808919e572e9.png[/img]
　　■Period
　　　[PDT] 06/27/2024 01:00 – 07/03/2024 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　　[CEST] 06/27/2024 10:00 – 07/04/2024 06:30 [Scheduled]
　　■Supply Drop with Bonus Items
　　　Normal 10-consecutive Supply Drops
　　■Bonus Item Contents (get 1 of the 2 items randomly listed below)
　　　■Wear
　　　　Normal Suit: Vist Foundation 01
　　　■Accessory
　　　　Helmet: Vist Foundation 01
　　　※Requesting 10-Consecutive Supply Drops during the campaign will grant you an additional 11th supply drop,
　　　　and get 1 extra item.
　　　※Single Supply Drop is NOT applied with this benefit.
　　　　The bonus item will not be awarded even if you request the 1-Attempt Supply Drop ten times in a row.
　
　■Notice of [Big Boost to Supply Drop Rates Campaign]
　　Some of the newly added materials will have a boost to their supply drop rates for a limited time.
　　■Period
　　　[PDT] 06/27/2024 01:00 – 07/03/2024 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　　[CEST] 06/27/2024 10:00 – 07/04/2024 06:30 [Scheduled]
　　■Featured material that will benefit from the Big Boost to its Supply Rate
　　　・★★★★ FA Unicorn Gundam LV1 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)
　　■Supply Drops that will benefit from Big Boost to Supply Rates
　　　・Normal Supply Drop
　　　※After the end of the campaign, all supply drop rates will be the same as other materials.
　
　
■Powered-up Hangers Campaign
Starting from [PDT] 06/27/2024 / [CEST] 06/27/2024, Powered-up Hangers Campaign will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/36f028fdea04fcd5d26447c45996e6b629935b72.jpg[/img]
　■Period
　　[PDT] 06/27/2024 01:00 – 07/10/2024 21:59 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 06/27/2024 10:00 – 07/10/2024 06:59 [Scheduled]
　■Contents
　　In the period, chance of “Great success” in Hangers will be multiplied by 3!
　　⇒　Basic “Great success”, plus “campaign bonus 20%”!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/b8896bf8a162ddb9422fdfd2e52dab07a94e7f34.png[/img]
　　※The sortie count bonus is added separately from the campaign benefits.
　
　　In addition, the enhancement value obtained when getting an owned MS by Supply Drops, etc., 
　　will be increased by 3 times.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/878ee39b85f57554e00fa21807208f9bb0a458da.png[/img]
　※Only the enhancement value increases by 3x with MS reobtaining.
　　Please note that recycle tickets and mechanics tickets using for fully enhancing are not included.
　
■【1st Anniversary Celebration】 Celebrating Container Vol.5
　We have confirmed that an unexpected message is displayed when receiving the Operator "Tenda Begin"
　from the "1st Anniversary Celebration" Celebrating Container Vol. 5.
　Still we are expecting that pilot can still receive the operator without any trouble.
　We apologize for all inconvenience we had caused.
※Please have a check to below for details of the container.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/4147330837532126215
※Operator can be changed from H.A.R.O. > Options > Sound Settings > Operator.
　
■July 2024 Premium Login Bonus
※画像挿入：080_
　◎[PDT] 06/30/2024 13:00 – 07/10/2024 12:59
　◎[CEST] 06/30/2024 22:00 – 07/10/2024 21:59
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/5e964f6e65a90db112735e01716db167539e1d1b.png[/img]
　・List of items you can get
　　MS: ★★★★ Banshee LV1
　　Other: Modification kit [★] – [★★★★], Hanger usage permission ＜At the beginning of the month＞, DP, Token
　
　◎[PDT] 07/10/2024 13:00 – 07/20/2024 12:59
　◎[CEST] 07/10/2024 22:00 – 07/20/2024 21:59
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/de2c03e5d4228b761d6a2a08eb5040cdd0a3afd7.png[/img]
　・List of items you can get
　　MS: ★★★ ReZEL Type-C [Defenser b-Unit] LV1
　　Other: Modification Kit [★] – [★★★], Hanger usage permission ＜The middle of the month＞, DP, Token
　
　◎[PDT] 07/20/2024 13:00 – 07/31/2024 12:59
　◎[CEST] 07/20/2024 22:00 – 07/31/2024 21:59
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/38afcbfc7619661e445d1dea820519102993d5ca.png[/img]
　・List of items you can get
　　MS: ★★ Gaza E LV1
　　Other: Modification Kit [★] – [★★★], Hanger usage permission ＜At the end of the month＞, DP, Token
　※When you acquire the Hangar usage permission, the dedicated hangar of the reinforcement facility will be opened.
　※Hangars have early, mid, and late slots, and each of these slots will be opened in the duration
　　in which the permission to use the hangar is acquired.
　※All hangars opened by the usage right will become unavailable at the end of the month 
　　in which the usage rights are acquired ([PDT] 12:59 / [CEST] 21:59 on the day).
　　(If the end of the month arrives in the middle of storing the MS, 
　　it will be unavailable after the MS enhancement is completed.)
　
■Unit adjustment
　　◎Various Parameter Adjustments are implemented.
　　　※For details, check here.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/4231776500617999916
　
　
■Battle related changes
　◎The indicator display in the lower right corner of the screen has been modified.
　　⇒　To make it easier to see how much time remains for effects such as “Psycommu Jack” and “Stealth”,
　　　　the indicators of the unit’s various indicators displayed in the lower right corner of the screen have been modified
　　　　so that the indicators start blinking 3 seconds before the effect wears off.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/f7298eb531fc26b0763505ceeff8a98152322542.png[/img]
　
　　◎The re-sortie window has been modified.
　　　⇒　The sortie point options on the re-sortie window has been changed when a point (relay point, own ship)
　　　　　is neutralized or destroyed.
　　　■Before
　　　　Once the usable access point is lost, the cursor will be automatically moved to the home base,
　　　　so when the timing of the attempted sortie coincides with the timing of the loss of the access point,
　　　　the player may unintentionally launch again at the home base.
　　　■Now
　　　　If the re-sortie point to which the cursor is pointing is no longer available,
　　　　then the re-sortie selection will be disabled for a certain period of time.
　　　　This will help the cases of unintentional sorties to the home base, which had occurred due to the timing of re-sortie.
　　　　※Pilots can move the cursor at will to release the selection disablement immediately.
　
　
■New Materials for exchange are added to Recycle Counter.
　⇒ Information about newly added materials
　■Unit
　　・★★★Alex [CA] LV1 added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/2ff56eb6aff80335a06f99f9880cff098b262ca5.png[/img]
　※The materials mentioned above will be available at Recycle Counter for 2 days, from [JST] 06/27/2024 – 06/28/2024.
　
■New Materials for exchange are added to DP exchange Counter.
　⇒ Information about newly added materials
　■Unit
　　・★★★Geara Zulu (Angelo) LV2 added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/23ecaefb81826e7e0b0c1383bf860a9e2700af7f.png[/img]
　■Main weapon
　　・★★Lange Bruno Gun Kai LV2 added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/04ff4d9d8e75b85281dbba299209a43e8ea4de64.png[/img]
　
　
■Rating Match/Quick Match Game Modes are updated.
　※There may be differences about the game mode with the information above,
　　which were introduced during the previous update regarding [Possible Game Modes].
　
■Situation Battle is now updated.
　⇒　The topic of the week is “Conspiracy Sector”.
　※For more details about this week’s Situation Battle, please click here.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/4231776500618005673
　
　
■Schedule for this week's weekend-only battle
　◎Weekend-only battle schedule
　　[PDT] 06/27/2024 12:00 – 06/30/2024 11:59
　　[CEST] 06/27/2023 21:00 – 06/30/2024 20:59
　◎Special Rules
　　・"Mix-up", "Simple Battle", "Shuffle Target", "Brawl Match" and "Duel Match" will be held in every 2 hours.
　　・Situation Battle “Conspiracy Sector” will be held.
　
　
■Fixes
　◎Custom parts
　　・In the “Optimized Underwater Ordnance”, the effect given by the custom parts was different from
　　　that of the MS originally outfitted with the underwater aptitude and now is fixed.
　◎Painting
　　・In “Loto (Transformed)”, some color changes were not reflected when painting and now is fixed.
　◎Others
　　・In the TIPS displayed in the Sortie Preparation Room, the text related to underwater suitability which was changed
　　　in previous updates and was outdated, now this function is no longer needed.
　　　Due to this consideration, the content of TIPS has been corrected and deleted respectively.
　　・When selecting "Ambient Occlusion" in H.A.R.O. > Options > Graphic Settings,
　　　the Japanese description displayed at the top of the screen was partially garbled and now is corrected.

　
The latest information will be posted on STEAM News and our Twitter in the future.
https://twitter.com/pc_gbo2

We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

　　[CEST] 06/20/2024 10:00 – 06/27/2024 06:30 [Scheduled]

　　Once STEP3 finished and this STEP UP Supply Drop will be over.

　　　　・★★★ Hazel Owsla LV1 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost: 550)
　　　　・★★★ Psycho Zaku Mk-II [TB] LV1 (Raid unit, ground only, cost: 500)

　　　■★★★★ MS
　　　　・★★★★ Phenex [NT] LV1 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)

Starting from [PDT] 06/20/2024 / [CEST] 06/20/2024, 
STEP UP Supply Drop with Maximum 5 times Drop rate will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/bab308f11a43a3ffd8c27abaaf8e5ef161e4de44.png[/img]

　　[PDT] 06/20/2024 01:00 – 06/26/2024 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 06/20/2024 10:00 – 06/27/2024 06:30 [Scheduled]

notes.title: Application Data Update and Server Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
　
Server maintenance will be performed on the following schedule.
　
◇Date & Time
[PDT] 05/29/2024 22:00 – 05/30/2024 01:00 [Scheduled]
[CEST] 05/30/2024 07:00 – 05/30/2024 10:00 [Scheduled]
　
◇Maintenance Details
・【Update file ver.0178】
・Supply Drop Lineup Update
　
　※Please note that you will not be able to log in to the game during the maintenance.
　※The end time may vary depending on the maintenance status. Please understand this in advance.
　※Entering the maintenance during matching may cause unexpected errors.
　　Please log out of the game before maintenance.
　
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
　

　
　
[PDT] 05/30/2024 / [CEST] 05/30/2024 Updated content is listed below.
　
　
■【Update file ver.0178】
　
　
■1st Anniversary Celebration
　Thank you for all pilots' playing and support, and also welcoming all new pilots who are joining GBO2,
　we are now starting "1st Anniversary Celebration"!
　
　■Period
　　[PDT] 05/30/2024 01:00 – 07/03/2024 21:59 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 05/30/2024 10:00 – 07/04/2024 06:59 [Scheduled]
　※For more details, please check here.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/4147330837532126215
　
　
■Guaranteed Nu Gundam [HWS] Boosted Supply Drop Notice
Starting from [PDT] 05/30/2024 / [CEST] 05/30/2024, Guaranteed Nu Gundam [HWS] Boosted Supply Drop will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/501960c9079a2af0674e1b32f04491508b6d9f04.png[/img]
　
　■Period
　　[PDT] 05/30/2024 01:00 – 06/05/2024 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 05/30/2024 10:00 – 06/06/2024 06:30 [Scheduled]
　■Contents
　　A Supply Drop, in which 10 consecutive Supply Drops can be requested up to STEP7.
　　The STEP will progress by 1 each time you perform a request,
　　as STEP1 → STEP2 → STEP3 → STEP4 → STEP5 → STEP6 → STEP7.
　　Once STEP7 finished and this STEP UP Supply Drop will be over.
　
　　・STEP1 (15 Tokens): Token 50% OFF!
　　・STEP2 (30 Tokens): As a bonus 50 Mechanic Tickets [★★★★] are obtainable!
　　・STEP3 (30 Tokens): As a bonus 50 Modification Kit [★★★★] are obtainable!
　　・STEP4 (30 Tokens): 2x Chance of obtaining “★★★★” materials!
　　・STEP5 (30 Tokens): 3x Chance of obtaining “★★★★” materials!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ As a bonus 100 Mechanic Tickets [★★★★] are obtainable!
　　・STEP6 (30 Tokens): 3x Chance of obtaining “★★★★” materials!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ As a bonus 100 Modification Kit [★★★★] are obtaianble!
　　・STEP7 (30 Tokens): 1 Guaranteed Obtainable “Nu Gundam [HWS] LV1” !!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ As a bonus Custom Part “Ranged ATK-DEF Program LV1” is obtainable!
　
　■Custom parts
　◎Ranged ATK-DEF Program LV1
　　・Increased ranged attack boost by 5.
　　　Reduce ranged damage by 5%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/7d5d4f1ba56bcfc22fb7be3888b015ea6efc7159.png[/img]
　※Same supplies will be drawn as the ongoing Supply Drops.
　　　For more details, please check [Item List].
　
　
■Notice of “Limited Supply Drop!! Loto”
Starting from [PDT] 05/30/2024 01:00 / [CEST] 05/30/2024 10:00,
a Limited Supply Drop with a MS drop rate boosted event will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/ef33cb05bcc5de309b26cf7703107edb8bbb1ab7.jpg[/img]
　
　■Period
　　[PDT] 05/30/2024 01:00 – 06/05/2024 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 05/30/2024 10:00 – 06/06/2024 06:30 [Scheduled]
　■Contents
　　During the period, “Limited Supply Drop (Once / 10 Times)” can be requested from the material counter.
　　Within the Limited Supply Drop, Loto’s drop rate will be increased.
　■Featured material with a Big Boost to its supply drop rate
　　In the Limited Supply Drop, the specified unit and its related main weapon will be affected.
　　◎Supply drop rate increase① (Item Amount 1)
　　・★★★ Loto LV1 (Support unit, ground/space uses, cost: 500)
　　◎Supply drop rate increase② (Item Amount 1)
　　・★★★ Loto LV2 (Support unit, ground/space uses, cost: 550)
　　◎Supply drop rate increase③ (Item Amount 2)
　　・★ Missile Container [Large M] LV2
　　・★ Beam Burner LV2
　■Supply Drops that are affected by the drop rate increase
　　・Limited Supply Drop
　※Materials those can be received from this Limited Supply Drop will be as same as the current normal Supply Drop lineup.
　　　Differing from the standard Supply Drop, only the specified items in the Limited Supply Drop will be boosted.
　※Drop rate increases of the Limited Supply Drop will affect the units of each LV and also the units’ main weapon differently.
　　e.g. While unit’s LV1–2 and main weapon are affected by the drop rate increases.
　　　・LV1 unit’s drop rate increased by “3%”
　　　・LV2 unit’s drop rate increased by “3%”
　　　・Main weapons’ drop rate Increase “3％”
　　The Supply Drop drop rate increases is made by the reducing the drop rate of “★” rarity items.
　※Regarding the detailed lineup of the Limited Supply Drop, please check [Item List].
　※The amount of tokens required to request a Limited Supply Drop is the same as normal Supply Drop.
　　(Once – 3 tokens / 10 Times – 30 tokens)
　※Please make sure to have a check to the last day of this Limited Supply Drop period.
　
　
■Notice of Supply Drop Lineup “Nu Gundam [HWS]”
Supply Drop Lineup has been updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/4fb6ee562baa23b81864c33e8baf66f59a07cfbd.jpg[/img]
　■Period
　　[PDT] 05/30/2024 01:00 – 06/05/2024 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 05/30/2024 10:00 – 06/06/2024 06:30 [Scheduled]
　■Added New Materials
　　■Unit
　　・★★★★ Nu Gundam [HWS] LV1 (Support unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)
　　　※The above MS is eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・Support unit with cost of 700.
　　・In anticipation of a long, drawn-out war with Neo Zeon forces, 
　　　this unit was designed in accordance with the FSWS Plan,
　　　enhancing the functionality of Nu Gundam, using weaponry and additional armor.
　　・Weapon upgrades include an enlarged ranged weapon, 
　　　and an large-caliber mega particle cannon attached to the left arm,
　　　also the chest features missile-loaded units, and some other weaponry enhancements to other body parts.
　　　Various measures were taken to counter an increase in weight caused by the additional armor,
　　　such as loading the armor with propellant, and internalizing thrusters to improve overall thrust.
　　・This project was a vector for adding functions to the excesses of the U.C. 0090s, and
　　　was at odds with the original concept of the Nu Gundam, 
　　　but the compatibility with the Nu Gundam itself was very good.
　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
https://bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2024/03/6e2dbff0eeef5e74f19c5d7d2c72a794.mp4

　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　　　※Keep that in mind that the release time of the unit is scheduled.
　
　Sub-weapon “Fin Funnels [Defend]”
　・Deploy Fin Funnels to form a barrier around the unit.
　　Barrier will block ranged attacks and consume the remain ammunition,
　　once ammunition reach zero, then the barrier will be deactivated.
　　Barrier will be deactivated when getting hit by close combat or reloading the weapon.
　
　Skill “Resist Move” LV2
　・Press "Accelerate" twice to perform Resist Move.
　　Reaction is nullified during Resist Move and reduce the damage taken.
　
　Skill “Release Ranged Output Limiter”
　・The main ranged weapon “Hyper Mega Rifle”, carried by this MS,
　　has the following changes in weapon performance depending on the focusing stage.
　　■Normal firing
　　・5 beams in a rapid bursts.
　　・No direct staggering effect, but will do accumulation stagger.
　　■1st focusing stage
　　・Boosting power and attack range
　　・Only 1 beam shot but will deal stagger to target when hit.
　　■2nd focusing stage
　　・even much power and attack range, also having larger hitting radius
　　・Beam shot will have penetrate effect.
　
　■Removed Materials from the Supply Drop
　　Some materials are removed from the supply drop lineup.
　　　※For more information regarding the updated supply drop lineup, please refer to the [Supply Drop List].
　
　■Exclusive pilot item as a Bonus for the 10 Consecutive Supply Drops!
　　Beginning from [PDT] 05/30/2024 01:00 / [CEST] 05/30/2024 10:00,
　　1 random exclusive pilot item as a bonus can be obtained from 10 consecutive drops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/94b7365cf005bdcb6d3f78c633f88c89ae664922.png[/img]
　■Period
　　[PDT] 05/30/2024 01:00 – 06/05/2024 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 05/30/2024 10:00 – 06/06/2024 06:30 [Scheduled]
　　■Supply Drop with Bonus Items
　　　Normal 10-consecutive Supply Drops
　　■Bonus Item Contents (get 1 of the 2 items randomly listed below)
　　　■Wear
　　　　Normal suit: Federation D02
　　　■Accessory
　　　　Helmet: Federation D02
　　　※Requesting 10-Consecutive Supply Drops during the campaign will grant you an additional 11th supply drop,
　　　　and get 1 extra item.
　　　※Does NOT apply to the 1-Attempt Supply Drop.
　　　　The bonus item will not be awarded even if you request the 1-Attempt Supply Drop ten times in a row.
　
　■Other material

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/a014b208b74bf684216cf5abd2b62400f7dd11d3.png[/img]
　
　■Notice of [Big Boost to Supply Drop Rates Campaign]

■Updates

　　◎Achievement rewards for Battle Simulator is now updated.

　　　■Achievement rewards

　■Unit adjustment related

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/e6ce1c923582284ae50650d83db4c47f7d741a3f.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/4148457371246837483

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/0a8a1c1b5fa905042aa0c53611e1ed7d9ed2989f.png[/img]

　　　⇒　New report items added to the report window in battle result and allow pilots to make a even detailed report.
　　　　※For the reason and other information about this change,
　　　　　　please have a check to [Developer Newsletter] Regarding the Update of March on PS version.
　　　　　https://bo2.ggame.jp/en/info/?p=137766

　　■Report items
　　　・Left Match Early/AFK(from abandoning the battle)
　　　　Players who are not moving in a battle, or abandoning the entire battle
　　　・Report Chat(Chat spam)
　　　　Actions such as repeatedly discourage allies in chat incite them
　　　▼New elements▼

　　　・Obstructive Behavior

　　■How to use

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/55ffd4b9494cd9403a88bb00dabe77073f20bf1d.png[/img]

Hello, Pilots!

　[CEST] 05/30/2024 10:00 – 07/04/2024 06:59 [Scheduled]

　■Period
　　[PDT] 05/23/2024 01:00 – 05/29/2024 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CEST] 05/23/2024 10:00 – 05/30/2024 06:30 [Scheduled]
　　■Contents
　　During the period, “Limited Supply Drop (Once / 10 Times)” can be requested from the material counter.
　　Within the Limited Supply Drop, Silver Bullet Suppressor’s drop rate will be increased.
　■Featured material with a Big Boost to its supply drop rate
　　In the Limited Supply Drop, the specified unit and its related main weapon will be affected.
　　◎Supply drop rate increase① (Item Amount 1)
　　・★★★ Silver Bullet Suppressor LV1 (Support unit, ground/space uses, cost: 650)
　　◎Supply drop rate increase② (Item Amount 1)

　　Differing from the standard Supply Drop, only the specified items in the Limited Supply Drop will be boosted.
　※Drop rate increases of the Limited Supply Drop will affect the units of each LV and also the units’ main weapon differently.
　　e.g. While unit’s LV1–2 and main weapon are affected by the drop rate increases.
　　　・LV1 unit’s drop rate increased by “3%”

This is the Steam® version oeperations team.

notes.title: Notice About Suspension of Some Accounts（2024/4/4）
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
This is the Steam® version oeperations team.
　
Currently, we are receiving reports indicating that regular gameplay is being disrupted due to unauthorized behavior.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused to users who are enjoying the game normally.
　
We have been conducting investigations based on the reports we have received and information 
from our internal investigation criteria, and in response to these disruptive actions, 
we have been monitoring the action logs as appropriate on the management side.
We would like to report that for the accounts where issues were confirmed, 
measures to halt gameplay have been successfully implemented.

■ Actions Taken: Permanent Usage Suspension, etc.
　
As this online competitive game thrives through everyone's collaboration
the management will continue to investigate accounts that are deemed to be 
violating the terms of use or engaging in disruptive behavior towards others. 
If disruptive or interfering actions are confirmed, 
we may halt gameplay for the relevant accounts without prior notice. 
We kindly ask for your understanding in advance.
　
Furthermore, we extend our gratitude to users who have provided information about those
engaging in disruptive or interfering behavior and have cooperated with our investigations. 
We would like to take this opportunity to thank you.
※Please note that if there are repeated instances of false reports, penalties may be imposed on the reporting users as well.
　
If you come across players who might be engaging in unfair practices or using unauthorized tools 
during gameplay in the future, we kindly request your cooperation in providing information 
through the "Contact Form" mentioned below.
　
▼Contact (Inquiry)
https://bnfaq.channel.or.jp/title/2823
　
We are committed to applying penalties to those involved in unfair practices and tool usage, for the sake of our players. 
We ask for your continued support for "Mobile Suit Gundam: Battle Operation 2." 
Thank you.

notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
This is the Steam® version oeperations team.
　
Currently, we are receiving reports indicating that regular gameplay is being disrupted due to unauthorized behavior.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused to users who are enjoying the game normally.
　
We have been conducting investigations based on the reports we have received and information 
from our internal investigation criteria, and in response to these disruptive actions, 
we have been monitoring the action logs as appropriate on the management side.

If disruptive or interfering actions are confirmed, 
we may halt gameplay for the relevant accounts without prior notice. 
We kindly ask for your understanding in advance.
　
Furthermore, we extend our gratitude to users who have provided information about those
engaging in disruptive or interfering behavior and have cooperated with our investigations. 
We would like to take this opportunity to thank you.
※Please note that if there are repeated instances of false reports, penalties may be imposed on the reporting users as well.
　
If you come across players who might be engaging in unfair practices or using unauthorized tools

through the "Contact Form" mentioned below.

We are committed to applying penalties to those involved in unfair practices and tool usage, for the sake of our players.

notes.title: About some account recovery due to accounts misbanned by system （2024/3/7）
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
　
From [JST] 2023/12/05 to 2024/02/21,
we found some cases of some accounts were detected and jugded as cheating by the system,
and had been misbanned by the system afterward.
　
■ Target accounts
・187 misbanned accounts
　
We had investigated the data such as action log to analyze this issue.
We truly apologize to players who had misbanned by system and become unplayable for a certain period
for all these inconveniences and bringing you concerns.
　
We, development team, has unbanned those accounts on [JST] 2024/02/22 and [JST] 2024/02/29 after our rejudgement.
　
We apologize for taking a long time to find the trouble core and delayed the unbanning.
Again, we deeply express our regret to players who affected by this issue.
Besides, players who got misbanned can play from the last savedata in the game.
　
For this, we would like to humbly pay the compensation to misbanned players.
　
■ Compensation
◎Target
Account got misbanned during [JST] 2023/12/05 - 2024/02/22
　
◎Content
　Misbanned days x 3 tokens
　
◎Period for claiming the compensation
　After the server maintenance on [JST] 2024/03/07 – 2024/05/09 13:59
　
◎Additional information
　System will automatically distribute the compensation to target accounts while players login to GBO2
　after the server maintenance on [JST] 2024/03/07.
　※Compensation can be claimed from Reward Center.
　
　
We will take this issue seriously 
and put all efforts to avoid another same happening.
　
　
We look forward to your continue support to "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/2b5aff406b347f28c12d909af2deeb63e3af751a.png[/img]

　　[CET] 02/29/2024 09:00 – 03/07/2024 05:30 [Scheduled]

　　・STEP5 (30 Tokens): 3x Chance of obtaining "★★★★" materials!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ As a bonus 100 Mechanic Tickets [★★★★] are obtainable!
　　・STEP6 (30 Tokens): 3x Chance of obtaining "★★★★" materials!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ As a bonus 100 Modification Kit [★★★★] are obtaianble!
　　・STEP7 (30 Tokens): 1 Guaranteed Obtainable "Banshee Norn LV1" !!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　+ As a bonus Custom Part "Composite Frame [Type-B] LV1"  is obtainable!
　■Custom parts
　◎Composite Frame [Type-B] LV1
　・Increases the HP recovery rate of the repair tool by 15%.
　　MS HP goes up 200, and melee strength goes up 2.
　　If Enhancement List level reaches 3, MS HP increases by 300 more and melee strength increases 3.
　　When reaching Level 6, MS HP goes up another 500 and melee strength increases by 5.
　　Note that multiple Composite Frame parts cannot be equipped at once.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/8892f77d2bef40b30d52042deedd39e389fe6fe1.png[/img]
　※Same supplies will be drawn as the ongoing Supply Drops. For Details, please check [Item List].
　
　
■Notice of Supply Drop Lineup “Banshee Norn”
Supply Drop Lineup has been updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/0bfdf0aa13cf136eed25fe18bb4dea99c3e24e5f.jpg[/img]
　■Period
　　[PST] 02/29/2024 00:00 – 03/06/2024 20:30 [Scheduled]
　　[CET] 02/29/2024 09:00 – 03/07/2024 05:30 [Scheduled]

　　■Unit
　　・★★★★ Banshee Norn LV1 (General unit, ground/space use, Cost 700)
　　※The above MS is eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
　
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・General unit with cost of 700.
　　・An upgraded variant of the Unicorn Gundam 02 Banshee, 
　　　with revised weaponry and specifications to enhance its basic performance and operability.
　　・The RX-0 series was originally designed to be boarded by Cyber-Newtype,
　　　but the specifications were changed so that non-Cyber-Newtype could also use this unit.
　　・The Armed Armor BS, once equipped for ranged combat,
　　　and Armed Armor VN adapted for melee weaponry were scrapped,
　　　to improve the capability of continuous fighting which had been a trouble on the RX-0 unit.
　　　And two newly-added Armed Armors including a multiple function shield, the DE Type.
　　　Also the XC Type,
　　　increasing generator output and expanding psycho-wave send/receive capabilities using Psycho-Frame.
　　・As a result, the unit is easier to operate for those who may not possess remarkable Newtype abilities,
　　　and transitioning to Destroy Mode is quite easy, improving its overall performance as an anti-Newtype machine.
　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
https://bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2023/12/67fd98e816d649efeb97c1319781c30c.mp4

　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　　　※Keep that in mind that the release time of the unit is scheduled.
　　Sub-weapon "Beam Jutte"
　　・Can only be used as melee weapons under "NT-D" or "Awakening", rapid combo is not possible.
　・Hold the attack button down, then release it to briefly enter guard stance.
　　　Thrusters are consumed while in guard stance, 
　　　but when taking a melee attack, damage/stagger reactions are nullified.
　　　Then thrusters will fully recover and counterattack will be made.
　　・This effect will not work if hit by launched melee weapons or tackled.
　　◎Tutorial video of sub-weapon "Beam Jutte"
　　【Basic】
　　　・If an enemy attacks with a melee attack, use the "guard stance" to counter it!
　　　　Then your enemy will receive a counterattack and down, giving you a chance to hit hard again!
https://bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2023/12/cf8027efddcfbd46cc2170329afa62c7.mp4

　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　　【Practical】
　　・You can still move during using Beam Jutte and holding the attack button (but not while in guard stance),

notes.title: Application Data Update and Server Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
　
Server maintenance will be performed on the following schedule.
　
◇Date & Time
[PST] 02/07/2024 21:00 – 02/08/2024 00:00 [Scheduled] 
[CET] 02/08/2024 06:00 – 02/08/2024 09:00 [Scheduled] 
　
◇Maintenance Details
・Server and data maintenance support
・Supply Drop Lineup Update
　
　※Please note that you will not be able to log in to the game during the maintenance.
　※The end time may vary depending on the maintenance status. Please understand this in advance.
　※Entering the maintenance during matching may cause unexpected errors.
　　Please log out of the game before maintenance.
　
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

　　　　　　　　& 100 Mechanic Tickets [★★] as bonus!
　　・STEP3 (30 Tokens): 1 random bonus custom parts guaranteed when requested 10 consecutive Limited Supply Drop
　　　　　　　　& 100 Modification Kit [★★] as bonus!
　　・STEP4 (30 Tokens): 1 random bonus custom parts guaranteed when requested 10 consecutive Limited Supply Drop
　　　　　　　　& 100 Mechanic Tickets [★★★] as bonus!
　　・STEP5 (30 Tokens): 1 random bonus custom parts guaranteed when requested 10 consecutive Limited Supply Drop

　　　　Adds an additional 4% per unit level.

　　　　Adds an additional 4% per unit level.
　　　　Bonus for multiples of part cap at 15%.

　　　　Reduces damage from melee weapons by 3%.
　　　　Adds an additional 4% per unit level.
　　　　Bonus for multiples of part cap at 15%.

　　　　Increases ranged damage to enemies by 1%.
　　　　Adds an additional 3% per unit level.
　　　　Bonus for multiples of part cap at 10%.

　　　Overtuning (Thrusters) LV1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/c304e601419bd7161d1ad4c38ef0c522a35e4cd9.png[/img]
　　　　Boosts thrusters by 3.
　　　　Provides another 4 per unit level.
　　　　Bonus for multiples of part cap at 15.

　　　Overtuning (Frame) LV1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/cfb0328c8570752b196986ec94d2c586c8994e05.png[/img]
　　　　Increases unit's HP by 300.
　　　　Adds an additional 900 HP per unit level.
　　　　Bonus for multiples of part cap at 3000.

　　　Composite Frame [Type-A] LV1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/c61d629020a6d361846378ebf5a2c56e98bc211f.png[/img]
　　　　Increases HP recovery rate of the repair tool by 15%.
　　　　MS HP goes up 200, and ranged compensation goes up 2.
　　　　If Enhancement level reaches 3, MS HP increases by 300 more, and ranged compensation increases 3.
　　　　When reaching level 6, MS HP goes up 500, and ranged compensation increases by 5.

　　　Educational Computer LV1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/c7c245f848a96b971e56b6fed8c82e31a0a7f501.png[/img]
　　　　Increases damage to enemies by 3%.
　　　　Reduces damage to MS HP by 3%.
　　　　The effect increases 4 minutes after the battle begins.

　　　Heavy Armor LV1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/41000a513cdd0742aa060e62a495ab45893e96f8.png[/img]
　　　　Increases ballistic/beam/melee resistance by 1.
　　　　Adds an additional 3 per unit level.
　　　　Bonus for multiples of parts cap at 10.

　　　Psycho Package LV1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/0058e74e1992893591956dce6ed1de10c36b3cf1.png[/img]
　　　　Reduces enemy Psycommu weapon disable time and reduces their damage by 10%.
　　　　Increases MS HP by 1200.

a Limited Supply Drop with Boosted Drop Rate for a part of MS related drops will begin.

notes.title: Notice About Suspension of Some Accounts（2024/2/1）
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
This is the Steam® version oeperations team.
　
Currently, we are receiving reports indicating that regular gameplay is being disrupted due to unauthorized behavior.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused to users who are enjoying the game normally.
　
We have been conducting investigations based on the reports we have received and information 
from our internal investigation criteria, and in response to these disruptive actions, 
we have been monitoring the action logs as appropriate on the management side.
We would like to report that for the accounts where issues were confirmed, 
measures to halt gameplay have been successfully implemented.
　
As of 31th Janualy, 2024 [JST]
　
■Number of Account Suspension Cases

[/tr]
[/table]
　
■ Actions Taken: Permanent Usage Suspension, etc.
　
As this online competitive game thrives through everyone's collaboration
the management will continue to investigate accounts that are deemed to be 
violating the terms of use or engaging in disruptive behavior towards others. 
If disruptive or interfering actions are confirmed, 
we may halt gameplay for the relevant accounts without prior notice. 
We kindly ask for your understanding in advance.
　
Furthermore, we extend our gratitude to users who have provided information about those
engaging in disruptive or interfering behavior and have cooperated with our investigations. 
We would like to take this opportunity to thank you.
※Please note that if there are repeated instances of false reports, penalties may be imposed on the reporting users as well.
　
If you come across players who might be engaging in unfair practices or using unauthorized tools 
during gameplay in the future, we kindly request your cooperation in providing information 
through the "Contact Form" mentioned below.
　
▼Contact (Inquiry)
https://bnfaq.channel.or.jp/title/2823
　
We are committed to applying penalties to those involved in unfair practices and tool usage, for the sake of our players. 
We ask for your continued support for "Mobile Suit Gundam: Battle Operation 2." 
Thank you.

　　　overhauling the Geara Zulu to improve upon the concept of the Hamma-Hamma.
　　・The base was a Geara Zulu equipped with a Psycho-frame using repurposed spare parts of the Sinanju.
　　　The arm parts in particular followed the Hamma-Hamma’s design,
　　　and demonstrated unexpected maneuverability thanks to the multiple thrusters in its peculiar shoulder parts.
　　・The Rozen Zulu's wired beam cannon allowed for all-range combat, 
　　　and was equipped with special Psycho-jammers on its back as the joker against the Unicorn Gundam.
　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
https://bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2023/11/231123_Roze0vbms88823TAEi94ncYYcw.mp4
　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　　　※Keep that in mind that the release time of the unit is scheduled.

　　・unable to use NT-D Ability Boost skill.

　　・Damage dealt to favorable type is reduced,

notes.title: Notice About Suspension of Some Accounts（2024/1/4）
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
This is the Steam® version oeperations team.
　
Currently, we are receiving reports indicating that regular gameplay is being disrupted due to unauthorized behavior.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused to users who are enjoying the game normally.
　
We have been conducting investigations based on the reports we have received and information 
from our internal investigation criteria, and in response to these disruptive actions, 
we have been monitoring the action logs as appropriate on the management side.
We would like to report that for the accounts where issues were confirmed, 
measures to halt gameplay have been successfully implemented.
　
As of 28th December, 2023 [JST]
　
■Number of Account Suspension Cases

[tr]
[td]Date[/td]

[td]～July 2023[/td]

[/tr]
[tr]

[td]930　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]December 2023[/td]
[td]347　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
　
■ Actions Taken: Permanent Usage Suspension, etc.
　
As this online competitive game thrives through everyone's collaboration
the management will continue to investigate accounts that are deemed to be 
violating the terms of use or engaging in disruptive behavior towards others. 
If disruptive or interfering actions are confirmed, 
we may halt gameplay for the relevant accounts without prior notice. 
We kindly ask for your understanding in advance.
　
Furthermore, we extend our gratitude to users who have provided information about those
engaging in disruptive or interfering behavior and have cooperated with our investigations. 
We would like to take this opportunity to thank you.
※Please note that if there are repeated instances of false reports, penalties may be imposed on the reporting users as well.
　
If you come across players who might be engaging in unfair practices or using unauthorized tools 
during gameplay in the future, we kindly request your cooperation in providing information 
through the "Contact Form" mentioned below.
　
▼Contact (Inquiry)
https://bnfaq.channel.or.jp/title/2823
　
We are committed to applying penalties to those involved in unfair practices and tool usage, for the sake of our players. 
We ask for your continued support for "Mobile Suit Gundam: Battle Operation 2." 
Thank you.

notes.title: Notice About Suspension of Some Accounts（2023/12/7）
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
This is the Steam® version oeperations team.
　
Currently, we are receiving reports indicating that regular gameplay is being disrupted due to unauthorized behavior.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused to users who are enjoying the game normally.
　
We have been conducting investigations based on the reports we have received and information 
from our internal investigation criteria, and in response to these disruptive actions, 
we have been monitoring the action logs as appropriate on the management side.
We would like to report that for the accounts where issues were confirmed, 
measures to halt gameplay have been successfully implemented.
　
As of 7th December, 2023 [JST]
　
■Number of Account Suspension Cases
[table]
[tr]
[td]Date[/td]
[td]Number of Accounts Addressed[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]～July 2023[/td]
[td]350　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]August 2023[/td]
[td]4,477　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]September 2023[/td]
[td]1,463　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]October 2023[/td]
[td]921　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]November 2023[/td]
[td]930　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
　
■ Actions Taken: Permanent Usage Suspension, etc.
　
As this online competitive game thrives through everyone's collaboration
the management will continue to investigate accounts that are deemed to be 
violating the terms of use or engaging in disruptive behavior towards others. 
If disruptive or interfering actions are confirmed, 
we may halt gameplay for the relevant accounts without prior notice. 
We kindly ask for your understanding in advance.
　
Furthermore, we extend our gratitude to users who have provided information about those
engaging in disruptive or interfering behavior and have cooperated with our investigations. 
We would like to take this opportunity to thank you.
※Please note that if there are repeated instances of false reports, penalties may be imposed on the reporting users as well.
　
If you come across players who might be engaging in unfair practices or using unauthorized tools 
during gameplay in the future, we kindly request your cooperation in providing information 
through the "Contact Form" mentioned below.
　
▼Contact (Inquiry)
https://bnfaq.channel.or.jp/title/2823
　
We are committed to applying penalties to those involved in unfair practices and tool usage, for the sake of our players. 
We ask for your continued support for "Mobile Suit Gundam: Battle Operation 2." 
Thank you.

notes.title: Application Data Update and Server Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
　
Server maintenance will be performed on the following schedule.
　
◇Date & Time
[PST] 11/29/2023 21:00 – 11/30/2023 00:00 [Scheduled] 
[CET] 11/30/2023 06:00 – 11/30/2023 09:00 [Scheduled] 
　
◇Maintenance Details
【Update file ver.0172】
　Server and data update maintenance
　Supply Drop Lineup Update
　
　※Please note that you will not be able to log in to the game during the maintenance.
　※The end time may vary depending on the maintenance status. Please understand this in advance.
　※Maintenance starts while pilot is still in a battle may cause unexpected errors.
　　We strongly recommend to log out GBO2 before maintenance.
　
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
　
　
[PST] 11/30/2023 / [CET] 11/30/2023 Updated content is listed below.
　
　
■【Update file ver.0172】
　
　
■2nd Special Support Week notice
"GBO Autumn Festival" is starting from [PST] 11/30/2023 00:00 / [CET] 11/30/2023 06:00.

　　　　[CET] 11/30/2023 09:00 – 12/14/2023 05:30 [Scheduled]

　　　During the Period, Special Supply Drops (10 Times) that include all MS and Weapons
　　　that are appeared by previous Supply Drops can be requested for free once a week. (Up to 20!)
　　　Furthermore, 1 guaranteed MS of ★★ or above rarity + 1 guaranteed MS of ★★★ or above rarity can be dropped!
　　　(Maximum 2 ★★ or above MS + 2 ★★★ or above MS!)
　※This Special Supply Drop will be updated and pilots can request the next one
　　on every Thursday [PST] 00:00 / [CET] 06:00 [Scheduled] during the campaign.
　※This Special Supply Drop will contain all MS and armaments on the lineup updated 
　　after [JST] 07/30/2020 on other platform.
　　(Supplies to be drawn in the special Supply Drops include all MS and armaments that have been previously excluded.)
　※Regarding the lineup of Special Supply Drops and Drop Rates, please check [Item List].
　
　2. Limited Special Mission
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/2936b9d7ef695e0726986790c999f77784d82048.png[/img]
　　Starting from [PST] 11/30/2023 / [CET] 11/30/2023, "Limited Special Mission" will begin.

　　　　[CET] 11/30/2023 09:00 – 12/14/2023 05:59 [Scheduled]
　　■Content
　　　We have a special mission for you during the period.
　　　You will have a chance to gain "Desert Zaku" and other rewards by completing the special mission
　　　during the campaign.
　　■Mission reward
　　　■Unit
　　　・★★  Desert Zaku  LV1–2 (General unit, Ground Use, cost 400–)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/92b2a6a203d90bfba76c7028830661cc08be319e.png[/img]

■Notice of “Limited Supply Drop!! Moon Gundam”

■Guaranteed Full Armor ZZ Gundam Boosted Supply Drop Notice
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/dc67384c4090576b73a52ff1da13af701250468c.png[/img]
Starting from [PST] 11/30/2023 / [CET] 11/30/2023,

■Notice of Supply Drop Lineup “Full Armor ZZ Gundam”

Supply Drop Lineup has been updated.
　■Period

　　　[CET] 11/30/2023 09:00 – 12/07/2023 05:30 [Scheduled]

　　　※The above MS is eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　・Support Unit with cost of 700.
　　・A variant of ZZ Gundam, taking the ultimate firepower of the 4th generation MS 
　　　and bolstering its specs to extraordinary levels, improving its capabilities in extended combat.

　　　and also covered in armor to compensate for the structural weaknesses inherent in the transformation mechanism.
　　　Supplemental thrusters prevent reduced mobility from the additional weight, 
　　　with augmented propellant tank capacity to match.

　　　and has a High Mega Cannon in its abdomen and a variety of missiles,
　　　making it an overwhelmingly powerful machine that is suitable for decisive battles.
　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
https://bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2023/09/230928_Flaep099gXXsek27gk8xXZkinY3.mp4

　　　※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
　　　※Keep that in mind that the release time of the unit is scheduled.
　Skill "Linked Fire"

　　※Like Full Armor ZZ Gundam's  sub-weapon "Head High Mega Cannon".

　　・Explosion is detected at the point where the beam lands.

notes.title: Notice About Suspension of Some Accounts（2023/11/2）
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
This is the Steam® version oeperations team.
　
Currently, we are receiving reports indicating that regular gameplay is being disrupted due to unauthorized behavior.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused to users who are enjoying the game normally.
　
We have been conducting investigations based on the reports we have received and information 
from our internal investigation criteria, and in response to these disruptive actions, 
we have been monitoring the action logs as appropriate on the management side.
We would like to report that for the accounts where issues were confirmed, 
measures to halt gameplay have been successfully implemented.
　
As of November 2th, 2023 [JST]
　
■Number of Account Suspension Cases
[table]
[tr]
[td]Date[/td]
[td]Number of Accounts Addressed[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]～July 2023[/td]
[td]350　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]August 2023[/td]
[td]4,477　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]September 2023[/td]
[td]1,463　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]October 2023[/td]
[td]921　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
　
■ Actions Taken: Permanent Usage Suspension, etc.
　
As this online competitive game thrives through everyone's collaboration
the management will continue to investigate accounts that are deemed to be 
violating the terms of use or engaging in disruptive behavior towards others. 
If disruptive or interfering actions are confirmed, 
we may halt gameplay for the relevant accounts without prior notice. 
We kindly ask for your understanding in advance.
　
Furthermore, we extend our gratitude to users who have provided information about those
engaging in disruptive or interfering behavior and have cooperated with our investigations. 
We would like to take this opportunity to thank you.
※Please note that if there are repeated instances of false reports, penalties may be imposed on the reporting users as well.
　
If you come across players who might be engaging in unfair practices or using unauthorized tools 
during gameplay in the future, we kindly request your cooperation in providing information 
through the "Contact Form" mentioned below.
　
▼Contact (Inquiry)
https://bnfaq.channel.or.jp/title/2823
　
We are committed to applying penalties to those involved in unfair practices and tool usage, for the sake of our players. 
We ask for your continued support for "Mobile Suit Gundam: Battle Operation 2." 
Thank you.

notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.

and we have stopped this Supply Drop event on [JST]10/13/2023 14:40.

We apologize for all inconveniences that we have caused to all pilots.
　
For that, we will send compensation to those targeted pilots.
　
■Compensation
◎Target
　Pilots who had requested this STEP UP Supply Drop during [JST] 10/12/2023 17:00 to 10/13/2023 14:40.

notes.title: Notice of suspension of the 【Autumn Festival】 Part 3 - Boosted Supply Drop!
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
　
We have confirmed the following bug with the "[Autumn Festival] Part 3- Boosted Supply Drop!"", which is being held from October 12, 2023 at 17:00 (JST).
　
◇Confirmed bugs
　■【Autumn Festival】 Part 3 - Boosted Supply Drop!
Unavailable MS of less than the specified rarity may be selected to be ejected in the quota to determine the number of unacquired MS of ★2 or higher, or ★3 or higher.
Sometime, unacquired MS that should have been ejected may not be ejected.
Application may stop when requesting Supply Drop
　
We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused.
The following Supply Drop will be temporarily suspended to investigate the cause of the above bug and to examine how to deal with the problem.
　
Supply Drop to be suspended:
　■【Autumn Festival】 Part 3 - Boosted Supply Drop!
　
We appologies for the delay and confusions caused.
We will inform detailed information regarding this issue afterwards.
Thank you very much for your patience in advence.
　
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

notes.title: Notice About Suspension of Some Accounts（2023/10/5）
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
This is the Steam® version oeperations team.
　
Currently, we are receiving reports indicating that regular gameplay is being disrupted due to unauthorized behavior.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused to users who are enjoying the game normally.
　
We have been conducting investigations based on the reports we have received and information 
from our internal investigation criteria, and in response to these disruptive actions, 
we have been monitoring the action logs as appropriate on the management side.
We would like to report that for the accounts where issues were confirmed, 
measures to halt gameplay have been successfully implemented.
　
As of 5th October, 2023 [JST]
　
■Number of Account Suspension Cases

[tr]

[/tr]
