[td]1,463　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
　
■ Actions Taken: Permanent Usage Suspension, etc.
　
As this online competitive game thrives through everyone's collaboration
the management will continue to investigate accounts that are deemed to be 
violating the terms of use or engaging in disruptive behavior towards others. 
If disruptive or interfering actions are confirmed, 
we may halt gameplay for the relevant accounts without prior notice. 
We kindly ask for your understanding in advance.
　
Furthermore, we extend our gratitude to users who have provided information about those
engaging in disruptive or interfering behavior and have cooperated with our investigations. 
We would like to take this opportunity to thank you.
※Please note that if there are repeated instances of false reports, penalties may be imposed on the reporting users as well.
　
If you come across players who might be engaging in unfair practices or using unauthorized tools 
during gameplay in the future, we kindly request your cooperation in providing information 
through the "Contact Form" mentioned below.
　
▼Contact (Inquiry)
https://bnfaq.channel.or.jp/title/2823
　
We are committed to applying penalties to those involved in unfair practices and tool usage, for the sake of our players. 
We ask for your continued support for "Mobile Suit Gundam: Battle Operation 2." 
Thank you.

notes.title: Notice About Suspension of Some Accounts
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
This is the Steam® version oeperations team.
　
Currently, we are receiving reports indicating that regular gameplay is being disrupted due to unauthorized behavior.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused to users who are enjoying the game normally.
　
We have been conducting investigations based on the reports we have received and information 
from our internal investigation criteria, and in response to these disruptive actions, 
we have been monitoring the action logs as appropriate on the management side.
We would like to report that for the accounts where issues were confirmed, 
measures to halt gameplay have been successfully implemented.
　
As of September 7th, 2023 [JST]
　
■Number of Account Suspension Cases
[table]
[tr]
[td]Date[/td]
[td]Number of Accounts Addressed[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]～July 2023[/td]
[td]350　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]August 2023[/td]
[td]4,477　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
　
■ Actions Taken: Permanent Usage Suspension, etc.
　
As this online competitive game thrives through everyone's collaboration
the management will continue to investigate accounts that are deemed to be 
violating the terms of use or engaging in disruptive behavior towards others. 
If disruptive or interfering actions are confirmed, 
we may halt gameplay for the relevant accounts without prior notice. 
We kindly ask for your understanding in advance.
　
Furthermore, we extend our gratitude to users who have provided information about those
engaging in disruptive or interfering behavior and have cooperated with our investigations. 
We would like to take this opportunity to thank you.
※Please note that if there are repeated instances of false reports, penalties may be imposed on the reporting users as well.
　
If you come across players who might be engaging in unfair practices or using unauthorized tools 
during gameplay in the future, we kindly request your cooperation in providing information 
through the "Contact Form" mentioned below.
　
▼Contact (Inquiry)
https://bnfaq.channel.or.jp/title/2823
　
We are committed to applying penalties to those involved in unfair practices and tool usage, for the sake of our players. 
We ask for your continued support for "Mobile Suit Gundam: Battle Operation 2." 
Thank you.

notes.title: Notice About Suspension of Some Accounts
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
This is the Steam® version oeperations team.
　
Currently, we are receiving reports indicating that regular gameplay is being disrupted due to unauthorized behavior.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused to users who are enjoying the game normally.
　
We have been conducting investigations based on the reports we have received and information 
from our internal investigation criteria, and in response to these disruptive actions, 
we have been monitoring the action logs as appropriate on the management side.
We would like to report that for the accounts where issues were confirmed, 
measures to halt gameplay have been successfully implemented.
　
As of August 16th, 2023 [JST]
　
■Number of Account Suspension Cases
[table]
[tr]
[td]Date[/td]
[td]Number of Accounts Addressed[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]～July 2023[/td]
[td]350　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]August 2023（16th）[JST][/td]
[td]1,692　Accounts[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
　
■ Actions Taken: Permanent Usage Suspension, etc.
　
As this online competitive game thrives through everyone's collaboration
the management will continue to investigate accounts that are deemed to be 
violating the terms of use or engaging in disruptive behavior towards others. 
If disruptive or interfering actions are confirmed, 
we may halt gameplay for the relevant accounts without prior notice. 
We kindly ask for your understanding in advance.
　
Furthermore, we extend our gratitude to users who have provided information about those
engaging in disruptive or interfering behavior and have cooperated with our investigations. 
We would like to take this opportunity to thank you.
※Please note that if there are repeated instances of false reports, penalties may be imposed on the reporting users as well.
　
We are committed to applying penalties to those involved in unfair practices and tool usage, for the sake of our players. 
We ask for your continued support for "Mobile Suit Gundam: Battle Operation 2." 
Thank you.

notes.title: Application Data Update and Server Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
Server maintenance will be performed on the following schedule.
　
◇Date & Time
[PDT] 07/26/2023 22:00 – 07/27/2023 01:00 [Scheduled] 
[CEST] 07/27/2023 07:00 – 07/27/2023 10:00 [Scheduled] 

◇Maintenance Details
　
・Application Data Update
・Supply Drop Lineup Update

　※Please note that you will not be able to log in to the game during the maintenance.
　※The end time may vary depending on the maintenance status. Please understand this in advance.
　※Entering the maintenance during matching may cause unexpected errors.
　　Please log out of the game before maintenance.

　
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
　
　
　　[PDT] 07/26/2023 / [CEST] 07/27/2023 Updated content is listed below.
　
　
■Application update file ver.0168
　
■Game rule related
◎New support requests "EMP Blast" and "Scramble" for Custom Matches
　　⇒　Extended rules "Basic Match +" and "Mix Up +" have been added, which allow the use of two new support requests.
　
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/06afce68bd0fca2eb98b081cc4ee5598cbd940c4.png[/img]
　
■Assistance request "EMP Blast"
　⇒　Can only be used on the ground with small amount of damage.
　　　Disables enemies' Radar function, weapons' ASL function and Unable to receive information spot by allies in a duration.
　　　No damage or effect to allies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/196636f44f3aa864b274a56f77279ec3fcd3377a.png[/img]

・Disabling Radar function
　Radar on the upper right of the screen will be disable and the overall screen will be covered by noise slightly.
　Disables the skills "High-Performance Radar", "Personnel Radar", "Observational Data Link", and "Fake Beacon".


・Disable weapons' ASL function
　ASL, Auto aiming system of weapon will be disable.
・Unable to receive information spot by allies
　Unable to gain information about enemies those spotted by allies.
　
■Assistance request "Scramble"
　⇒　"Scramble" will instantly zero the re-launch time of allies and ready for re-sortie.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/6206ab472f2604535a15d6ad472e16c2a26d58cb.png[/img]

　
■How to call "EMP Blast" and "Scramble"
　The two new support requests can be requested from relay point suppressed by ally, just as with the usual artillery support.


　You can now choose the support request while you at the point:
　　・"Space": The usual artillery support　※As usual
　　・"E": "EMP Blast"
　　・"R": "Scramble"
　　※These key set is only the default setting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/97d36b02fc0aa601656ef8e462a3eb8ef1f7cf69.png[/img]
※"EMP Blast" and "Scramble" can also be used in Free Practice.
※New support requests can be used in "Basic Match +" and "Mix Up +", 2 rules can be chosen in custom game.
　　Besides, other details of two rules is same as the normal one.

　
■Unit related
◎Some sub-weapons are changed as MS specialized weapon.
　■Hyaku-Shiki
　　・Sub-weapon "Head-Mounted Vulcan [Modified]" has been changed the name to "Hyaku-Shiki Head-Mounted Vulcan".
　　　Also "power", "projectile speed", "firing speed rate" and "stagger accumulation value" has been increased.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/e781f9a89d1d7cf7a7ea0461255fab42ad2c60a2.png[/img]
　
◎Various Parameter Adjustments are implemented.
※For details, check here.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/3645152208653194821
　
■Battle related
◎Pilots can now see their re-sortie remain time due to the update of new support request "Scramble".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/36eec311a165b8645d5e40f3b3ebae46b9656c9b.png[/img]

　
◎Those field units have NOT been ridden by pilots on the battlefield are now off the lock on target from weapons such as Funnels.

　■Field units
　　　・Type 61 MBT
　　　・Oggo
　　　・Skiure
　　　・Ball
　　　・Magella Attack
　　　・Wappa
　
■Others
◎MS "Dolmel"'s source has been corrected from "Mobile Suit Gundam Katana" to "Mobile Suit Gundam EX REVUE"

◎We have added the instruction “EXIT : ALt + F4” on the bottom left of the game title.
　
■STEAM ONLY "Welcome New & Returning pilots Campaign"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/e05265c18c8c61608a2777f7e914321a362c7efb.png[/img]
　Starting from [PDT] 07/27/2023 / [CEST] 07/27/2023, "Welcome New & Returning pilots Campaign" will begin.
　■Period

　　[CEST] 07/27/2023 10:00 – 08/24/2023 06:59 [Scheduled]

notes.title: Notice of Application Data Update
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
Server maintenance will be performed on the following schedule.
　
◇Date & Time
[PDT] 06/28/2023 22:00 – 06/29/2023 01:00 [Scheduled] 
[CEST] 06/29/2023 07:00 – 06/29/2023 10:00 [Scheduled] 
◇Maintenance Details
・【 Update ver.0167 】
・Application Data Update
・Update of Supply Drop Line Up
　
　※Please note that you will not be able to log in to the game during the maintenance.
　※The end time may vary depending on the maintenance status. Please understand this in advance.
　※Entering the maintenance during matching may cause unexpected errors.
Please log out of the game before maintenance.
　
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
　
　
ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
【 Added on [PDT] 06/29/2023 01:00 / [CEST] 06/29/2023 10:00) 】
The server maintenance that started at　[PDT] 2023/06/28 22:00 / [CEST] 2023/06/29 07:00 was completed at [PDT] 2023/06/29 01:00 / [CEST] 2023/06/29 10:00.
Thank you very much for your understanding and cooperation in maintenance.
　
　
　[PDT] 06/28/2023 / [CEST] 06/29/2023 Updated content is listed below.
【 Update File ver.0167 】

◎New weapons are now added to a part of MS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/46046d4aaf8911eea4d7fad4c4c6f78e013b61eb.png[/img]
　
◎Various Parameter Adjustments are implemented.
※For details, check here.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080/view/3660911636376407427
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/9f53a41cdbc12c69067ea9a8098a53472f9c2e2c.png[/img]
　
　
■Rank related
◎New rank "Major General"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/abadaf66fa445caf037d4882ed67a7ba31f08aad.png[/img]
　
　
■Battle related
◎"Ally information" is now changed.
　⇒　In the "Ally Information" displayed on the left side of the screen during battle,　the display of friendly MS relaunch time has been modified for improved convenience.
　
　
　■Before
　　The time to launch again was displayed from the moment an allied MS was destroyed, but the count did not start until after the animation so it was difficult to know the exact time of seconds remaining until the actual launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/7c9679e8d0e077716cee1dfd3fb12f9818504101.png[/img]
　■After
　　We have modified the display to show the re-launch time at the timing when the count actually starts after an allied MS is destroyed and the animation has been completed.

　The timing of displaying the number of seconds remaining before launching again is now correct.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/28c74bfa6abe475ae878685688dbcb6479dd5eb5.png[/img]
　
　
■Other
◎Conditions for accomplishing some of the daily missions had been changed.
　⇒　Wednesday mission "Win 2 battle!" are changed to "Win 1 battle!".
　
◎Some rewards for monthly missions were changed.
　
　
■Limited Supply Drop Event for the launch of the Steam® Version [5th Limited Supply Drop !! Moon Gundam, Dag Doll, Zaku IV (IP)"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/c7ccc4f0496823cd592e1ccba6bda026a9b744cd.png[/img]

　　　　※The above MS is eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　　・Support Unit with Cost of 550.
　　　・This prototype MS was developed to be an escort for MA at the heart of the Titans' "Project Seirene" and its external appearance features a Gundam face and mono-eye.
　　　・Although large in comparison to other MS of its era, it features impressive mobility. This superior mobility, combined with an exclusive composite weapon called the "I-Field Launcher",
　　　　allows it to cover a wide range, nullifying enemy attacks and countering with even stronger firepower.
　　　・Development with no regard to cost led to its incredible mobility, but if no limiter is applied,
　　　　it is too much for even Cyber Newtypes to handle, so it is usually under the constraint of one.
　　　　When the limiter is deactivated, it switches to "Offense Mode 1", and when at full throttle, it moves into "Offense Mode 2".
　　　・It was later seized by the AEUG and Quattro Bajeena called it "Mono-eye Gundam" because of its appearance.
　　　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
https://adm-bo2.ggame.jp/images/info/2023/04/230427_0DOofde3g084223GAW3QplXm.mp4

　　　・Melee Priority is also slightly boosted in this mode, reducing reaction when hit by a ranged attack during melee combat.
　　■Offense Mode: Phase 2 Ability Boost

　　　・Fully recover ALL parts HP.
　　　・Boosts ATK, DEF, MOB, and adds "Flight Control Program LV3" skill.
　　　・Melee Priority is boosted in this mode too, nullifying reaction when hit by a ranged attack in melee combat.
　　　※No matter "Phase 1" or "Phase 2", every sortie can only be activated once only.
　　　※The skill has a time limit, and once it over, thrusters will overheat for awhile and not able to be activated until next sortie.
　
　　■Skill: I-Field Control System

　　　　Reaction from cumulative beam attacks is reduced as well.

notes.title: Notice of penalty reduction due to difficulty in matching.
notes.content:
We have discussed with our team again about the situation of the difficulty of matching in the game and the penalties that have been incurred as a result of this situation, 
and we would like to announce that we will be taking the following measures to mitigate the penalties.

■ Reduction of imposed penalty
◇Detail
All penalties incurred from May 30, 2023 (Tue.), when the official service launched to June 14, 2023 (Thu), 22:00 (PDT), will be reduced.

◇Eligible players
All players

Date and time of reduction
June 14, 2023 (Wed) 22:00 (PDT) [Scheduled].

◇Period
At the first login during the period of June 14, 2023 (Wed) 22:00 (PDT) - June 28, 2023 (Wed) 21:59 (PDT) [Scheduled].

◇How to get reduced
Penalty reduction will be automatically implemented for all players by logging in 
after the application data update on Wed., June 14, 2023, 22:00~01:00 (PDT) [scheduled].
*If application data is updated during the match, unintended behavior may occur.
We appreciate your cooperation in logging out of the game well in advance.


We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused you.
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" for Steam®.

notes.title: FAQs
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
This is the Steam version team.

As we have many new players to the game we have received numerous questions about the game and its mechanics. As a result we have compiled the following is a list of frequently asked questions about playing "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".
*The most recent questions that many of players have asked are listed at the top.


■FAQs
Q: Why is the viewpoint movement of a mobile suit slow during fighting, even if I move the mouse or controller stick to move the viewpoint?
A:  Each mobile suit has a "Turn speed" parameter, and the speed of viewpoint movement depends on this value.
If you are using a mouse, you can see the direction in which the mobile suit is facing by moving the red square reticle as you move the viewpoint.

Q: How do I close an application from the title screen?
A: If you wish to exit the game on the title screen, you can exit the application by pressing the Alt and F4 keys simultaneously.


Q: Why is there a time every Thursday when I can't play the game?
"A: Every Wed. and Thu. from 22:00 to 1:00 (PDT) (scheduled), we will be performing scheduled maintenance to apply that weeks update which includes new Supply Drops, events, and other game features. Updates will be announced on Steam News, please check the link below for the details.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1367080"


■ Questions about specifications
Q: Is there any data transfer from PS3 "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation" or PS3/PS4 "Gundam Battle Operation Next", or any data transfer bonuses?
A: 
There is currently no data transfer from PS3 "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation" or PS3/PS4 "Gundam Battle Operation Next" or data rewards.

Q: Can network test play data be transferred to the production version?
A:
Play data used during the network test cannot be transferred to the production version.

Q: When I start the game, why does the message "Preparing Epic Online System Anti-Cheat Interfaces" appear different from the name of the file that is actually installed? 
A:
The latest version of Easy Anti-cheat is now integrated into and part of the EPIC Online Service, so the information shown is correct.

Q: How can I assign controller buttons to keys?
A:
You can set it up from within the game by following the steps below:
1. press the V key (*) in base camp to open the [H.A.R.O.] screen
2. Select "Options" > "Key Binding Settings"
3. Select the item for which you want to set the action in the [Action] column
* For default settings when using keyboard.

Q: Does the game allow for cross-play with PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 players?
A:
Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2 does not have cross-platform play functionality.
PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 players can match and form groups with each other, 
but you cannot match or form groups with players from different platforms.

Q: What happens to my saved data if I change the PC on which I play the game?
A:
As long as you are using the same Steam account, your player data will be saved regardless of which device you log in from.
Please note that option/configuration settings are not saved on the server and are unique to each device.
Please note that if you change your PC, you will need to reconfigure your options.

Q: [Common to Steam users] I want to know the "minimum system requirements" and "recommended system requirements" to play the game.
A:
The "Minimum System Requirements" and "Recommended System Requirements" for each game can be found on the store page of each game on the "Steam" website.
Please search by game name from the Steam top page here and check the introduction page for each game.
(URL to Steam page)
Please also check the official website of each game for specifications.
We cannot guarantee game performance in environments that do not meet the minimum system requirements.
The "minimum system requirements" are the minimum environmental conditions under which the game will operate. We recommend that you meet the "Recommended Requirements" to play the game comfortably.


■Operation-Related
Q:　【Common to Steam version】Can I play this game on my home-built PC?
A:
If you are using a home-built or modded machine when playing PC games, including Steam versions, there is a possibility that unexpected accidents may occur due to compatibility between parts.
In such cases, it is difficult for us to accurately determine the customer's operating environment and it is impossible for us to conduct our own investigation.
In addition, please note that we will not be able to respond to inquiries. Please note that BTO computers with a manufacturer's warranty is not considered as the category of home-built machines.
In the case of using game programs such as mods or external programs that do not go through the Steam Store, support is not applicable.

Q: I cannot start the game.
A:

Restarting the game may improve the problem. Please try restarting it.
Also, please try restarting your computer as well. 
If the above does not improve the situation, please try the following procedure as well.
　1. click [Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2] in the Steam library.
　2. click [Properties] in the menu (gear icon)
  3. Click on "Local Files" in the left menu, then Click [Check game file integrity.].

Q: Downloaded DLC is not reflected in the game.
A:
Please follow the steps below to check the status of your downloadable content (DLC).
1. launch the Steam client
2.  [Library] > right-click [Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2]
3. check if the item [Properties] > [DLC] > [Install] is checked
　If checked, the DLC is installed in the game.
　* It is also possible to play the game without reflecting the DLC by unchecking the [Install] item and restarting the game.
If the DLC is still not reflected in the above state, please try the following procedure.
1. launch the Steam client
2.  [Library] > right-click [Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2]
3. Properties > DLC > Uncheck the Install item.
Check [Install] again.
　* Some items, such as consumable items, may not be available for re-download.
　* Some products may require certain in-game operations to reflect content.

Q: I am having trouble connecting to the Internet.
A:
1. Restart the PC or communication device (router or modem) and reconnect after a period of time
Turn off the router or modem to which the computer is connected, then start the modem, then the router.
2. Try "Diagnose Internet Connection" in Windows
　 Please confirm that all diagnostics are successful and that the NAT type is determined to be 1 or 2.
　 https://www.playstation.com/ja-jp/support/connectivity/internet-connect-playstation/
　 * If the NAT type is "3", it may not be able to match properly.
3. Confirmation with your provider regarding the line you are using
　 Please check with your provider regarding the following situations
　 - Whether it is difficult to make a connection due to congestion, etc.
　 - Are there any security services from providers that may affect Internet communications?
4. check if there is any problem or maintenance on Steam
　 Please check the thread in the Steam Downtime Notification Board.
　 https://steamcommunity.com/discussions/
 * In addition to the Steam Bulletin Board, downtime information can be found on the following Facebook and Twitter pages.
　 https://www.facebook.com/Steam
　 https://twitter.com/Steam_Support
　 Also, please check the Steam Server Status page to verify that the problem you are experiencing is not due to system-wide downtime.
　 https://store.steampowered.com/stats/
　 * The store and other Steam features may not be available during outages, downtime, or server maintenance on Steam.
If you have a wireless connection, try a wired connection if possible.
　 If you are using wireless communication (Wi-Fi), try a wired connection, as it may be affected by other devices.
6. checking the port settings of communication devices and updating firmware
7. reinstall game data
　 This may be due to an abnormality in the installation data. Please try reinstalling the game data.
　 * Since the saved data of this game is stored on the server, the saved data will not be deleted even if you delete the game data on your computer.

Q: "Preparing Epic Online System Anti-Cheat Interfaces." message appears and I cannot start the game.
A:
If you are unable to start the game with the message "Epic Online System Anti-Cheat Interfaces are preparing. message appears on the title screen and you are unable to start the game, this may be due to the security software you are using.
If this situation occurs, please check the settings of your security software.

Q: With certain procedures, the game audio (stereoscopic) is not output.
A:
If the Windows OS sound setting is switched from "3D Sound(Off)" to "Windows Sonic for Headphones" during game play, the game audio will not be output.
This can be fixed by the following procedure.
1. Restart the application after the problem occurs.
2. After the problem occurs, return the Windows OS sound setting to "3D Sound (Off)".
3. Before launching the application, switch the Windows OS sound settings to "Windows Sonic for Headphones".
For customers who wish to enjoy 3D sound, please try 3.


■In-app purchase/ in-game currency or point
Q: Can I play for free?
A:
Downloading the game and using the service is free of charge.
However, a fee will be charged for the purchase of Tokens.
* There will be separate communication charges for downloading and communication during the game. 


■Functions
Q: How do I connect to the Internet?
A:
Please check the website below:
https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=1456-EUDN-2493
(Move to Valve Corporation's website)

Q: How do I get a "Steam Account"?
A:
Please check the URL below:
https://store.steampowered.com/join
(Move to Valve Corporation's website)


■Others/Notes
Q: I want to know about Steam trouble and maintenance information.
A:
Please check the thread in the Steam Downtime Notification Board.
https://steamcommunity.com/discussions/
　* In addition to the Steam Community Discussions, you can also find us on Facebook and Twitter below.
https://www.facebook.com/Steam
https://twitter.com/Steam_Support
Also, please check the Steam Server Status page to verify that the problem you are experiencing is not due to system-wide downtime.
https://store.steampowered.com/stats/
* The store and other Steam features may not be available during problems, downtime, or server maintenance on Steam.

Q: [Common to all platforms] Regarding novelty-related items and items to be distributed at campaigns and events for Game Console version.
A:
[Common to all platforms] Please contact the following e-mail address for inquiries related to novelty items and handouts for campaigns and events for Console Games.
 ■Campaign-related (Console Games)
 https://bnfaq.channel.or.jp/title/2990

We thankyou for all your questions and your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

notes.title: Notice of the matching issue and compensation
notes.content:
Hello Pilots,
This is “Mobile Suit Battle Operation 2 Steam® team.

We have received many comments from players around the world about the current difficulties in matching and the penalties that have been caused as a result of these issues.

In addition to the above problems, we are aware that players have been unable to play this title satisfactorily due to repeated emergency maintenances for four days in a row since the day of service launch,
as well as poor matching during the hours when players are most likely to play the game, and we apologize for the inconvenience this has caused.

The satisfaction of our player is a priority for us, so
As an apology for the inconvenience caused to everyone, we will distribute the following compensation:

■About compensation
◇Details
30 tokens

◇Eligible users
All players

◇Date and time of distribution
From after the end of maintenance at 1:00 AM on June 8, 2023 (Thu.) (PDT)

◇How to receive
After logging in, please receive it at the Rewards Center of the in-game base camp.

◇Receiving deadline
Until 21:59 (PDT), Wednesday, June 21, 2023 

We are still hard at work to resolve the game issues and improve the experience for our players.

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused to players who have been playing the game since shortly after its release.
Thank you so much for your patience and understanding while we work, and your continued support of the "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" Steam® version.

Please make sure you’re following our official GBO2 Twitter account for further updates at https://twitter.com/GBO2EN

notes.title: Application Data Update
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team on Steam®.
　
　Application Data Update on [PDT] 05/31/2023 / [CEST] 06/01/2023.
　
　
■"Atlas Gundam [TB]" guaranteed STEP UP Supply Drop Notice
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/dc6551d8f6a99568c0ed9917c0978b6566ccf478.png[/img]
Beginning [PDT] 05/31/2023 / [CEST] 06/01/2023, "Atlas Gundam [TB]" LV1 guaranteed STEP UP Supply Drop will begin.
　■Period
　　　[PDT] 05/31/2023 22:00 – 06/07/2023 21:30 [Scheduled]
　　　[CEST] 06/01/2023 07:00 – 06/08/2023 06:30 [Scheduled]
　■Content
　　A Supply Drop, in which 10 consecutive Supply Drops can be requested up to STEP 7.
　　The STEP will progress by 1 each time you perform a request, as STEP 1 → STEP 2 → STEP 3 → STEP 4 → STEP 5 → STEP 6 → STEP 7.
　　After STEP 7 is requested, Boosted Supply Drop will be over.
　　　・STEP1 (15 Tokens)：Tokens 50% OFF!
　　　・STEP2 (30 Tokens)：Bonus  50 [★★★★] Mechanic Tickets  are obtainable!
　　　・STEP3 (30 Tokens)：Bonus 50 [★★★★] Modification Kits  are obtainable!
　　　・STEP4 (30 Tokens)：★★★★ Materials Drop Rate x2!
　　　・STEP5 (30 Tokens)：★★★★ Materials Drop Rate x3! +  100 [★★★★] Mechanic Tickets  as bonus!
　　　・STEP6 (30 Tokens)：★★★★ Materials Drop Rate x3! +  100 [★★★★] Modification Kits  as bonus!
　　　・STEP7 (30 Tokens)：1 Guaranteed "Atlas Gundam [TB]"!! +  Custom Parts "Overtuning [Frame] LV1" as bonus!
　　■Custom part
　　　・"Overtuning [Frame] LV1"
　　　・Increasing MS HP by 300. Every time MS LV gets higher, its HP will increase by 900. Every same part will benefit you, 3000 HP as maximum.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/bb6a4e297003a51dd27dbd9faf32920542307626.png[/img]
※Same supplies will be drawn as the ongoing Supply Drops. For details, please check the [Item List].

■Notice of Supply Drop Lineup

　　　※The above MS is eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
　　■Mobile Suit Features
　　　・General Unit with Cost of 600.
　　　・This Gundam prototype was developed by Anaheim Electronics using funds from the Moore Brotherhood.
　　　・A pair of iconic "Sub Legs" use movable arms to change their position, allowing it to operate well in various terrain, and providing impressive midair mobility, and "Water jets" on its legs enable underwater performance that would even rival that of the Principality of Zeon's Amphibious MS.
　　　・It is equipped with a railgun, assault rifle, beam saber, and other highly versatile weapons,
　　　　and also has a "Velos Medusa" built into its shield that limits the movement of targets hit by bullets.
　　　・This MS is a high-performance unit that is adaptable to all areas, and has acquired high performance and versatility for operation under gravity on land, sea, and air.
　　　・Can only be deployed on the Ground.
　　　■Skill "Sub Leg Controller"
　　　　・Press the "special weapon" button to activate the "Sub Leg":
　　　　・To enter flight mode, allowing actions in midair.
　　　　・Increases mobility, reduces the thruster consumption of high-speed movement,
　　　　　and reduces damage recoil while active.
　　　　・Syncs movement and melee attack to reticle direction while active allowing advanced combat at the cost of attack power.
　　　　・This skill can even be used underwater.
　　　　　Thrusters are constantly consumed while the skill is activated and the skill effect is canceled when overheated.
　■Exclusive pilot item as a Bonus for the 10 Consecutive Supply Drops!
　　　Beginning from [PDT] 05/31/2023 22:00 / [CEST] 06/01/2023 07:00,
　　　1 random exclusive pilot item as a bonus can be obtained from 10 consecutive drops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/6f2bb540b46e3c84cff0c3e8e7cba576146c376f.png[/img]

　　　　[CEST] 06/01/2023 07:00 – 06/08/2023 06:30 [Scheduled]

　　　　■Accessory

　　　　※Does NOT apply to the 1-Attempt Supply Drop. The bonus item will not be awarded even if you request the 1-Attempt Supply Drop ten times in a row.
　　■Other Added Materials
　　　■Units
　　　　・★★★　Prototype Stark Jegan LV3 (Support Unit, Ground/Space use, cost: 600)
　　　　・★★★　Hyaku Shiki Kai LV3 (General Unit, Ground/Space use, cost: 700)
　　　　・★　Dom Tropical (Test Type) LV3 (General Unit, Ground only, cost: 400)
　　　　※"Prototype Stark Jegan LV3" and "Hyaku Shiki Kai LV3" are eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/f9c12dd6dbd77f1c2718b5a0d3cb64e72b6563a3.png[/img]
　　■Removed Materials from the Supply Drop
　　　Some materials are removed from the supply drop lineup.
　　　※For more information regarding the updated supply drop lineup, please refer to the [Supply Drop List].
　　■Notice of [Big Boost to Supply Drop Rates Campaign]
　　　Some of the newly added materials will have a boost to their supply drop rates for a limited time.
　　　■Period

　　　■Supply Drops that will benefit from Big Boost to Supply Rates

■Overview of “GBO DAYS”
We have different events for all pilots [JST] every first Thursday through the first Sunday as our big campaign "GBO Days"!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/5060e1b5895ce0a6c749a9eb3bcfc081efd443fe.png[/img]

　　GBO Days is a special monthly campaign that will start at the first Thursday of every month at [JST] 17:00 until the next Monday [JST] 04:59 [scheduled].
　　Pilots who always play GBO2 will receive a lot of benefits, furthermore, new and returning pilots will be even benefited from some of the content during the campaign!

notes.title: [Clan Match] Rewards & Schedule
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is the Steam® version "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team.
　
Schedule and rewards of Clan Match are listed below.
※Details of Clan Match and rewards are also listed below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/54c9cfe78331c8867f6b118afb196eff693cce5a.png[/img]
■Clan Match schedule
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/0b0210e2166d447c5e099f1b2b7e601330c1eed1.png[/img]
　
　
■Rewards
Clans those on the list of Clan Match ranking will be awarded a “Clan Match Flag” 
according to their ranking as a commemorative gift, 
and all clan members will also receive a new MS and Clan Mark material ahead of time.
You can also unlock operators and get DP as extra prizes.
　■New MS
　・★★ GM II Weapon Tester (General unit, ground/space uses, cost: 400)
　■Mobile Suit Features
　・General unit with cost of 400.
　・This MS was created by Federation Forces for the Titans 
　　and was used to test and evaluate weapons such as the Fedayeen Rifle and Shock Wire.
　・Due to its large production numbers and proven versatility, 
　　it was selected as a test unit to develop new weaponry for the Titans, hence its dark blue coating.
　・A prototype Fedayeen Rifle features a folding grip mechanism designed for 
　　switching between ranged and close combat.
　　However, this feature was eventually omitted due to technical contributions from the Jupiter Fleet.
　　In addition, a weapon known as the Shock Wire was refined for better handling, 
　　evolving into a portable weapon called the Sea Serpent that could be used with the manipulator.
　・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/1bd220aa1d0e04230ee0878a2c865a50a4ddce56.png[/img]
　◆Conditions for earning the Clan Match MS reward
　　The reward MS depends on the ranking in the Clan Match and there will be less restriction 
　　when the Clan Match goes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/0c0d56ae2c614a2307e2e5664c19729a0103672d.png[/img]

　◆Clan mark material (Early acquisition)
　　The clans who had reached a clan match rank will be rewarded the clan mark material to all clan members
　　earlier than other players.
　　■Clan Mark Material
　　　・Background: Underwater A (Blue)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/d49968cf7f91c8c6fa9ebf5e857166ce24b61fcc.png[/img]
　◆Conditions to earn Clan Mark Material
　　Some clan mark materials are awarded according to the overall clan match ranking, 
　　while others are awarded to all participants.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/2a9a277c109bbf6ea7195ba40640c0768c9c04d9.png[/img]
　◆Clan Match Flag
　　The clan that wins the Clan Match Overall Ranking will receive a Clan Match Flag.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/01110d8c3fe5240b8f045f01fd625c7f269e0757.png[/img]
　　The clan match flag will be displayed on the clan search result screen in addition to counting the number of hits so far.
　　※The number of Clan Match Flags acquired can be checked at a Clan terminal.
　
　◆Clan Match Flag Requirements
　　Clan Match flags can be earned based on your overall clan match ranking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/d274f8f3af8ec0c46481c5e97d79ef2827247d6a.png[/img]
　◆Operator
　　All clan members in the clan that listed on Clan Match Overall Ranking will be able to use the operator
　　 “Neidhardt Heidegger”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/083900c58e9f87940bfd051c94ce5bb8f7c19349.png[/img]
　◆Operator acquisition requirements
　　Operators can be earned according to their overall clan match ranking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/dd4f7600f5a2f86e2d924db08170807e6da5c430.png[/img]
　◆DP
　　Clans that win the Clan Match Overall Ranking will be rewarded by DP to all clan members.
　
　◆DP rewards according to rankings
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/e4e3c7738236f5b055a54a2ae139c33c7f946bd2.png[/img]
　
　◆Clan Rewards Details
　　※Those rewards forgotten claiming can be obtained in the next match reward redeem period.
　　　Since the rewards is related to the current ranking of the Clan Match, there is a possibility that rewards 
　　　which from the previous match result will be unable to be claimed due to the changed ranking.
　　■About Clan Match Reward MS
　　　・If you are obtaining the clan match reward MS that you have already acquired again, it will be converted into
　　　　a several number of recycle tickets, and you will also gain enhancement values as well.
　　　　(If yours is fully enhanced, they will be converted to tickets for more mechanics based on their rarity.)
　　　・The lineup of new MS for Clan Match rewards will be changed regularly.
　　　　In addition, the reward MS will be lined up in regular supply drop after a certain period of time.
　　■About the clan mark material
　　　・The Clan Mark material from the Clan Match can be earned by winning a ranking and will be rewarded again
　　　　individually after a certain period of time.
　　■About Operators
　　　・All clan members in the clan that finishes in the overall Clan Match rankings will be able to use the operator
　　　　“Neidhardt Heidegger”.
　　　・The operator can be changed in the menu H.A.R.O.＞Options＞Sound Settings by selecting the operator.

　
The latest information will be posted on STEAM News and our X (Twitter) in the future.
https://x.com/pc_gbo2

We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

notes.title: "Premium Login Bonus" Details
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team on Steam®.
　
Details and rewards of "Premium Login Bonus" are listed below.
　
■Premium Medal of War
　Premium Medal of War can be obtained by completing a certain number of "monthly missions".
　Premium Medal will benefit pilot a bunch of bonus.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/45705816fc1f99497221ec9a74e42985223452b1.png[/img]
　■Bonus you wil be benefited by Premium Medal of War
　　1.Encouragement can be used to the whole team for boosting battle reward.
　　　Pilot can use Encouragement after grouping.
　　　No matter victory or not, pilots who have the effect of Encouragement will be great boosted on battle reward and container discover chance.
　　　Teammate will also be benefited with the bonus if your team win the battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/93536c7f22c3b426517c28be81b02ba95b7c9e14.png[/img]
　　※If there are more than one pilot activated Encouragement, only the strongest effect one will apply to all teammates.
　　※There is limit for everyday Encouragement uses.
　　※Encouragement uses will only be counted when battle finished and reset [JST] every day 05:00.
　
　　2.More container can be discovered! ※Pilot will have the effect once get the Premium Medal.
　　　Daily discoverable container will be increased for reward.
　
　　3.More items on the lineup list in Recycle Counter. ※Pilot will have the effect once get the Premium Medal.
　　　List of MS/main weapon/custom parts will be added and pilots will be much easier to exchange the items they wait.
　
　■Finishing monthly mission will level up your stage of Premium Medal.
　　Depends on your stage of Premium Medal, Encouragement can be used per day and bonus will be boosted.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/6e518434e639235fbba4c62a116e49b48df13267.png[/img]
　　※Premium Medal of War will be reset [JST] on the first day every month 5:00.
　
　
■What is the premium login bonus?
　This is a login bonus where you can receive daily special items when you log into Battle Operation 2.
　The Premium Login Bonus can only be received by pilots who have been awarded the "Platinum Order of Battle".

※When you have received all login bonuses, you will receive tokens every day until the next lineup update.
※The login bonus will be updated on the 1st, 11th and 21st of every month [JST].
[u]※You will receive the Premium Login Bonus on [JST] 5 a.m., the day after you have been awarded the Platinum Medal.[/u]
※Premium Medal can be obtained by completing a certain number of "monthly missions".
※Monthly Missions are updated on [JST] 5 a.m. on the first day of each month.
Since its necessary to re-login to the game for the monthly update, be sure to return to title screen once and login again.

■List of Premium Login Bonuses for June 2023

notes.title: [Clan Match] Overview
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" team on Steam®.
　
Clan Match details is listed below.
※For details of schedule and rewards, please click here.
　
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/142e344a3fad2bf857b12e847c89aea99aca2075.png[/img]

■What is Clan Match
A weekly short-term ranking event between “clans” in “P.M.U.”
With rules set for each event where “CMP (clan match points)” are obtained through competition.
The ranking of entire clan depends on CMP earned and all clan members can earn special rewards by reaching higher ranking.
　
■How to participate in Clan Matches
　1. Enter the briefing room by choosing “Events” -> “Clan Match” at sortie counter during the clan match period.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/6c2b7f7f427c4d9b0f152bab2ba2518032f92c2d.png[/img]
　　※You can enter the room at any time during the clan match period.
　　※Pilots who have just joined a clan during the clan match will not be able to participate.
　※Pilots who have a status of [PENALTY Lv1] or higher won’t be able to participate.
　
　2. After entering the briefing room, invite your clan members via invitation menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/dfb842ad3842d8d5813240bb011c71eec4ec46ae.png[/img]
　　※The number of invites is limited to half the number of participants set for the room.
　　　If it is 6v6 room, you can invite only up to 5 players, excluding yourself.
　　※Pilots who have just joined a clan during the clan match will not be able to participate.
　
　3. Removing the private setting after invitations have been sent will start the matchmaking with another clan.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/447944ea4ee6d4dadc5a880fac08c9cf5bff6b68.png[/img]
　　※Private settings cannot be canceled unless half the number of participants are available in the room.
　　※Matching will not occur with another group of the same clan.
　　※Matchmaking is based on the average ranking of clan members in the group.
　
■How to play the clan match
　1. “CMP (Clan Match Points)" can be earned after the Clan Match.
　　The CMP earned is determined by the following criteria.
　■CMP Evaluating ① Team score
　　・“5% of team score” from battle is turned to CMP
　　　Example）Team score is 12000　⇒　5% of which is 600CMP earned
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/e38c7bf6ac794b6df768cf5a9e2b698e585bd18a.png[/img]
　　※The maximum CMP earned by a team score is +1,100 CMP.
　　　(Maximum value may vary depending on the COST limit at the time of the event).
　■CMP Evaluating ② Victory or defeat
　　・Following amount is obtained depending on match results:
　　　Victory：+300CMP
　　　Loss：+100CMP
　　　Draw：+200CMP
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/72579608d86199372042e02275ed6c1b0c38542a.png[/img]
　■CMP Evaluating ③ Enemies' average rating
　　・CMP can be earned based on  the average rating of enemy clan members
　　　S-　：+400CMP
　　　A+　：+300CMP
　　　A　：+200CMP
　　　A-　：+150CMP
　　　B+　：+100CMP
　　　B- ~ B　：+50CMP
　　　C- ~ C+　：+25CMP
　　　D- ~ D+　：+0CMP
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/07f06cbdd85b3cf78fe24c1798cd3a3035dda3cc.png[/img]
　　Example of CPM obtained by the above three items:
　　　Team Score: 12000 ＝ 600CMP
　　　Match Result: Win＝300CMPTotal = 1,000CMP obtained
　　　Enemy average rating: B+= 100CMP
　
　2. The value of CMP possible during the clan match period is determined by the top 3 battles within that period.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/7b3959933d503dcde4f7f43b439856a10659e4a3.png[/img]
　　Regardless of how much CMPs you earn, only the top 3 battles will be accumulated to the ranking.
　
■Regarding the ranking system
Clan match rankings are available for clan matches.
　⇒　You can check your ranking via H.A.R.O. -> Database -> “Clan Match” Ranking.
　
■Clan Match Overall Ranking
The following is the ranking table, listing clan’s rank and CMP “Clan Match Points”.
The top 100 ranked clans are displayed in the overall ranking table.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/2445b62cc76698353d92efd65ff4c43074d928af.png[/img]
　※Since it takes a certain amount of time for CMPs to be reflected in the rankings,
　　the rankings may not reflect the latest CMPs depending on the timing at which you check the rankings.
　
　
■Clan Match Rewards
Rewards will be presented to the clan that ranked in the Clan Match Overall Ranking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/b5f2a1ace08d69f730c64febef6349599aa9c626.png[/img]
※For more detaisl of rewards, please click here.
　
We will try our best and put effort to GBO2, Thank you for all your support!

and the status of May's monthly mission achievements and earned War Medals will be reset at the same time as this Monthly Mission update the
　From the "Monthly Mission for June 2023," you will be able to receive the Premium Log-in Bonus from the day after you receive the Platinum War Medal,
 so please try to get the Premium Log-in Bonus from May 1, 2023 13:00 (PDT) onward.

notes.content:

■Tutorial
 We are fight with "Mobile Suit(MS)", so the key is to master your control of MS.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/f02be15e34510f38cb4fd707fe45280497be7947.jpg[/img]
 Don't worry, we have a tutorial video for you to learn the basic controls.
https://youtu.be/XNAogE4vJIA
　
■Basic
 ■Lesson 1: Your advantage and disadvantage
 Every type of MS will good at counter a type and weak at another.
 You will deal more damage to enemies and take less damage if yours is countering them.
 On the other hand, if your opponent is countering your unit type, you are in a big trouble.
 Identify your enemies by their looks and damage amount, and push when you have advantage and run away from those you are disadvantage.
　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/c4d5f9f1ed6f1f7996711bf7d169070f6789928d.png[/img]
　
 ■Lesson 2: Safety in numbers
 "War is not only about quality but quantity", so always advance with your teammate.
 Never go your own, wipe out those cut off from the group one by one. If you can do this, you are close to victory.
　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/6d5c710a2688336c923af08e8fe04fa1a8aa4b20.jpg[/img]
　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/638d8e52b09bf68cae1ed130fc12c468e2163f8d.jpg[/img]
　
■Advance
 ■Lesson 1: Check the MS skills
 Every MS have different MS skills and these skills will bring you different benefit.
 Each unit have their own spec and unique movement pattern depends on their skills.
 To know "what you can do" in the unpreditable battlefield, it is important to learn "what skills you have" first.
　
 >> Example of skill
 Emergency Evasion System
https://youtu.be/DpH1t-kIaqA
　
 Melee Combo Controller
https://youtu.be/2kFOsA18cXQ
　
 ■Lesson 2: Make good use to the hotkeys of your weapons(shortcut)
"　　・When using keyboard
　　　[Mouse wheel↓] or [alt] to switch to the next weapon
　　　[alt] (holding) to show ""shortcut panel""
　　　[1/2/3[mouse wheel ↑]/4/5/6/7/8] to switch to weapon you had set
　
　　・When using console controller
　　　[RB] to switch to the next weapon
　　　[RB] (holding) to show [shortcut panel]
　　　[RB] and [A/B/X/Y/BY/BA/XA/XY] to switch to weapon you had set

　(Number key and [A/B/X/Y/BY/BA/XA/XY] can be set for any weapons as you like.)"
  Weapon switching will always affect you in the live and dead situation in MS battle.
  You may learn your own switching pattern in free practice and training mode.
 ※Default setting
　
 Customimzing the hotkeys
　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/d44c080adc909cdee03603a2ceb0587f77272a3c.png[/img]
　
 UI of using the weapon shortcut
　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/fccf90bc42ab20655a1ded27a0dbb6e522417b6d.png[/img]
　
■Master
 ■"Stagger" and "Down"
 MS will get "stagger" when continue getting hit by enemy.
 MS cannot move when they are "stagger" so you will have chance to hit them even harder at the moment.
 Every weapon have their own "Stagger Accumulation Value", which means each weapon will cost different attacks to make your opponent to stagger.
 Second, MS will be "down" when they are hit by some kinds of attack.
 MS will take much time to recover from "down" than "stagger", which means more vulnerable.
　
 Videos of "Stagger" and "Down"
"　
https://youtu.be/76TvZAuCKPI"
 Bazooka or support type weapons only take one hit to "stagger", but machine guns and beam rifle will take more times.
 "Down" is mainly caused by melee attack.
　
　
Hope this will help you to enjoy GBO2!

notes.title: Tips for fresh new pilots②
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" on Steam® team.
　
Here, you will find some useful information for battle in GBO2.
　
　
■MS
 ■3 types of MS
 We have "General", "Raid" and "Support" type MS in GBO2, each of them is specialized to counter one of the other type and be countered by another one.
 Learn this well and you will know your advantage and disadvantage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/415f8c2fed1ac13627a393271c553ebe9afae98f.png[/img]
　
 ■Different type of MS
 General
 A well balanced type, good at both close and mid range battle.
 Suitable for different kinds of situation or strategy.
　
 Raid
 Expert of close range combat.
 Get close to your opponent, deal massive melee damage and mess the battle field up!
　
 Support
 Specialist of long range attack or carrying different support function.
 You can shoot at general or raid where they cannot reach you with your high fire power weapons.
　
 ■Customize
 Main weapon
 You can equip weapons with different effect to your MS.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/93bd431b8abf0ec3b5aed07092a61f3ade1a43d9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/a6ed9e45cf0688f04d521b8275df6c45b6aac071.png[/img]
　
 Custom parts
 Custom parts can boost the spec when you equip them to your MS.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/0ce792942f103816b0f477f85954870932df0839.png[/img]
　
■Infantry
The pilot of the MS, get off from MS and act as a human (infantry).
　
 ■Weapons
 Bazooka
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/497a00c239db316b5aabca71ef9ea267204ebbdf.jpg[/img]
 Machine gun
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/45d179973a0660b6ad436112abecec6235faa416.jpg[/img]
 Repair kit
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/5b4c7e184c0c1fbb12d4383d169420d41acae7f9.jpg[/img]
 Flash bang
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/3c37b8031aa1080cde3620f6ba8da00661c6fe7f.jpg[/img]
 Knife
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/57fdd8b95655c7130715ccedfd6744281e5cc451.jpg[/img]
　
 ■Infantry actions
 Seize a point
 Get close and stay to take a point.
 Once you take the point, your teammates will able to respawn(sortie) from there.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/a8f552a58c56e307fc204bf2d6699f57914bcef8.jpg[/img]
　
 Set/defuse a bomb
 You can set a bomb to the required area in enemy base.
 Bomb will blow up the base in 60 seconds and you will gain massive score. 
 You can go through the same procedure to defuse a bomb in your base too.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/ea6089f1e7ec58c707625b141ae04adf5c31b6b2.jpg[/img]
　
 Artillery support
 Once your team take a point in the MAP, it will show "!" mark which means the artillery support is ready.
 Artillery support can be called to an area in the MAP.
 It's a large-scale attack that can turn the tides of the battlefield and creating openings, so go aggresively if you have the chance.
"[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/fdca91dff22d765268bc51c477a1cdec07a17d9e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/a7eb8c74b5575409a97bd4a1ba8f4059a0ef4704.jpg[/img]"
　
 Take over the enemy MS
 You may get on a MS which is no pilot on it and take over the control.
 Be careful, that MS will be self-destructed in a minute so don't be trapped by the explosion.
"[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/ec01c4bbc81816b262a09a258358a58145d480dc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/dcf28dcb1ae576b7e68081b57d1415cd3719e7d2.jpg[/img]"
　
 ■Ridable units on the field
 Pilot can also control some unit on the field, not just the MS.
"[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/f9d699e4b2352439d0b7b315284b6b94ecab3800.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/8510864f352f974c0b3c25c77761e9337d5efdbb.jpg[/img]"
　
■Game rules(mode)
 ■6 vs 6 team against battle action
 Seize the victory by evaluating the battle situation, not just through destroying MS but, also by taking control of the relay points, destroying the enemy bases, and much more!
 The team have higher score will be the winner.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/8cb0894db07ec6309a3d45ee4d7d95f141cdc11d.jpg[/img]
　
 ■Basic
"[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/f1db314b62c437ab6202b24dee28eab1b3b187c7.jpg[/img]
"
　
 ■Ace Match
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/6883511e5fa199506cfc73068961d43fa4ededbf.jpg[/img]
　
 ■Simple Battle
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/77b61ff9721628a279db12251a5f3bbee90ae996.jpg[/img]
　
 ■Shuffle Target
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/be2e5706c068acdaa4ca9177eff96497e9083932.jpg[/img]
　
 ■Mix Up
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/5ae22f2c7278895e6265f14b8e6306ea5f9a41ca.jpg[/img]
　
 ■Brawl Match
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/5a4bbab3cc3d83755e8d5673c8bc298bb5e1fe82.jpg[/img]
　
 ■Duel Match
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/38e27e65335acf8e68710d68e4f86c7c3c1db0de.jpg[/img]

 ■Tips
 Do as much as you can, then you will obtain more EXP and DP!
"[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/8d6fb7c86b6b14e16fdc1d20ce852e9e6b3ed604.jpg[/img]
"
 Monthly MS bonus
 More monthly MS you have, more bonus you will get.
"[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/9fc5b41ac4a007f7c5e1c715b5da65fd65ed1f7b.png[/img]
"
　
■UI & controls
 ■UI
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/c980718b7228303c448ba4f48a19b665274c1a12.jpg[/img]
　
 ■Controls
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/899b54e55048ee29462664f74b95d4ee4fc50488.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/63600e91e577d0218b6336681555f39988ff1ec3.png[/img]

　
■Battle Simulator
 ■Choose the mode
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/dabdb2deaae3e0fc288349c22543fef12a4cd190.png[/img]
 In "Battle Simulator", you can test different situations that you will have in battle with the AI pilots.
 "Trial" mode lets you able to try a MS, "Survival" mode is to face the advancing by non-stop enemy MS group, and "Boss" mode will have a battle with the gigantic MS.
　
 ■Trial
 A mission to use the specified MS to destroy the a target.
　
 1. You can try the MS which you don't have
  ⇒ In "Trial", you can only choose the MS the missioin provided, but you may try the MS which you don't have.
  ⇒ You CANNOT customize or paint the trial MS.
   ※ Still, you can customize the MS if you have already obtained it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/b7941928db3f386b6484057e2364e2bbf2b459d7.png[/img]
　
 2. Finish the tasks in each phase and destroy target
  ⇒ Such as "destroy a certain number of enemy MS", once you have finished all tasks in all phase, the target will appear in the field.
  ⇒ Once the target has been destroyed, the mission will be cleared no matter how many enemies remain.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/0beb144fec112a25483c6bb42234b4ae0f9bcbc0.png[/img]
　
 ■Survival
 Enemy MS will keep approaching and you have to destroy a certain number of MS to finish this mission.
　
 Destroy a certain number of MS to finish the mission.
 ⇒ Every phase you will have different number of MS to destroy, and finish the requirements of the final phase to clear the mission.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/c6403ac87af73ba0c17f8107351752cb217009ba.png[/img]
　
 ■Boss
 Destroy the boss in the final phase to finish this mission.
　
 Finish tasks in each phase, once you destroy the boss, the mission is over.
  ⇒ Such as "destroy a certain number of enemy MS", once you have finished all tasks in all phase, the boss will appear in the field.
  ⇒ Once the boss has been destroyed, the mission will be cleared no matter how many enemies remain.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/4c69c972b55bd85fee8459197150c82253d38bfa.png[/img]
 For more details about "Battle Simulator", please click here.
 ※Content of "Battle Simulator" will be possiblely changed, so please check the information on our website or in game.
　
　
Hope this will help you to enjoy GBO2!

notes.title: Tips for fresh new pilots①
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!
This is "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" on Steam team.
　
Here, you will find some useful information for battle in GBO2.
　
　
■About "Daily bonus"
3 times a day, the reward of DP, EXP and CP will be boosted hugely after battle.
※"Daily bonus" will be reset [JST] every day 05:00.
　
　
■About "Monthly MS Bonus"
If you have the monthly MS, then your battle reward will be boosted depends on the numbers you have obtained.
  ■How to know monthly MS for the month
  You can press TAB key in the reward result and choose the "All items",
  choose the "Monthly MS Bonus" in the menu, you will see the monthly MS for the month.
  Monthly MS will be changed every application update.
　
　
■About "Container Reward"
  You may find a "Container Reward" after battle randomly.
  Different content in each bronze → sliver → gold → platinum and better rewards by the color of the container.
  You may obtain ★–★★★★ material from the container including those not on the list of Supply Drop Lineup (custom parts, etc.).
  Also include the new MS or new main weapons in the lineup.
　

■Container discover chance
  Chance = 10%
　　⇒ You may discover container in the mode Quick Match/ Rating Match/ Custom Match.
　■Other feature about "Container rewards"
  After you discover bronze containers several times, a sliver container or above will be guaranteed for the next.
※Every can only discover maximum 2 containers.
※It will be reset [JST] every day 05:00.
  (You need to re-login to reset the date in game)
※If Penalty status is [PENALTY LV1] or above, you will not able to get any container.
　
　
■Premium Medal of War
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/45705816fc1f99497221ec9a74e42985223452b1.png[/img]
Premium Medal of War can be obtained by completing a certain number of "monthly missions".
Premium Medal will benefit pilot a bunch of bonus.
　
◎Finishing monthly mission will level up your stage of Premium Medal.
 ⇒Depends on your stage of Premium Medal, Encouragement can be used per day and bonus will be boosted.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/93536c7f22c3b426517c28be81b02ba95b7c9e14.png[/img]
※Premium Medal of War will be returned to P.M.U. at 5:00 (JST) on the first day of each month.
　
◎Bonus you wil be benefited by Premium Medal of War
①Encouragement can be used to the whole team for boosting battle reward.
　⇒Pilot can use Encouragement after grouping.
　⇒No matter victory or not, pilots who have the effect of Encouragement will be great boosted on battle reward and container discover chance.
　⇒Teammate will also be benefited with the bonus if your team win the battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/6e518434e639235fbba4c62a116e49b48df13267.png[/img]
※If there are more than one pilot activated Encouragement, only the strongest effect one will apply to all teammates.
※There is limit for everyday Encouragement uses.
※Encouragement uses will only be counted when battle finished and reset [JST] every day 05:00.
　
②More container can be discovered! ※Pilot will have the effect once get the Premium Medal.
　⇒Daily discoverable container will be increased for reward.
　
③More items on the lineup list in Recycle Counter. ※Pilot will have the effect once get the Premium Medal.
　⇒List of MS/main weapon/custom parts will be added and pilots will be much easier to exchange the items they wait.
　
④Others
Those pilots have the Sliver Order or above will be benefited by the effects listed below even without using Encouragement.
 ⇒Always have container discover chance bonus
 Container discover chance will always be boosted even without Encouragement.
 ⇒Always have more space in the Hanger
 More space in hanger so that pilot can enhance more MS at the same time.
　
　
■Login bonus
Pilots will able to obtain the login bonus when they first login to GBO2 everyday.
※Login bonus will be reset [JST] every day 05:00.
※Pilot can claim the Login bonus in Reward Counter.
※Content of Login bonus will be update on every month 1/11/21.
※Once pilots had claimed all items on Login bonus lineup, they will obtain 1,000 DP everyday until the next update.
※The acquisition status will be reset after the period.
　
　
■Training
You can go to "Tenda" in basecamp,
to learn the skills you need in battle through the "Training".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/da87ac5813426b3065b6a17a78d55d86a0682659.png[/img]
　
　
■About function "Quit game" and save data
Pilot can save the game data manually by using the function "Quit game" in the menu.
　
　
"H.A.R.O Menu" ＞ "Option" ＞ "Quit game"
　
There may be a possibility that game data will NOT be saved properly,
like DP exchange items and Login bonus data will NOT saved if pilot forgot to press "Quit game".
　
So we highly recommend pilots to press "Quit game" and save the game properly,
if you will off the seat for a long time that may cause you logout GBO2 automatically.
　
※If you game is not saved, those used DP will be returned to the last save state.
※GBO2 will apply auto save after Supply Drop or after a battle.
　
　
■Rating Match
In GBO2, we will evaluate the pilot rating by:
①Compare to the rival: comparing the "Score", "Feints", etc. to define the victory team.
②Victory: Defining the victory team.
The evaluation of rating is mostly rated by these two measure.
　
■Rival
  After teaming up, system will randomly match enemy team with the same pattern(same number of MS type general, raid and support) and with rating close to yours. 
  With the close rating and same MS type in both teams, you will have a highly accurate personal results comparison.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/3f2c8747089acfadd4db1efcde5ad316afab46f7.png[/img]
 ※Rival will NOT be matched with rival before a battle started.
 ※There may be a possibility of no completely same type of MS in both teams but system will match you the closest rating pilots.
　
 ※There may also be a possibility that more than one rivals in enemy team due to the reason above.
　
　
■Group matching
You can invite your friend as your teammate and fight the enemy team.
 ■How to play group match
   1. Choose a game mode like quick match, then press "C".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/bcc5a5b9f1059d8ccba63998b72ab403d13cc134.png[/img]  2. Invite your friends while preparing or press "TAB" to release the private room to public.
     Once release to public, your team will start the matching.
  ※You can only invite friends to YOUR team.
  ※You need to invite friends whose rating is close to you and have the network quality relatively close to you as well, or you can also go for the Quick Match.
　
  3. Matching will be started with the same number of both team members, average rating and close network quality. If either team is lack of member before matching started, the room will open to public and pilots will able to join the group match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/ac245c47184af53d6b3b74159efbab91ca5c2414.png[/img]

※Even one pilot's leave will cause the room dismiss once the matching finished and before the battle started.
 　(The pilot who wasn't invited by host will resume the matching.)
※The match will take much time than usual because it needs both team with close requirements. We will try to improve this part in the future.
　
　
■Hanger
You can enhance your MS in the hanger.
Find "Leona" in the basecamp to get to the hanger.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/da95426fbb2789880757254922135c4624906db3.png[/img]
　
■How to use hanger
Choose the slot to enhance your MS
⇒Slots will be increased depends on your rank or your Premium Medal of War.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/159f732d40c39481913dfca3cce0ba2b565ed4f4.png[/img]
・1st : Can be use at first.
・2nd : Will be avaliable once pilot reach to "Corporal".
・Slot for Sliver Order : Avaliable for pilots who hold the Sliver Order.
・Slot for Gold Order : Avaliable for pilots who hold the Gold Order.
・Slot for Platinum Order : Avaliable for pilots who hold the Platinum Order.
・Monthly slot (from the head to the end of the month) : Can only be used after obtaining Premium Login Bonus.
※Slots for – Orders will be unable to be used after the Premium Medal of War is reset, but the enhancing MS in the slot will still be remained there until the enhancing is finished.
　
　
■Choose the MS to enhance
・Once you choose the MS, the enhancing will be started.
⇒You can see the "Enhance value of the MS" and how long the enhancing will take. 
⇒You can still use the enhancing MS in the battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/d385e6f3daa32c52e289d015b77813eeaad4181e.png[/img]
・Enhance value
  It will be increased after the enhancing.
  There will be events to boost the enhance effectiveness.
・Enhancing time
  Enhance will take real life time.
  You can also use mechanic ticket to reduce the enhancing duration.
・Great success chance
  Chances of great success.
  Enhance will 100% success and sometimes you will have great success.
　
※About mechanic ticket
 ・Can massively reduce the enhancing time.
  ⇒You need to use the same rarity ticket of the MS. (Like ★★★ticket for ★★★MS)
  ⇒You can use the ticket even after the enhancing has been started.
  ⇒Ticket can be obtained when you get some MS you already have from Supply Drop and container rewards, etc..
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/e645cfbf4dfdb32cd933b7b8b7a16a6ea848697c.png[/img]
■Using Enhance value to upgrade your MS
・You can use enhance value to upgrade your MS.
⇒Every MS will have different upgrade details.
⇒The upgraded LV will ONLY be counted to the upgraded MS. (Even same MS need to be upgraded individually)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/e68ac5c94e90b29b568d43f52340e5515b45bc91.png[/img]
　
■Clan
You can gather the other to form a clan.
You can go battle with them and chat with them via clan channel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/044fff051ca83d4cc101461856f04bb87a810a6a.png[/img]
◎How to join/form a clan
・You can join or form a clan using the Clan camp in the basecamp
⇒Find "Adomin Granzman" to open the menu of joining or forming a clan.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/0289e1365b322b0c0d4eba36ded4ec9276c5a6cc.png[/img]
・Set a filter or search a clan with its clan tag.
・Form a new clan.
・Discharge a member/dismiss the clan
・Check the invite from any clans.
※You can ONLY join ONE clan at the same time.
　
■Form a new clan
・Form a new clan as a clan leader.
  You can set the clan profile and choose aim of clan when you form a clan.
 ・Clan name: 2–12 words.
  ※No space in the front or double space.
 ・Clan tag: 2–3 words. Can only be alphabet, number, "-" or "_".
  ※No space in clan tag.
 ・Aim of clan: set your clan's aim such as "Play freely" or "Prefer communicating", etc..
 ・Active time in week: you may set like "everyday" or "only weekend", etc..
 ・Active period in day: such as "daytime" or "midnight", etc..
 ・Preferred rating: the prefers of members' rating like "all rating" or "C- or above", etc..
 ・Preferred member: the prefers of members who is good at support type or general type or somewhat.
 ・You can also set the clan applying to be "need leader's approval".
 ・Introduction with maximum 60 words.
  ※Maximum clan member is 30.
  ※Clan name and tag can not use those had already been using.
    However, half-width and full-width characters (clan name only) and names with different uppercase and lowercase characters will be judged as different names.
 ※Please note that clan name and tag can only be set once.
 ※Pilot cannot form another clan within 7 days from a clan formed.
　
・Clan leader can:
 ・Invite others to clan
 ・Edit the clan profile (but not the name or tag)
 ・Applying the application to join the clan
 ・Assign/unassign a "Sub-leader" (Sub-leader can also apply application or edit clan profile)
 ・Assign someone as new leader
 ・Dismiss the clan
 ※Clan will be dismiss or clan leader reassign automatically if the clan leader didn't login for a long period.
　
■Join a clan
・You can join a clan too.
 Search a clan and send your application, or join a clan by receiving an invite.
 You have to wait the request had been applyed if the clan is set to "need leader's approval".
 ※You have to wait 24 hours to join a new clan once you leave or discharged from a clan.
　
◎Clan menu
 ・You can manage or see your clan in clan menu.
  You can see which clan member is online, edit the clan profile or apply application here.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/b8f4676d74cb5c5d1a3b48277727eb217a430433.png[/img]
※Clan profile can only be edited by leader or sub-leader.
※If the clan is set to "need leader's approval", then only leader can apply the request of joining the clan.
　
◎Clan channel
 ・You can chat with your clan member via this channel.
  You can press R3 button to open the chat box and chat with clan member excluding you are in a battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42229234/a2aea5fec5d06729c3b42d8b209316d6f6874a1e.png[/img]
◎Clan level
 ・You will get CP(clan point) from battle reward once you join a clan.
  Clan point will make clan level up and members will get the level up rewards together.
　
◎Clan menu in H.A.R.O. menu
 ・You can also open clan menu in H.A.R.O menu.

Report on Network Test Results for January 2023
We are pleased to announce the results of the January 2023 network test and the results of a questionnaire survey.

■ The number of players

We are very happy that so many of our pilots around the world have played the game. 
We are very happy that so many of our pilots around the world have played the game. We expect that more people will play the game when it is finally released, and these numbers will encourage us to continue to improve our operations.

■GBO2 playing status of its consumer version
*insert image here
Roughly half of the respondents were new players who had never played the consumer version.
As for the results by country, many respondents in Japan had played the consumer version of GBO2 before, while many respondents in other countries were playing the game for the first time.
We are glad that the Steam version of the game has been a good opportunity for players to get to know "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

■Kind of devices used to play
*insert image here
More than half (55.8%) played with a mouse and keyboard.
For those who have already played the consumer version, this seems to have been a new "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" experience.
Some of the pilots who responded "other" used foot pedals to control units, and we believe that the Steam version is unique in that it allows each pilot to play on the device that he or she is most comfortable using.
*Please note that control with foot pedals, etc. has not been officially confirmed.

Popular cost range and popular MS
*Insert images here

notes.title: 【Developer message】Management team attitude to harassment behaviors
notes.content:
Thank you for all playing and support to "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2" (GBO2).
This is from management team on Steam.
We will talk about management team attitude to harassment behaviors in this time.
It may be a little bit long article and we will be happy if you could pay attention to this developer message.

■Management team attitude
All harassment behaviors are NOT allowed in battle.
・Friendly fire in battle
・Non-cooperate action(AFK and keep chating, etc) rather than battle.
・Disconnecting from battle.
・Defamating via chat or mail.
・Continue fake report.

To maintain game environment and providing the good game-experience, the penalty will be proceed:
①Warning mail to the users who are keep the harassment behaviors.
②If the target who keep on even getting warning mail as ①, we will ban the account forever as a penalty.


▼Behavior will be punished
You will gain the "Disconnecting status" when disconnecting drom battle and it will become worse when keep do so.
・Friendly fire in battle(Force disconnecting when detected.)
・Non-cooperate action(AFK and keep chating, etc) rather than battle.
・Disconnecting from battle(Not including the network issues).
・Disconnecting from battle after team confirmed.

For the "Disconnecting status", It will be "GOOD ＜ CAUTION ＜ PENALTY Lv1 ＜ PENALTY Lv2" 4 steps,
It will keep step up when you keep disconnecting and the penalty will be getting heaviler.
It will recover by playing rating match or other game mode normally.

▼Penalty detail
・Less reward（PENALTY Lv1：Half or no container、PENALTY Lv2：No reward）
・Unable to build room
・Rank point will stay at 0 even victory(It will keep dropping when lose the battle.)
・Battle limitation（PENALTY Lv1：30 Hours、PENALTY Lv2：120 Hours）
If it is continously happened even in　"PENALTY Lv2", you will unable to join battle on EVERY time.
・Less rating level on next battle
　S-、A+：Rating level -7
　A、A-：Rating level -6
　B+、B、B-：Rating level -5
　C+、C、C-：Rating level-4
　D+、D、D-：Rating level-3


▼Report function
You can report the harassment behaviors thought the "Report" in the battle result window.
We hope all is good but feel free to report anything if necessary.


When there is a disconnecting because of the network issues,
It is non-sense to punish a user who disconnect game because of network issues
but please understand that it is hard to identify all situation and the need to set the heavy penalty.

We have a strict policy at the moment.
As a cushion for those troubles happened in game,
there is a chance if only disconnected from game only once.
It is a system for those who are unlucky disconnected from the game without any wishes,
and this is the cushion and also a chance for those bad manner users.

If the rating level getting less because there is someone leave the battle,
the pilot who fight to the end will have a adjustment rating as the same of the minus level,
you will not lost any rating level due to this reason.
※But there will no adjustment if there is the same pilots on both side.


GBO2 is a "Multiple player" game but not "Single" game, you are playing with "Other players" at the same time.
Game-experience is not only you, it's for all players.
Since, we hope you can understand and be cooperate.

We will keep on putting effort to GBO2 developing.
Hope you enjoy GBO2!

Hello, Pilots!

Now you may play the content of PS5™/PS4® "GBO2" on Steam®.

▼Update schedule
Content on 【Steam®】 will be a little bit later than 【PS5™/PS4®】.
Contents below will be the same with PS4/PS5 but different schedule.
・Update file release
・Application update
・Supply drop lineup update
・Unit adjustment（MS/Main weapon/Sub weapon）
・New materials in DP Exchange Counter/Recycle Counter
・Game rule update in each match
　
The schedule and a part of details of these events on 【Steam®】 will be different from 【PS5™/PS4®】.
・Event & Campagin
・Supply drop lineup update and approach
・Weekly Weekend Battle
・Clan Match
・Clan Match reward collection period
　
※There is also a possiblity of chance on 【Steam®】 to change the schedule.
※For more detail of update schedule 【Steam®】, please check the "Reference news" on Steam® store page or "update history".
　
　
　
▼Reset timing of login bonus and daily task
The reset timing on 【Steam®】 will be:
・Login bonus：Everyday 05:00 (JST)
・Daily task：Everyday 05:00 (JST)
・Monthly task：The first day of every month 04:59 (JST)
　
※Since you received from the reward counter, each task requirement(daily task and login bonus token, etc)will be counted. Please don't be forget to take all the task or reward.
　
※The requirement of monthly task "DP/token/getting the recycle ticket" will only count the item you have gained in the period.
　
※The monthly task "〇〇 monthly task done last month" will depend on the finsihing condition of the monthly task in the past.
　
This monthly task will not be possible to clear on the first month(from start playing GBO2).
⇒　By completing 18 or more monthly missions in April, you will be able to finish May's monthly mission "18 monthly task done last month" in the following month's May monthly mission.
　
（Clearing more of this month's monthly missions will give you an advantage in the following month's monthly missions.）
　
▼No cross-playing and cross-save between 【Steam®】 and the 【PS5™/PS4®】.
There will be no cross-playing and cross-save between 【Steam®】 and 【the console version】.
Of course we understand there are users on 【PS5™/PS4®】 are looking forward to play with their own save data on 【Steam®】.
As we disscuss for that and we have made the decision because of the difference between both platform's management team,
many fresh pilots will join GBO2 because of the launching on Steam®,
to balance the pilots power and guarantee all pilots a good experience,
we will NOT have cross-save and cross-playing on Steam®.
　
　
We understand there are users from 【PS5™/PS4®】 who are worry about or have question to our policy on 【Steam®】.
We are really hoping all users will have a good game-experience and answering all those who are waiting and expexting GBO2 on Steam® so we will keep on the development.
We are also looking forward to let experienced users on 【PS5™/PS4®】 will have a try of GBO2 by keyboard and mouse on 【Steam®】, and new users in the future who are interested in GBO2 but miss the chance to play GBO2, the new start in GBO2 on Steam®,
we will bring you all our best effort to GBO2! Come, join and enjoy!

notes.title: Notice about upcoming Network Test!
notes.content:

GBO2, is a Free-to-Play game set in the "Mobile Suit Gundam" universe featuring up to 6 vs 6 battles.
